actions.description: Retrieve executive performance report for the ActiveTrail account, providing email marketing metrics over the past 12 months. Returns monthly statistics including emails sent, bounce rates, open rates, click rates, click-to-open rates, complaint rates, and unsubscribe rates for both marketing campaigns and transactional emails. Use this to analyze overall account performance trends and generate summary statistics. #### Output | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | Yes | Data from the action execution | | `error` | string | No | Error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | Yes | Whether or not the action execution was successful or not |

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/AccountGetTwoWaySmsRepliesConnector
actions.label: Account: Get Two Way Sms Replies
actions.description: Tool to retrieve virtual number SMS replies with filtering options. Use when you need to fetch two-way SMS responses for campaigns with optional filtering by search term, campaign ID, or date range.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/AccountPutAccountContentCategoriesConnector
actions.label: Account: Put Account Content Categories
actions.description: Tool to update a specific content category by ID. Use when you need to modify the name or display order of a category in your ActiveTrail account.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/AutomationsDeleteAutomationsConnector
actions.label: Automations: Delete Automations
actions.description: Tool to delete one or more automations from Active Trail. Use when you need to remove automations by their IDs. Supports bulk deletion by providing comma-separated IDs.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/AutomationsGetAutomationLogConnector
actions.label: Automations: Get Automation Log
actions.description: Tool to track contacts through automation journey by retrieving detailed logs. Use when you need to see which contacts started a specific automation and their progress through each step of the workflow.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/AutomationsGetAutomationReportsLogAutomationQueueConnector
actions.label: Automations: Get Automation Reports Log Automation Queue
actions.description: Tool to retrieve contacts that did not finish a specific automation. Use when you need to get the list of contacts remaining in the automation queue for a given automation ID.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/AutomationsGetAutomationsConnector
actions.label: Automations: Get Automations
actions.description: Tool to list account automations with filtering and pagination. Use when you need to retrieve automations from the ActiveTrail account. Supports filtering by state and pagination parameters.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/AutomationsGetAutomationsDetailsConnector
actions.label: Automations: Get Automations Details
actions.description: Tool to retrieve detailed configuration of a specific automation excluding step-by-step execution details. Use when you need metadata about automation behavior, scheduling, reporting settings, and operational constraints.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/AutomationsGetAutomationsEmailCampaignStepsConnector
actions.label: Automations: Get Automations Email Campaign Steps
actions.description: Tool to retrieve all email campaign steps in an automation workflow. Use when you need to get details about all 'send email' steps configured within a specific automation, including email content, scheduling, and tracking settings.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/AutomationsGetAutomationsSmsCampaignStepsConnector
actions.label: Automations: Get Automations Sms Campaign Steps
actions.description: Tool to retrieve all SMS campaign steps in an automation workflow. Use when you need to get details about all 'send SMS' steps configured within a specific automation, including SMS content, scheduling, and tracking settings.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/AutomationsGetAutomationTriggerTypesConnector
actions.label: Automations: Get Automation Trigger Types
actions.description: Tool to retrieve all available start trigger options for automations. Use when you need to get the list of trigger types that can initiate automation workflows in ActiveTrail. #### Output | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | Yes | Data from the action execution | | `error` | string | No | Error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | Yes | Whether or not the action execution was successful or not |

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/AutomationsGetUpdateActionsConnector
actions.label: Automations: Get Update Actions
actions.description: Retrieves all available update action types that can be applied to contacts within automation workflows. Each action type includes its ID, name, description, type category, and required parameters. Use this to discover what contact update operations are available when building or modifying automation workflows (e.g., updating contact fields, changing status, adding tags, etc.). #### Output | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | Yes | Data from the action execution | | `error` | string | No | Error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | Yes | Whether or not the action execution was successful or not |

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/CampaignReportsGetAllCampaignReportsConnector
actions.label: Campaign: Reports Get All Campaign Reports
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a full overview of all campaign reports with comprehensive metrics. Use when you need to get reports for all campaigns including send date, opened emails, number of clicks, CTO, bounces, unsubscribers, complaints, unopened and sent emails. Default behavior: Returns campaigns filtered by last update date within the previous 3 months when date parameters are not specified. Default limit is 20 records per page, maximum is 100.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/CampaignReportsGetAllSentCampaignsConnector
actions.label: Campaign: Reports Get All Sent Campaigns
actions.description: Tool to retrieve campaigns with optional filtering by date, mailing list, and search criteria. Use when you need to get campaigns filtered by date range (default is last 3 months), limited to a specific number (default is 100), or filtered by mailing list.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/CampaignReportsGetCampaignBouncesConnector
actions.label: Campaign: Reports Get Campaign Bounces
actions.description: Tool to retrieve bounce details by domain for a specific campaign. Use when you need to analyze campaign bounce rates and identify problematic email domains. Defaults to campaigns updated in the last 3 months.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/CampaignReportsGetCampaignReportsBouncedConnector
actions.label: Campaign: Reports Get Campaign Reports Bounced
actions.description: Tool to retrieve bounced email details filtered by bounce type for a specific campaign. Use when you need detailed information about which contacts' emails bounced and why, with the ability to filter by hard or soft bounces.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/CampaignReportsGetCampaignReportsComplaintsConnector
actions.label: Campaign: Reports Get Campaign Reports Complaints
actions.description: Tool to retrieve contacts who reported a specific campaign as spam. Use when you need to identify which contacts flagged your campaign as unwanted. The default search window is the last 3 months; if the campaign wasn't sent during the specified dates, an empty list is returned.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/CampaignReportsGetCampaignReportsSentConnector
actions.label: Campaign: Reports Get Campaign Reports Sent
actions.description: Tool to retrieve contacts who received a specific campaign email. Use when you need to identify which recipients successfully received your campaign. The default search window is the last 3 months; if the campaign wasn't sent during the specified dates, an empty list is returned.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/CampaignReportsGetCampaignReportsUnopenedConnector
actions.label: Campaign: Reports Get Campaign Reports Unopened
actions.description: Tool to retrieve contacts who did not open a specific campaign. Use when you need to identify which recipients received but did not open your campaign email. The default search window is the last 3 months; if the campaign wasn't sent during the specified dates, an empty list is returned.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/CampaignReportsGetCampaignUnsubscribedConnector
actions.label: Campaign: Reports Get Campaign Unsubscribed
actions.description: Retrieves the list of contacts who unsubscribed from a specific email campaign. Use this action when you need to: - Identify which recipients opted out of receiving future communications from a campaign - Analyze unsubscribe patterns and reasons for a particular campaign - Track campaign unsubscribe metrics and contact details By default, searches campaigns updated within the last 3 months. If the campaign wasn't sent within the specified date range, an empty list is returned. Supports pagination for large unsubscribe lists.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/CampaignReportsGetPushCampaignReportsConnector
actions.label: Campaign: Reports Get Push Campaign Reports
actions.description: Retrieves push notification campaign performance metrics and reports filtered by date range, send type, or search term. Returns analytics including sent count, delivered count, opened count, clicked count, open rate, click rate, and delivery status for each campaign. Default behavior: Returns the last 20 campaigns from the last 3 months when no parameters are specified.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/CampaignsCreateCampaignConnector
actions.label: Campaigns: Create Campaign
actions.description: Create and return a new email campaign for specific groups. The campaign can be configured as an A/B split test, E-commerce campaign, or a regular campaign. Created in draft status unless is_sent is set to true.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/CampaignsCreateCampaignForContactsConnector
actions.label: Campaigns: Create Campaign For Contacts
actions.description: Tool to create and send a new campaign to specific contacts in ActiveTrail. Use when you need to create campaigns targeted at selected recipients by contact IDs or email addresses. Supports regular campaigns, A/B split campaigns, and e-commerce campaigns.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/CampaignsDeleteCampaignConnector
actions.label: Campaigns: Delete Campaign
actions.description: Tool to remove a campaign from ActiveTrail account. Use when you need to delete a campaign that is no longer needed.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/CampaignsGetCampaignDesignConnector
actions.label: Campaigns: Get Campaign Design
actions.description: Tool to retrieve campaign design configuration including visual layout and HTML content. Use when you need to get the design details of a specific email campaign.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/CampaignsGetCampaignSchedulingConnector
actions.label: Campaigns: Get Campaign Scheduling
actions.description: Retrieves the scheduling configuration for a specific email campaign, including send status and scheduled datetime. Use this action when you need to check if a campaign is scheduled to send, when it's scheduled to send (in UTC), or verify the send status of a campaign. The response includes is_sent flag (whether campaign is dispatched) and scheduled_date_utc (planned send datetime). Campaign ID can be obtained from campaign list actions.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/CampaignsGetCampaignsDetailsConnector
actions.label: Campaigns: Get Campaigns Details
actions.description: Tool to retrieve detailed campaign information including name, subject, and settings. Use when you need to get comprehensive details about a specific email campaign.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/CampaignsGetCampaignsSegmentConnector
actions.label: Campaigns: Get Campaigns Segment
actions.description: Tool to retrieve campaign sending settings including target groups and sending restrictions. Use when you need to get the segmentation configuration for a specific campaign.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/CampaignsGetCampaignsSentCampaignsConnector
actions.label: Campaigns: Get Campaigns Sent Campaigns
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all sent campaigns from ActiveTrail. Use when you need to view all campaigns that have been sent, including their details such as name, subject, send status, and delivery metrics. #### Output | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | Yes | Data from the action execution | | `error` | string | No | Error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | Yes | Whether or not the action execution was successful or not |

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/CampaignsGetCampaignTemplateConnector
actions.label: Campaigns: Get Campaign Template
actions.description: Retrieves template details (design, content, subject line, sender info) for a specific email campaign. Use this action when you need to: - View the template configuration used in a campaign - Get HTML/plain text content of a campaign template - Retrieve sender information (from name, from email, reply-to) - Access template metadata like category, creation/modification dates Note: Requires a valid campaign ID which can be obtained from the 'Get Sent Campaigns' action.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/CampaignsGetPushCampaignsConnector
actions.label: Campaigns: Get Push Campaigns
actions.description: Tool to retrieve push notification campaigns with optional filtering by date, campaign ID, and search criteria. Use when you need to get push campaigns filtered by date range (default is last 6 months and last 20 campaigns), or filtered by specific campaign ID or search term.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/CampaignsGetTemplateConnector
actions.label: Campaigns: Get Template
actions.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about a specific template from the account's saved templates. Use when you need to fetch template details including name, subject, content, category, and encoding settings.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/CampaignsListSmsCampaignsConnector
actions.label: Campaigns: List Sms Campaigns
actions.description: Tool to retrieve SMS campaigns with optional filtering by date, search term, and type. Use when you need to get SMS campaigns filtered by date range (default is last 3 months) or other criteria. Returns up to 20 campaigns per page by default.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/CampaignsPutCampaignsSegmentConnector
actions.label: Campaigns: Put Campaigns Segment
actions.description: Tool to update campaign sending settings including groups and sending restrictions. Use when you need to modify which groups receive a campaign. Note: Only campaigns in draft mode can be updated.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/CampaignsUpdateCampaignDesignConnector
actions.label: Campaigns: Update Campaign Design
actions.description: Tool to update the design and HTML content of an email campaign in ActiveTrail. Use when you need to modify a campaign's visual layout, HTML content, or encoding settings. Important: Only campaigns in draft mode can be updated through this endpoint.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/CampaignsUpdateCampaignSchedulingConnector
actions.label: Campaigns: Update Campaign Scheduling
actions.description: Tool to configure send schedule for draft campaigns. Use when you need to update the scheduling configuration of a campaign. Only campaigns in draft mode can be updated.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/CampaignsUpdateCampaignSDetailsConnector
actions.label: Campaigns: Update Campaign SDetails
actions.description: Updates an email campaign's core details including name, subject line, sender profile, category, and delivery settings. Important: Only campaigns in DRAFT status can be updated. Attempting to update sent or scheduled campaigns will fail. Use 'Get Campaign by ID' first to verify the campaign is in draft mode before updating.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/CampaignsUpdateCampaignTemplateConnector
actions.label: Campaigns: Update Campaign Template
actions.description: Tool to update the template associated with an email campaign in ActiveTrail. Use when you need to assign or change a template for a campaign. Important: Only campaigns in draft mode can be updated through this endpoint.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/CommerceCreateOrderConnector
actions.label: Commerce: Create Order
actions.description: Tool to create new orders in ActiveTrail commerce system. Use when you need to add order records with customer information, products, and transaction details. Accepts an array of order objects for batch creation.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/CommerceGetCommerceSchemaConnector
actions.label: Commerce: Get Commerce Schema
actions.description: Tool to retrieve order fields schema information from the ActiveTrail commerce API. Use when you need to get information about available order fields, their types, and custom names for commerce/order management. #### Output | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | Yes | Data from the action execution | | `error` | string | No | Error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | Yes | Whether or not the action execution was successful or not |

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/CommerceGetOrderConnector
actions.label: Commerce: Get Order
actions.description: Tool to retrieve complete details of a specific order from ActiveTrail commerce system. Use when you need to fetch order information including customer details, financial data, products, and shipping information.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/CommerceUpdateOrderConnector
actions.label: Commerce: Update Order
actions.description: Updates an existing order in the ActiveTrail commerce system. Use this action to modify order details including customer information (name, email, phone), shipping address, order status, pricing (amounts, tax, currency), or product items. You must provide the existing order_id - this action cannot create new orders. Common use cases: - Update order status (e.g., from "pending" to "shipped") - Modify customer contact information - Adjust pricing or add/remove items - Update shipping addresses - Change order metadata (dates, custom fields)

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/ContactsCreateContactConnector
actions.label: Contacts: Create Contact
actions.description: Creates a new contact in ActiveTrail with the provided information. At least one of email or sms must be provided as the primary identifier. All other fields are optional and can be used to enrich the contact profile. Important: Newly created contacts are not automatically assigned to any group. To enable email/SMS campaigns for this contact, you must add them to a group using a separate action after creation. Returns the complete contact record including the assigned contact ID.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/ContactsDeleteContactConnector
actions.label: Contacts: Delete Contact
actions.description: Tool to permanently remove a contact from the ActiveTrail account by their unique contact ID. Use when you need to delete a specific contact. This operation is destructive and cannot be undone. Returns success status and optional message.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/ContactsGetCampaignReportsEmailActivityConnector
actions.label: Contacts: Get Campaign Reports Email Activity
actions.description: Tool to retrieve all contacts' activity on a specific campaign. Use when you need comprehensive activity data including opens, clicks, bounces, and other engagement metrics for each contact in a campaign. By default, the search covers campaigns updated in the last 3 months; if the campaign wasn't sent in the specified date range, an error will be returned.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/ContactsGetContactActivityConnector
actions.label: Contacts: Get Contact Activity
actions.description: Tool to retrieve contact's email engagement history including opens and clicks. Use when you need detailed activity data showing which campaigns were sent to a contact and their engagement metrics.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/ContactsGetContactDetailsConnector
actions.label: Contacts: Get Contact Details
actions.description: Tool to retrieve complete details of a specific contact by their ID. Use when you need full contact information including personal data, contact fields, subscription status, and all custom extended fields.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/ContactsGetContactGroupsConnector
actions.label: Contacts: Get Contact Groups
actions.description: Tool to retrieve all groups associated with a specific contact. Returns group details including group ID, name, member counts, and creation dates. Use when you need to list a contact's group memberships by contact ID.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/ContactsGetContactListConnector
actions.label: Contacts: Get Contact List
actions.description: Tool to retrieve account contacts filtered by status and date range. Use when you need to get a list of contacts filtered by customer status (active, unsubscribed, bounced, etc.) or by registration date. Default behavior: retrieves contacts modified within the last three months with a limit of 100 contacts per page.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/ContactsGetContactsErrorsConnector
actions.label: Contacts: Get Contacts Errors
actions.description: Tool to retrieve bounce and error history for a specific contact. Use when you need to understand delivery issues or bounce patterns for a contact's email address.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/ContactsGetContactsMailinglistsConnector
actions.label: Contacts: Get Contacts Mailinglists
actions.description: Tool to retrieve all mailing lists associated with a specific contact. Use when you need to list a contact's mailing list memberships by contact ID.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/ContactsGetContactsMergesConnector
actions.label: Contacts: Get Contacts Merges
actions.description: Tool to retrieve contacts experiencing merge conflicts with filtering options. Use when you need to get the list of contacts with merge conflicts, filtered by status, date range, or limited to a specific number of conflicts.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/ContactsGetContactSmsStatisticsConnector
actions.label: Contacts: Get Contact Sms Statistics
actions.description: Tool to retrieve contact interaction statistics for a specific transactional SMS. Use when you need to see how a contact interacted with a transactional/operational SMS including delivery status, bounce information, and unsubscribe actions.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/ContactsGetContactsStatisticsCampaignConnector
actions.label: Contacts: Get Contacts Statistics Campaign
actions.description: Tool to retrieve contact's interaction statistics for a specific campaign. Use when you need to see how a specific contact engaged with a campaign including opens, clicks, bounces, unsubscribes, and spam complaints.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/ContactsGetContactsSubscriptionAllContactsConnector
actions.label: Contacts: Get Contacts Subscription All Contacts
actions.description: Tool to get contacts' subscription status and the source of their status (if known). Use when you need to retrieve all contacts with their subscription status information filtered by creation date. Defaults to three months back if date range is not specified.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/ContactsGetContactsSubscriptionCustomersStatusConnector
actions.label: Contacts: Get Contacts Subscription Customers Status
actions.description: Get daily breakdown of contact status statistics over a date range. Returns counts of active, unsubscribed, bounced, quarantined, spam complaints, inactive, and user-requested removal contacts for each day in the specified period. Defaults to recent days when no date range is provided.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/ContactsGetContactsSubscriptionSubscribersConnector
actions.label: Contacts: Get Contacts Subscription Subscribers
actions.description: Tool to retrieve all contacts who subscribed and the source of their subscription status. Use when you need to get a comprehensive list of subscribers. The search defaults to 3 months back if date range is not specified.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/ContactsGetContactsSubscriptionUnsubscribersConnector
actions.label: Contacts: Get Contacts Subscription Unsubscribers
actions.description: Tool to retrieve all contacts who unsubscribed and the source of their unsubscription status. Use when you need to get a comprehensive list of unsubscribers. The search defaults to 3 months back if date range is not specified.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/ContactsGetContactsUnsubscribersSmsConnector
actions.label: Contacts: Get Contacts Unsubscribers Sms
actions.description: Tool to retrieve all contacts who unsubscribed from receiving SMS messages. Use when you need to get a list of SMS unsubscribers with optional filtering by date range and pagination support.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/ContactsGetContactsWithSmsStateConnector
actions.label: Contacts: Get Contacts With Sms State
actions.description: Tool to retrieve account's contacts list with SMS subscription state. Use when you need to get contacts filtered by customer status (active, unsubscribed, bounced, etc.) and by state change date range, with default filtering to three months back.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/ContactsGetCustomerStatsForTransactionalMessageConnector
actions.label: Contacts: Get Customer Stats For Transactional Message
actions.description: Tool to retrieve customer interaction statistics for a specific transactional message. Use when you need to see how a contact engaged with a transactional/operational message including delivery status, opens, clicks, and other interaction metrics.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/ContactsImportNewContactsConnector
actions.label: Contacts: Import New Contacts
actions.description: Tool to import new contacts into a group in ActiveTrail. Use when you need to bulk import contacts with customer information (limited to 1000 contacts per call). Returns success count and any errors for failed contact imports.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/ContactsListTransactionalSmsMessagesConnector
actions.label: Contacts: List Transactional Sms Messages
actions.description: Tool to retrieve all SMS transactional messages with pagination support. Use when you need to fetch the list of operational SMS campaigns configured in the account.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/ExternalCreateSmsOperationalMessageConnector
actions.label: External: Create Sms Operational Message
actions.description: Tool to create a new operational SMS transactional message. Use when you need to create an SMS campaign for later use or editing.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/ExternalDeleteMailingListConnector
actions.label: External: Delete Mailing List
actions.description: Tool to permanently remove a mailing list from the ActiveTrail account by its unique ID. Use when you need to delete a mailing list that is no longer needed. This operation is destructive and cannot be undone. Returns success status and confirmation message.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/ExternalGetExternalSchemaConnector
actions.label: External: Get External Schema
actions.description: Tool to retrieve contact field schema information for the account. Use when you need to get the structure and metadata of all available contact fields. #### Output | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | Yes | Data from the action execution | | `error` | string | No | Error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | Yes | Whether or not the action execution was successful or not |

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/ExternalGetSendingProfilesConnector
actions.label: External: Get Sending Profiles
actions.description: Tool to retrieve account email sending profiles. Use when you need to get sending profile configurations including sender names, email addresses, and reply-to settings. #### Output | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | Yes | Data from the action execution | | `error` | string | No | Error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | Yes | Whether or not the action execution was successful or not |

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/ExternalGetSmsSendingProfilesConnector
actions.label: External: Get Sms Sending Profiles
actions.description: Tool to retrieve SMS sending profiles configured for the account. Use when you need to get SMS sender profile configurations including sender names and phone numbers. #### Output | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | Yes | Data from the action execution | | `error` | string | No | Error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | Yes | Whether or not the action execution was successful or not |

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/ExternalRemoveExternalContactFromGroupConnector
actions.label: External: Remove External Contact From Group
actions.description: Tool to remove contacts from a group via external ID. Use when you need to delete external contacts from a specific group in ActiveTrail. Limited to 1000 contacts per call.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/ExternalSendOperationalMessageConnector
actions.label: External: Send Operational Message
actions.description: Create and send a new operational message via the external API (limited to 500 messages per request). Recipients will be created as contacts if they don't already exist.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/ExternalSendOperationalMessageEmailConnector
actions.label: External: Send Operational Message Email
actions.description: Send an email operational message to individual emails (limited to 500). Supports dynamic text replacement via email_package key-value pairs.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/ExternalUpdateContactConnector
actions.label: External: Update Contact
actions.description: Tool to update an existing contact's information by ID. Use when you need to modify contact details such as name, email, phone, address, or custom fields. Only the fields you include in the request will be updated; other fields remain unchanged.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/GroupsAddGroupMemberConnector
actions.label: Groups: Add Group Member
actions.description: Tool to add a member to a group in ActiveTrail. Creates a new contact or adds an existing contact to the specified group. Supports comprehensive contact information including names, phone numbers, addresses, dates, and custom extension fields. The API will not return errors if the contact is already in the group (idempotent operation).

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/GroupsCreateANewGroupConnector
actions.label: Groups: Create ANew Group
actions.description: Creates a new contact group in ActiveTrail for organizing and segmenting contacts. Groups are containers for contacts that allow you to: - Organize contacts by category, campaign, or segment - Target specific groups for email/SMS campaigns - Manage contact memberships independently The newly created group will be empty. Use the "Add Group Member" action to add contacts to this group. Returns the complete group details including the assigned group ID.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/GroupsDeleteAMemberInAGroupConnector
actions.label: Groups: Delete AMember In AGroup
actions.description: Tool to delete a group member by ID. Use when you need to remove a contact from a specific group in ActiveTrail.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/GroupsDeleteGroupByIdConnector
actions.label: Groups: Delete Group By Id
actions.description: Tool to delete a group by ID. Use when you need to permanently remove a group from ActiveTrail. This is a destructive operation that cannot be undone.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/GroupsGetAllGroupsConnector
actions.label: Groups: Get All Groups
actions.description: Tool to retrieve the full list of account groups with pagination and filtering. Use when you need to get all groups or search for groups by name. Default limit is 100 groups per page.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/GroupsGetGroupConnector
actions.label: Groups: Get Group
actions.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about a specific group by its unique identifier. Use when you need to fetch group details including name, contact counters, and timestamps.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/GroupsGetGroupContentsByIdConnector
actions.label: Groups: Get Group Contents By Id
actions.description: Tool to retrieve all group members by group ID with pagination and filtering. Use when you need to get complete information about contacts in a specific group. Returns up to 100 contacts per page with optional filtering by status and date range.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/GroupsGetGroupsEventsConnector
actions.label: Groups: Get Groups Events
actions.description: Tool to retrieve all events for a specific group with optional filtering by event type, event date, and subscriber creation date. Use when you need to analyze group engagement metrics like opens, clicks, and unsubscribes. Default date range is 3 months back if not specified.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/GroupsUpdateGroupConnector
actions.label: Groups: Update Group
actions.description: Updates an existing group in ActiveTrail by its ID. Primary use case: Rename a group by updating its name field. Important notes: - Only the 'name' field is reliably updateable via this endpoint - The API typically returns HTTP 204 (No Content) on success - Group must exist or will return 404 error Use 'Get All Groups' or 'Get Group by ID' actions to find the group ID first.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/LandingpageGetLandingPagesConnector
actions.label: Landingpage: Get Landing Pages
actions.description: Tool to retrieve landing pages from the ActiveTrail account with pagination support. Use when you need to get all landing pages or fetch paginated results.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/MailingListAddMailinglistMemberConnector
actions.label: Mailing: List Add Mailinglist Member
actions.description: Tool to add a member to a mailing list in ActiveTrail. Creates a new contact or adds an existing contact to the specified mailing list and groups. Either email or SMS must be provided.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/MailingListCreateNewMailingListConnector
actions.label: Mailing: List Create New Mailing List
actions.description: Tool to create a new mailing list in ActiveTrail. Use when you need to add a new mailing list to organize and manage contacts.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/MailingListGetMailingListConnector
actions.label: Mailing: List Get Mailing List
actions.description: Tool to retrieve basic information about a specific mailing list by its unique identifier. Returns the mailing list ID and name. Use when you need to verify a mailing list exists or get its name by ID.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/MailingListGetMailingListMembersConnector
actions.label: Mailing: List Get Mailing List Members
actions.description: Tool to retrieve all members belonging to a specific mailing list. Use when you need to get contacts from a mailing list, with optional filtering by contact status and state change date range.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/MailingListGetMailingListsConnector
actions.label: Mailing: List Get Mailing Lists
actions.description: Tool to retrieve all mailing lists from the ActiveTrail account. Use when you need to get the list of mailing lists associated with the account. #### Output | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | Yes | Data from the action execution | | `error` | string | No | Error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | Yes | Whether or not the action execution was successful or not |

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/MailingListRemoveAContactFromAMailingListConnector
actions.label: Mailing: List Remove AContact From AMailing List
actions.description: Removes a specific contact from a mailing list in ActiveTrail. Use this action to unsubscribe or remove a contact from a particular mailing list without deleting the contact from your account entirely. The contact will no longer receive campaigns sent to this specific mailing list, but will remain in other lists they belong to. Note: This is a destructive operation that cannot be undone via API. To re-add the contact to the list, use the 'Import New Contacts' action.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/OperationalMessageGetTransactionalMessagesClassificationConnector
actions.label: Operational: Message Get Transactional Messages Classification
actions.description: Tool to retrieve all classification options for operational/transactional messages. Use when you need to get available classifications for categorizing and filtering transactional message reports. #### Output | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | Yes | Data from the action execution | | `error` | string | No | Error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | Yes | Whether or not the action execution was successful or not |

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/PushCampaignReportGetPushCampaignReportDeliveredConnector
actions.label: Push: Campaign Report Get Push Campaign Report Delivered
actions.description: Tool to retrieve contacts who successfully received a specific push notification campaign. Use when you need to identify which recipients had the push campaign delivered to their devices. The campaign must have been sent within the specified date range (defaults to last 3 months); if not sent during these dates, an empty list is returned.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/PushCampaignReportGetPushCampaignReportFailedConnector
actions.label: Push: Campaign Report Get Push Campaign Report Failed
actions.description: Tool to retrieve the failed delivery report for a specific push campaign. Use when you need to see which contacts experienced delivery failures and why. The campaign must be sent in the specified date range (defaults to last 3 months).

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/PushCampaignReportGetPushCampaignReportSentConnector
actions.label: Push: Campaign Report Get Push Campaign Report Sent
actions.description: Tool to retrieve the list of contacts who were sent a specific push notification campaign, including contact details, device types, and sent timestamps. Use when you need to see the complete list of recipients for a push campaign with their delivery information. Supports filtering by date range (defaults to last 3 months), send type, and search terms. Returns paginated results with contact details for each recipient.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/SegmentationCreateSegmentationConnector
actions.label: Segmentation: Create Segmentation
actions.description: Create a new contact segmentation in ActiveTrail. Segmentations are rule-based filters that define target audiences based on contact field values (e.g., email equals specific value, city contains text, etc.). Use this to create dynamic segments for campaign targeting, automation workflows, or contact organization. Requires a unique name and at least one base rule with field, operator, and values.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/SegmentationGetSegmentationRuleFieldTypesConnector
actions.label: Segmentation: Get Segmentation Rule Field Types
actions.description: Retrieve a reference dictionary of all available field types that can be used in segmentation rules for ActiveTrail automation. Returns field type definitions including their identifiers, names, data types, and descriptions. This endpoint provides the foundational metadata needed to understand which contact fields (email, phone, custom fields, behavioral data, etc.) can be evaluated when constructing segmentation conditions in marketing automations. Use this when you need to discover what field types are available before building or validating segmentation rules. #### Output | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | Yes | Data from the action execution | | `error` | string | No | Error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | Yes | Whether or not the action execution was successful or not |

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/SegmentationGetSegmentationRuleOperationsConnector
actions.label: Segmentation: Get Segmentation Rule Operations
actions.description: Retrieves available rule operations for segmentation by field type. Returns operations categorized by field types (Info, Date, Action, Numeric, etc.) with their corresponding operation types (Is, IsNot, Contain, GreaterThan, etc.). Use this to understand which operations are valid when building segmentation rules based on field types. #### Output | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | Yes | Data from the action execution | | `error` | string | No | Error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | Yes | Whether or not the action execution was successful or not |

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/SegmentationGetSegmentationRuleTypesConnector
actions.label: Segmentation: Get Segmentation Rule Types
actions.description: Tool to retrieve available segmentation rule types for automation. Returns a list of rule type names that can be used when creating or editing automation segmentations. Use this to discover what types of rules are available (e.g., Info, Numeric, Date, Group, Action, Order-related, Cart, Catalog, etc.). #### Output | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | Yes | Data from the action execution | | `error` | string | No | Error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | Yes | Whether or not the action execution was successful or not |

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/SegmentationGetSegmentationRuleTypesMappingConnector
actions.label: Segmentation: Get Segmentation Rule Types Mapping
actions.description: Tool to retrieve the complete mapping of segmentation rule types with their associated field types and operations from ActiveTrail. Use this when building segmentation rules to understand which field types and operations are available for each rule type (e.g., Info rules support Email fields with 'Is' operation). #### Output | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | Yes | Data from the action execution | | `error` | string | No | Error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | Yes | Whether or not the action execution was successful or not |

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/SegmentationGetSegmentationsConnector
actions.label: Segmentation: Get Segmentations
actions.description: Retrieve all contact segmentations from your ActiveTrail account. Segmentations are rule-based filters that define target audiences for campaigns and automations (e.g., contacts who opened specific campaigns, belong to certain groups, or match demographic criteria). Use this to list all configured segmentations and their IDs for use in campaign targeting or automation workflows. #### Output | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | Yes | Data from the action execution | | `error` | string | No | Error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | Yes | Whether or not the action execution was successful or not |

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/SegmentationUpdateSegmentationConnector
actions.label: Segmentation: Update Segmentation
actions.description: Tool to update an existing segmentation's name and/or rules by its ID. Use when you need to modify segmentation criteria or rename a segment. Segmentations are rule-based filters that define target audiences based on contact attributes, behaviors, or campaign interactions.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/SignupFormsGetSignupFormsConnector
actions.label: Signup: Forms Get Signup Forms
actions.description: Tool to retrieve all signup forms from the ActiveTrail account. Use when you need to get the list of signup forms associated with the account. #### Output | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | Yes | Data from the action execution | | `error` | string | No | Error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | Yes | Whether or not the action execution was successful or not |

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/SmartCodeSiteCreateSmartCodeSiteConnector
actions.label: Smart: Code Site Create Smart Code Site
actions.description: Creates a new Smart Code tracking site in ActiveTrail. Smart Code is ActiveTrail's web analytics and visitor tracking solution that monitors visitor behavior on your website. Use this action to register a website for Smart Code tracking by providing a site name and domain(s).

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/SmartCodeSiteDeleteSmartCodeSiteConnector
actions.label: Smart: Code Site Delete Smart Code Site
actions.description: Tool to remove a Smart Code site from ActiveTrail. Use when you need to permanently delete a Smart Code site identified by its unique ID.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/SmartCodeSiteGetSmartCodeSitesConnector
actions.label: Smart: Code Site Get Smart Code Sites
actions.description: Retrieves all Smart Code tracking sites configured in the ActiveTrail account. Smart Code is ActiveTrail's web analytics and visitor tracking solution. Use this action to list all registered websites with Smart Code tracking, including their IDs, names, and associated domains. #### Output | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | Yes | Data from the action execution | | `error` | string | No | Error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | Yes | Whether or not the action execution was successful or not |

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/SmartCodeSiteUpdateSmartCodeSiteConnector
actions.label: Smart: Code Site Update Smart Code Site
actions.description: Updates an existing Smart Code tracking site in ActiveTrail. Use this action to modify a site's name and domain configuration. Both name and domains must be provided in the update request (the API does not support partial updates).

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/SmsCampaignCreateSmsCampaignConnector
actions.label: Sms: Campaign Create Sms Campaign
actions.description: Tool to create a new SMS campaign in ActiveTrail. Use when you need to send SMS messages to segments of your audience with customizable content, sender name, and scheduling options.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/SmsCampaignGetCampaignClicksConnector
actions.label: Sms: Campaign Get Campaign Clicks
actions.description: Retrieves detailed click-through data for all links in a campaign or optionally for a specific link. Returns comprehensive information including contact details (name, email), click timestamps, device information (browser, OS, device type), and click counts. Default date range: last 3 months from current date. Use this for aggregate click analysis across multiple links; for detailed analysis of a single link, consider using 'Get Click Details by Link ID' action instead. Returns an error if the campaign wasn't sent within the specified date range.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/SmsCampaignGetCampaignOpensConnector
actions.label: Sms: Campaign Get Campaign Opens
actions.description: Tool to retrieve contacts who opened a specific campaign email. Use when you need to identify which recipients opened your campaign, track open rates, and analyze campaign engagement. Default search covers campaigns updated in the last 3 months; if the campaign wasn't sent during the specified date range, an empty list is returned. Supports pagination and filtering by group.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/SmsCampaignGetCampaignSDetailsConnector
actions.label: Sms: Campaign Get Campaign SDetails
actions.description: Tool to retrieve complete campaign information including send settings, design, template, and A/B test configuration. Use when you need comprehensive details about a specific email campaign.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/SmsCampaignGetPushCampaignOpensConnector
actions.label: Sms: Campaign Get Push Campaign Opens
actions.description: Retrieves a list of contacts who opened a specific push notification campaign, including contact details and when they opened the notification. Use this action to: - Track engagement metrics for push campaigns - Identify which recipients interacted with your push notifications - Filter opens by date range, send type, or search for specific contacts Note: The campaign must have been sent within the date range (defaults to last 3 months from current date if not specified). Results are paginated for campaigns with many opens.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/SmsCampaignGetSmsCampaignConnector
actions.label: Sms: Campaign Get Sms Campaign
actions.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about a specific SMS campaign by its unique identifier. Use when you need to fetch campaign details including message content, sender, status, and delivery metrics.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/SmsCampaignGetSmsCampaignClickersConnector
actions.label: Sms: Campaign Get Sms Campaign Clickers
actions.description: Retrieve contacts who clicked links in an SMS campaign with detailed click analytics. Returns contact information (name, email, phone), click timestamps, link details, and click counts. Supports filtering by specific links, date ranges, and contact search. Note: If the SMS was sent using "add numbers manually" instead of groups/mailing lists, you'll receive click counts but mobile numbers may not be available. Default search window is 3 months from today.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/SmsCampaignGetSmsCampaignEstimateConnector
actions.label: Sms: Campaign Get Sms Campaign Estimate
actions.description: Tool to calculate the estimated number of messages for a given SMS campaign. Use when you need to get message count estimates for campaigns that have not been sent yet. Cannot be used for already-sent campaigns.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/SmsCampaignGetSmsCampaignReportsConnector
actions.label: Sms: Campaign Get Sms Campaign Reports
actions.description: Tool to retrieve SMS campaign performance metrics and reports with filtering options. Use when you need to access SMS campaign analytics including sent, delivered, failed, clicks, and engagement statistics. Returns the last 20 campaigns from the last 6 months by default when no date range or filters are specified.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/SmsCampaignGetTransactionalSmsMessageConnector
actions.label: Sms: Campaign Get Transactional Sms Message
actions.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about a specific transactional SMS message by its unique identifier. Use when you need to fetch SMS message content, delivery statistics, and metadata for operational SMS messages.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/SmsCampaignUpdateCampaignConnector
actions.label: Sms: Campaign Update Campaign
actions.description: Tool to update draft campaigns in ActiveTrail. Use when you need to modify campaign properties such as name, subject, content, or design settings. IMPORTANT: Only campaigns in draft mode can be updated - campaigns that have been sent or are scheduled cannot be modified.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/SmsCampaignUpdateSmsOperationalMessageConnector
actions.label: Sms: Campaign Update Sms Operational Message
actions.description: Tool to update an operational SMS transactional message by ID. Use when you need to modify the name, sender, or content of an existing SMS campaign. Important: You cannot update a campaign that has already been sent.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/SmsCampaignReportGetAutomationReportsSmsCampaignSummaryConnector
actions.label: Sms: Campaign Report Get Automation Reports Sms Campaign Summary
actions.description: Tool to retrieve SMS campaigns' summary reports for a specific automation. Use when you need to analyze SMS campaign performance including sent, delivered, failed, credits consumed, unsubscribe, and click metrics within an automation.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/SmsCampaignReportGetAutomationReportsSummaryReportConnector
actions.label: Sms: Campaign Report Get Automation Reports Summary Report
actions.description: Tool to retrieve email campaigns' summary reports for a specific automation. Use when you need to analyze email campaign performance metrics including opens, clicks, click-to-open rate, conversions, bounces, unsubscribes, and spam complaints within an automation for a given date range.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/SmsCampaignReportGetCampaignDomainsReportConnector
actions.label: Sms: Campaign Report Get Campaign Domains Report
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a report by domain for a specific campaign. Use when you need to analyze campaign performance grouped by recipient email domains, including sends, opens, clicks, bounces, and engagement metrics per domain. Defaults to campaigns updated in the last 3 months.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/SmsCampaignReportGetCampaignReportConnector
actions.label: Sms: Campaign Report Get Campaign Report
actions.description: Retrieves comprehensive performance metrics for a specific email campaign by its ID. Returns detailed statistics including send count, open rate, click rate, click-to-open rate (CTO), bounce rate, unsubscribe rate, spam complaints, and conversion data. Use this when you need detailed performance analytics for a single campaign. Default behavior: Returns data for campaigns updated in the last 3 months when date parameters are not specified. Note: Returns an error if the campaign wasn't sent/updated within the specified date range.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/SmsCampaignReportGetPushCampaignReportSummaryConnector
actions.label: Sms: Campaign Report Get Push Campaign Report Summary
actions.description: Tool to retrieve aggregated summary statistics for push notification campaigns filtered by date range. Returns total counts across all campaigns including total sent, opens, clicks, clickers, unsubscribes, failed deliveries, and total devices. Use this when you need overall push campaign performance metrics rather than individual campaign details. Default behavior: Returns aggregate statistics for campaigns from the last 3 months when date parameters are not specified.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/SmsCampaignReportGetSmsCampaignDeliveredConnector
actions.label: Sms: Campaign Report Get Sms Campaign Delivered
actions.description: Tool to retrieve delivery confirmations for a specific SMS campaign. Use when you need to see which contacts successfully received the SMS message. The campaign must be sent in the specified date range (defaults to last 3 months). Note: If SMS was sent using manual number entry instead of a group, only the delivery count is returned without specific mobile numbers.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/SmsCampaignReportGetSmsCampaignReportConnector
actions.label: Sms: Campaign Report Get Sms Campaign Report
actions.description: Tool to retrieve summary report for a specific SMS campaign by ID. Use when you need detailed metrics about an SMS campaign's performance including sent count, delivery rate, clicks, and errors.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/SmsCampaignReportGetSmsCampaignReportClicksConnector
actions.label: Sms: Campaign Report Get Sms Campaign Report Clicks
actions.description: Tool to retrieve detailed click event data for links in SMS campaigns. Returns individual click records (not unique clickers) with contact information, timestamps, link details, and device/browser information. Use when you need granular click-level analytics for SMS campaign links. Note: By default, searches for clicks within the last 3 months. If the campaign wasn't sent in the specified date range, no data will be returned. If SMS recipients were added manually (not from a group), you may get click counts but not all contact details.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/SmsCampaignReportGetSmsCampaignReportFailedConnector
actions.label: Sms: Campaign Report Get Sms Campaign Report Failed
actions.description: Tool to retrieve the failed delivery report for a specific SMS campaign. Use when you need to see which contacts experienced delivery failures and why. The campaign must be sent in the specified date range (defaults to last 3 months). Note: If SMS was sent using manual number entry instead of a group, only the failure count is returned without specific mobile numbers.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/SmsCampaignReportGetSmsCampaignReportSentConnector
actions.label: Sms: Campaign Report Get Sms Campaign Report Sent
actions.description: Tool to retrieve all contacts that an SMS campaign was sent to. Use when you need to see the list of recipients for a specific SMS campaign. The campaign must be sent in the specified date range (defaults to last 3 months). Note: If SMS was sent using manual number entry instead of a group, only the contact count is returned without specific mobile numbers.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/SmsCampaignReportGetSmsCampaignReportSummaryConnector
actions.label: Sms: Campaign Report Get Sms Campaign Report Summary
actions.description: Retrieve aggregate summary metrics for SMS campaigns across a filtered date range. Returns total counts for sent messages, failed deliveries, clicks, unique clicks, unsubscribes, and credits consumed. Use this to get high-level performance statistics across all SMS campaigns in a given period. Default behavior: Returns aggregate metrics for the last 3 months when date parameters are not specified.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/SmsCampaignReportGetSmsCampaignReportUnsubscribedConnector
actions.label: Sms: Campaign Report Get Sms Campaign Report Unsubscribed
actions.description: Tool to retrieve contacts who unsubscribed from a specific SMS campaign. Use when you need to identify recipients who opted out of receiving future SMS messages. Note: For manually added numbers, only the count is returned, not individual phone numbers. Default search range is last 3 months; if campaign wasn't sent in the given range, no information will be returned.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/TemplatesDeleteTemplateConnector
actions.label: Templates: Delete Template
actions.description: Tool to remove a template from ActiveTrail account. Use when you need to delete a template that is no longer needed.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/TemplatesDeleteTemplatesTemplateCategoryConnector
actions.label: Templates: Delete Templates Template Category
actions.description: Tool to delete a template category by ID. Use when you need to remove a template category. Warning: Deleting a category will cascade-delete all templates within that category.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/TemplatesGetTemplateContentConnector
actions.label: Templates: Get Template Content
actions.description: Tool to retrieve HTML content of a specific template. Use when you need to get the HTML markup or design content of a template by its ID.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/TemplatesGetTemplatesConnector
actions.label: Templates: Get Templates
actions.description: Tool to retrieve saved templates from the ActiveTrail account. Use when you need to list all templates or search for templates by name. Supports pagination and filtering.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/TemplatesGetTemplatesTemplateCategoryConnector
actions.label: Templates: Get Templates Template Category
actions.description: Tool to retrieve all template categories from 'my templates' section. Use when you need to get the list of categories for organizing email templates. #### Output | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | Yes | Data from the action execution | | `error` | string | No | Error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | Yes | Whether or not the action execution was successful or not |

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/TemplatesPostTemplatesCampaignConnector
actions.label: Templates: Post Templates Campaign
actions.description: Creates a new email campaign from an existing template. The campaign will be created in draft status. Prerequisites: - A valid template ID (obtain from 'Get Templates' action) - A valid sending profile ID (obtain from 'Get Sending Profiles' action) Use this when you need to quickly create a campaign using a pre-designed template rather than building from scratch.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/TemplatesPostTemplatesTemplateCategoryConnector
actions.label: Templates: Post Templates Template Category
actions.description: Tool to create a new template category in ActiveTrail. Use when you need to add a new category for organizing email templates.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/TemplatesUpdateTemplateConnector
actions.label: Templates: Update Template
actions.description: Tool to update an existing email template in ActiveTrail account. Use this action to modify template properties including: - Template name and subject line - HTML content/body - Editor type and display settings - Template categorization - Character encoding settings All fields except 'id' are optional - only provide the fields you want to update. The template will be updated with the new values while preserving any fields not specified. Note: To update only the HTML content of a template, consider using the 'Update Template Content' action instead.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/TemplatesUpdateTemplateCategoryConnector
actions.label: Templates: Update Template Category
actions.description: Tool to update an existing template category in ActiveTrail. Use when you need to modify the name of a template category used for organizing email templates.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/TemplatesUpdateTemplateContentConnector
actions.label: Templates: Update Template Content
actions.description: Tool to update the HTML content of an email template in ActiveTrail. Use when you need to modify the design or layout of an existing template.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/UserSocialGetUserSocialAccountsGetConnector
actions.label: User: Social Get User Social Accounts Get
actions.description: Retrieve social media accounts (Facebook, Instagram, etc.) connected to the ActiveTrail account. Returns a list of connected social media accounts with details like platform, username, status, and connection date. Note: Social media integration is only available for ActiveTrail Plus plan customers. #### Output | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | Yes | Data from the action execution | | `error` | string | No | Error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | Yes | Whether or not the action execution was successful or not |

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/WebhooksCreateWebhookConnector
actions.label: Webhooks: Create Webhook
actions.description: Create a new webhook for event notifications in ActiveTrail. Webhooks enable real-time notifications for events like contact changes or campaign activities. After creating the webhook, use the 'Update Webhook Parameter' action to add custom parameters (headers, query params, body data) if needed.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/WebhooksDeleteWebhookConnector
actions.label: Webhooks: Delete Webhook
actions.description: Tool to remove a webhook from ActiveTrail account by its ID. Use when you need to delete a webhook that is no longer needed.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/WebhooksDeleteWebhooksParametersConnector
actions.label: Webhooks: Delete Webhooks Parameters
actions.description: Removes a specific parameter from a webhook configuration in ActiveTrail. Use this when you need to delete custom headers, query parameters, or body parameters that were previously added to a webhook. Requires both the webhook ID and the specific parameter ID to delete.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/WebhooksGetWebhookConnector
actions.label: Webhooks: Get Webhook
actions.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about a specific webhook by its unique identifier. Use when you need to fetch complete webhook configuration including event type, target URL, state, and associated parameters.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/WebhooksGetWebhooksConnector
actions.label: Webhooks: Get Webhooks
actions.description: Tool to list account webhooks with optional filtering. Use when you need to retrieve webhooks configured for the ActiveTrail account with filtering by event type, state, or target type.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/WebhooksGetWebhooksParametersConnector
actions.label: Webhooks: Get Webhooks Parameters
actions.description: Retrieves custom parameters configured for a specific webhook. Parameters define additional data (headers, query parameters, or body fields) that ActiveTrail includes when calling the webhook URL. Use this to inspect webhook configuration details including parameter keys, values, types, and dynamic field mappings.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/WebhooksPostWebhooksParametersConnector
actions.label: Webhooks: Post Webhooks Parameters
actions.description: Tool to add a new parameter to an existing webhook in your ActiveTrail account. Use when you need to configure additional parameters for webhook events, such as authentication headers, custom query parameters, or body fields. Each parameter can have either a static value or dynamically pull from contact fields.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/WebhooksPostWebhooksTest2Connector
actions.label: Webhooks: Post Webhooks Test2
actions.description: Tool to send a test webhook request with configurable URL and parameters. Use when you need to validate webhook configurations by sending a test request to a specified URL with custom event types, parameters, and target types.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/WebhooksTestWebhookConnector
actions.label: Webhooks: Test Webhook
actions.description: Send a test request to a configured webhook to verify it's working correctly. This action triggers a test event for the specified webhook without waiting for actual events to occur. Use this to validate that the webhook URL is reachable, properly configured, and able to receive notifications from ActiveTrail. The webhook must already exist in your ActiveTrail account.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/WebhooksUpdateWebhookConnector
actions.label: Webhooks: Update Webhook
actions.description: Tool to update an existing webhook configuration in ActiveTrail. Use when you need to modify webhook properties such as name, URL, event type, format, or active status.

actions.name: Corsair/Activetrail/WebhooksUpdateWebhookParameterConnector
actions.label: Webhooks: Update Webhook Parameter
actions.description: Tool to update an existing webhook parameter in your ActiveTrail account. Use when you need to modify parameter properties such as key, value, type, or field mappings for webhook events.

actions.name: Corsair/Addresszen/AutocompleteAddressesConnector
actions.label: Autocomplete: Addresses
actions.description: Get address autocomplete suggestions for a partial address query

actions.name: Corsair/Addresszen/VerifyAddressConnector
actions.label: Verify: Address
actions.description: Verify and standardize a US address using USPS CASS validation

actions.name: Corsair/Addresszen/KeyAvailabilityConnector
actions.label: Key: Availability
actions.description: Get public information on an API key, including whether it is currently usable

actions.name: Corsair/Addresszen/ResolveAddressUsaConnector
actions.label: Resolve: Address Usa
actions.description: Resolve an address autocompletion by its address ID and return the full address in US format

actions.name: Corsair/Aeroleads/LinkedinDetailsGetConnector
actions.label: Linkedin: Details Get
actions.description: Retrieve detailed information about a prospect using their LinkedIn profile URL, including emails, phone numbers, job details, and company data

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/AnnotationsBatchUpdateAnnotationsConnector
actions.label: Annotations: Batch Update Annotations
actions.description: Batch update multiple document annotations in a single API call. Use this action to efficiently update parsed values or other fields across many annotations at once, rather than making individual update requests for each annotation. Prerequisites: - Obtain annotation IDs using the 'Get Annotations' action with a document filter - Annotations must exist in documents that have been processed by Affinda Common use cases: - Correcting OCR/extraction errors in bulk - Updating parsed values after manual review - Modifying annotation data programmatically

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/AnnotationsCreateBatchAnnotationsConnector
actions.label: Annotations: Create Batch Annotations
actions.description: Batch create multiple document annotations in a single API call. Use this action to efficiently create multiple annotations at once for documents that have been processed by Affinda. This is useful for programmatically adding structured data to documents or importing annotation data from external sources. Prerequisites: - Documents must be created first using 'Create Document' action - Obtain document identifiers from 'Create Document' or 'Get Documents' actions - Know the data point identifiers for your collection (from extractor configuration) Common use cases: - Importing annotation data from external systems - Programmatically adding structured data to documents - Creating annotations for validation or training purposes

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/AnnotationsDeleteAnnotationsBatchConnector
actions.label: Annotations: Delete Annotations Batch
actions.description: Batch delete multiple document annotations in a single API call. Use this action to efficiently remove multiple annotations at once rather than making individual delete requests for each annotation. Prerequisites: - Obtain annotation IDs using the 'Get Annotations' action with a document filter - Annotations must exist in documents that have been processed by Affinda Common use cases: - Removing incorrect or unwanted annotations in bulk - Cleaning up annotations after document reprocessing - Deleting specific extracted data fields programmatically

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/AnnotationsGetAnnotationsConnector
actions.label: Annotations: Get Annotations
actions.description: Retrieves all annotations for a specific document. Annotations are extracted data fields (text, dates, numbers, tables, etc.) from parsed documents. Use this after a document has been processed to access the extracted data.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/AnnotationsUpdateAnnotationConnector
actions.label: Annotations: Update Annotation
actions.description: Tool to update data of a single annotation in Affinda. Use when you need to correct extracted values, verify annotations, or modify annotation metadata after document processing. Prerequisites: - Obtain the annotation ID using the 'Get Annotations' action with a document filter - Annotations must exist in documents that have been processed by Affinda Common use cases: - Correcting OCR or extraction errors in individual fields - Marking annotations as verified after manual review (set isClientVerified=true) - Updating parsed values to fix incorrect data extraction - Modifying annotation coordinates or page references Note: For bulk updates across multiple annotations, use the 'Batch Update Annotations' action instead for better efficiency.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/ApiUsersCreateApiUserConnector
actions.label: Api: Users Create Api User
actions.description: Tool to create a new API user within an organization. Use when you need to generate a new API user with authentication credentials for programmatic access to Affinda services.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/ApiUsersGetAllApiUsersConnector
actions.label: Api: Users Get All Api Users
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all API users. Use when you need to list API users, optionally filtered by organization.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/CollectionsCreateCollectionConnector
actions.label: Collections: Create Collection
actions.description: Tool to create a new collection. Use after you have a valid workspace ID and want to group documents by a specific extractor within that workspace.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/CollectionsCreateDataFieldForCollectionConnector
actions.label: Collections: Create Data Field For Collection
actions.description: Tool to create a data field for a collection along with a new data point. Use when you need to add a custom field to a collection for document processing and validation.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/CollectionsDeleteCollectionConnector
actions.label: Collections: Delete Collection
actions.description: Permanently delete a collection from Affinda by its identifier. This is a destructive operation that cannot be undone. Use Get Collections first to verify the collection ID before deletion. Note: Documents in the collection may also be affected.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/CollectionsGetCollectionConnector
actions.label: Collections: Get Collection
actions.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific collection by its ID. Use when you need full metadata about a collection after confirming its identifier.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/CollectionsGetCollectionFieldsConnector
actions.label: Collections: Get Collection Fields
actions.description: Tool to retrieve data field configuration for a collection associated with a data point. Use when you need to understand the structure and validation rules of a specific field in a collection. Note: This endpoint is deprecated.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/CollectionsGetCollectionsConnector
actions.label: Collections: Get Collections
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all collections. Use when you need to list collections in your Affinda workspace after authentication.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/CollectionsGetCollectionUsageConnector
actions.label: Collections: Get Collection Usage
actions.description: Retrieves monthly credits consumption statistics for a specific collection. Returns a list of usage records showing how many credits were consumed each month. Use this to track collection activity, monitor consumption trends, or generate usage reports. Note: This endpoint is deprecated.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/CollectionsUpdateCollectionConnector
actions.label: Collections: Update Collection
actions.description: Tool to update specific fields of a collection. Use when you need to rename or reassign a collection after creation.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/CollectionsUpdateDataFieldForCollectionConnector
actions.label: Collections: Update Data Field For Collection
actions.description: Tool to update a data field configuration for a collection's data point. Use when you need to modify field properties such as label, type, mandatory status, or validation settings after the field has been created.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/DataPointChoicesCreateDataPointChoiceConnector
actions.label: Data: Point Choices Create Data Point Choice
actions.description: Tool to create a custom data point choice. Use when you need to add a new choice option for a specific data point in a collection or organization. Note: This endpoint is deprecated but still functional.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/DataPointChoicesGetDataPointChoiceConnector
actions.label: Data: Point Choices Get Data Point Choice
actions.description: Tool to return a specific data point choice by its ID. Use when you need details about a particular data point choice option. Note: This endpoint is deprecated but still functional.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/DataPointChoicesListDataPointChoicesConnector
actions.label: Data: Point Choices List Data Point Choices
actions.description: Tool to retrieve available choices for a specific enum data point. Use when you need to discover valid options for dropdown/enum fields in a collection's data schema. Note: This endpoint is deprecated but still functional for accessing data point choice metadata.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/DataPointChoicesReplaceDataPointChoicesConnector
actions.label: Data: Point Choices Replace Data Point Choices
actions.description: Tool to completely replace all choices for a data point. Use when you need to bulk update enum options - existing choices are matched by value, new values are created, updated values are modified, and values not in the incoming list are deleted. Note: This is a deprecated endpoint but still functional. Either collection or organization must be specified to scope the replacement.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/DataPointChoicesUpdateDataPointChoiceConnector
actions.label: Data: Point Choices Update Data Point Choice
actions.description: Tool to update data of a data point choice by its ID. Use when you need to modify label, value, description, synonyms, or associated collection/organization for an existing data point choice. Note: This endpoint is deprecated but still functional.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/DataPointsCreateDataPointConnector
actions.label: Data: Points Create Data Point
actions.description: Tool to create a custom data point for document extraction. Use when you need to define a new field that should be extracted from documents in a specific extractor. Note: This endpoint is deprecated but still functional. Data points define custom fields for extraction models.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/DataPointsDeleteDataPointConnector
actions.label: Data: Points Delete Data Point
actions.description: Tool to permanently delete a data point by its identifier. Use when you need to remove a data point from the database after confirming the identifier. Note: This endpoint is deprecated but still functional.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/DataPointsGetDataPointConnector
actions.label: Data: Points Get Data Point
actions.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific data point by its identifier. Use when you need to inspect a data point's configuration, type, or structure. Data points represent individual fields that can be extracted from documents (e.g., 'name', 'email', 'date'). This endpoint is deprecated but still functional for retrieving data point metadata.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/DataPointsListDataPointsConnector
actions.label: Data: Points List Data Points
actions.description: Tool to retrieve all data points. Returns both custom data points and Affinda's off-the-shelf data points. Use when you need to list available data points for extractors.
