actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/DataPointsUpdateDataPointConnector
actions.label: Data: Points Update Data Point
actions.description: Tool to update data of a data point by its identifier. Use when you need to modify a data point's name, description, slug, parent, or mapping data source. Note: This endpoint is deprecated but still functional.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/DataSourcesCreateDataSourceConnector
actions.label: Data: Sources Create Data Source
actions.description: Tool to create a custom mapping data source. Use when you need to set up a new data source for mapping AI-extracted values to your database records.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/DataSourcesCreateDataSourceValueConnector
actions.label: Data: Sources Create Data Source Value
actions.description: Tool to add a new value to a mapping data source. Use when you need to add entries to a data source for mapping or validation purposes. The created value can then be referenced in document extraction and mapping workflows.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/DataSourcesDeleteDataSourceConnector
actions.label: Data: Sources Delete Data Source
actions.description: Permanently delete a mapping data source from the database by its identifier. This is a destructive operation that cannot be undone. Use when you need to remove a data source that is no longer needed or was created in error.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/DataSourcesDeleteDataSourceValueConnector
actions.label: Data: Sources Delete Data Source Value
actions.description: Tool to delete a specific value from a mapping data source. Use when you need to remove an incorrect or outdated value from a data source mapping.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/DataSourcesGetDataSourceConnector
actions.label: Data: Sources Get Data Source
actions.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific mapping data source by its identifier. Use when you need to fetch mapping data source metadata and schema configuration.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/DataSourcesGetDataSourceValueConnector
actions.label: Data: Sources Get Data Source Value
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a specific value from a mapping data source. Use when you need to get details about a particular value in a data source.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/DataSourcesGetDataSourceValuesConnector
actions.label: Data: Sources Get Data Source Values
actions.description: Tool to retrieve all values from a mapping data source. Use when you need to list or search values in a specific data source after authentication.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/DataSourcesListDataSourcesConnector
actions.label: Data: Sources List Data Sources
actions.description: Tool to retrieve the list of all custom mapping data sources. Use when you need to list or search for mapping data sources in your Affinda workspace.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/DataSourcesReplaceDataSourceValuesConnector
actions.label: Data: Sources Replace Data Source Values
actions.description: Tool to completely replace all values in a mapping data source. Use when you need to bulk update or refresh an entire data source's value list. Note: For large data sources (>1000 values), new values may take a few minutes to become searchable after the operation completes.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/DataSourcesUpdateDataSourceValueConnector
actions.label: Data: Sources Update Data Source Value
actions.description: Tool to update an existing value in a mapping data source. Use when you need to modify the label or description of an existing data source value. The value identifier itself cannot be changed.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/DocumentSplittersGetAllDocumentSplittersConnector
actions.label: Document: Splitters Get All Document Splitters
actions.description: Tool to get a list of all document splitters. Use when you need to retrieve document splitters, optionally filtered by organization.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/DocumentSplittersGetDocumentSplitterConnector
actions.label: Document: Splitters Get Document Splitter
actions.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific document splitter by its identifier. Use when you need to fetch metadata about a document splitter configuration.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/DocumentTypesCreateDocumentTypeConnector
actions.label: Document: Types Create Document Type
actions.description: Tool to create a new document type in the specified organization. Use when you need to define a new category of documents for processing. Document types allow you to organize and categorize documents within an organization.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/DocumentTypesDeleteDocumentTypeConnector
actions.label: Document: Types Delete Document Type
actions.description: Tool to permanently delete a document type by its identifier. Use when you need to remove a document type that is no longer needed. This is a destructive operation that cannot be undone.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/DocumentTypesGetDocumentTypeConnector
actions.label: Document: Types Get Document Type
actions.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific document type by its ID. Use when you need to confirm the configuration or metadata of a document type before processing documents.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/DocumentTypesGetDocumentTypeJsonSchemaConnector
actions.label: Document: Types Get Document Type Json Schema
actions.description: Tool to generate a JSON schema from a document type by its identifier. Use when you need the structured schema definition for a document type to understand its field structure and validation rules.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/DocumentTypesGetDocumentTypePydanticModelsConnector
actions.label: Document: Types Get Document Type Pydantic Models
actions.description: Tool to generate Pydantic model code from a document type's schema. Use when you need type-safe Python models for parsing documents of a specific type.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/DocumentTypesGetDocumentTypesConnector
actions.label: Document: Types Get Document Types
actions.description: Retrieve all document types accessible to the authenticated user. Returns a list containing each document type's identifier, name, description, ingest email, and organization. Use this to discover available document types before uploading or processing documents. #### Output | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | Yes | Data from the action execution | | `error` | string | No | Error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | Yes | Whether or not the action execution was successful or not |

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/DocumentTypesUpdateDocumentTypeConnector
actions.label: Document: Types Update Document Type
actions.description: Tool to update a document type by its identifier. Use when you need to modify the name or description of an existing document type.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/DocumentsAddTagToDocumentsConnector
actions.label: Documents: Add Tag To Documents
actions.description: Tool to add a tag to multiple documents in a single operation. Use when you need to organize or categorize multiple documents by assigning them a shared tag. Tags enable efficient filtering and grouping of documents in your workspace.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/DocumentsCreateDocumentConnector
actions.label: Documents: Create Document
actions.description: Upload a document to Affinda for parsing and data extraction. Use this action when you need to: - Parse resumes/CVs to extract candidate information - Process invoices to extract line items, amounts, and vendor details - Extract data from any supported document type (PDF, DOCX, images) You can upload either a file directly or provide a publicly accessible URL. The document will be processed by Affinda's AI extraction engine. Prerequisites: - For collection-based uploads: Get collection ID from get_collections action - For workspace-specific uploads: Get workspace ID from get_workspaces action

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/DocumentsCreateFromDataDocumentsConnector
actions.label: Documents: Create From Data Documents
actions.description: Create a document from structured resume or job description data for Search & Match. Use this when you have structured data to create a document programmatically without file uploads. Returns an identifier for subsequent status checks via /documents/{identifier}.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/DocumentsDeleteDocumentConnector
actions.label: Documents: Delete Document
actions.description: Tool to delete a specific document by its ID. Use when you need to remove a document that is incorrect or no longer needed, after confirming the document ID.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/DocumentsGetDocumentConnector
actions.label: Documents: Get Document
actions.description: Retrieve full details and parsed data for a specific document by its identifier. Use this tool to get comprehensive information about a document including: - Processing status (ready/failed) - Document metadata (file name, page count, language) - Parsed/extracted data results - URLs for PDF, original file, and review page - Collection and workspace information The document identifier can be either a system-generated ID or a custom identifier set during document upload.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/DocumentsGetDocumentRedactedConnector
actions.label: Documents: Get Document Redacted
actions.description: Tool to retrieve the redacted version of a document as a PDF file. Use when you need to get a document with sensitive information removed. The original document is not modified by this operation.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/DocumentsGetDocumentsConnector
actions.label: Documents: Get Documents
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all documents. Use when you need to list documents in your Affinda workspace after authentication.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/DocumentsRemoveTagFromDocumentsConnector
actions.label: Documents: Remove Tag From Documents
actions.description: Remove a tag from multiple documents in a single batch operation. Use this action to efficiently untag many documents at once rather than making individual remove requests. The operation is idempotent - removing a tag that isn't present on a document will not cause an error.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/DocumentsUpdateDocumentConnector
actions.label: Documents: Update Document
actions.description: Tool to update specific fields of a document. Use when you need to rename, reassign, or adjust expiry and storage settings after document creation.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/DocumentsUpdateDocumentDataConnector
actions.label: Documents: Update Document Data
actions.description: Update parsed data for a resume or job description document in Affinda. This endpoint is ONLY applicable for documents that have been processed with 'resume' or 'job-description' extractors. For other document types, use the batch_update_annotations endpoint instead. Use this tool when you need to correct or add parsed fields to an existing resume or job description document after it has been uploaded and processed.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/ExtractorsCreateExtractorConnector
actions.label: Extractors: Create Extractor
actions.description: Tool to create a new extractor. Use when you need to define a custom document parser with specific fields and extraction rules, typically derived from a base extractor.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/ExtractorsDeleteExtractorConnector
actions.label: Extractors: Delete Extractor
actions.description: Permanently delete an extractor from Affinda by its identifier. This is a destructive operation that cannot be undone. Use Get Extractors first to verify the extractor ID before deletion. Note: This action is deprecated by the API.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/ExtractorsGetExtractorConnector
actions.label: Extractors: Get Extractor
actions.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about a specific extractor by its identifier. Use when you need complete metadata about an extractor's configuration, fields, and capabilities.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/ExtractorsGetExtractorsConnector
actions.label: Extractors: Get Extractors
actions.description: Retrieve all extractors available for an organization. Extractors are document parsing configurations that define what data to extract from documents. This includes both Affinda's built-in extractors (resumes, invoices, etc.) and any custom extractors created for the organization. Use this action to: - List available extractors before creating a collection - Find the identifier of a specific extractor type - Check if custom extractors exist for the organization

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/ExtractorsUpdateExtractorConnector
actions.label: Extractors: Update Extractor
actions.description: Tool to update specific fields of an extractor. Use when you need to modify an extractor's name, category, validation settings, or field groups after creation.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/IndexesCreateIndexConnector
actions.label: Indexes: Create Index
actions.description: Tool to create a new index for search and match functionality. Use when you need to set up a new index for organizing and searching documents like resumes or job descriptions.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/IndexesDeleteIndexConnector
actions.label: Indexes: Delete Index
actions.description: Tool to permanently delete an index from Affinda by its name. Use when you need to remove an index that is no longer needed. This is a destructive operation that cannot be undone.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/IndexesGetIndexDocumentsConnector
actions.label: Indexes: Get Index Documents
actions.description: Tool to retrieve all indexed documents for a specific index. Use when you need to list documents in a search index after creating or accessing an index.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/IndexesListIndexesConnector
actions.label: Indexes: List Indexes
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all search indexes. Use when you need to view available indexes for searching and matching documents in Affinda.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/IndexesUpdateIndexConnector
actions.label: Indexes: Update Index
actions.description: Tool to update the name of an existing search index. Use when you need to rename an index after creation.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/InvitationsCreateInvitationConnector
actions.label: Invitations: Create Invitation
actions.description: Tool to create a new organization invitation. Use when you need to invite a user to join an organization with a specific role.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/InvitationsDeleteInvitationConnector
actions.label: Invitations: Delete Invitation
actions.description: Tool to delete an invitation by its identifier. Use when you need to remove or revoke an invitation after confirming the invitation identifier.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/InvitationsGetAllInvitationsConnector
actions.label: Invitations: Get All Invitations
actions.description: Tool to retrieve all invitations you created or sent to you. Use when you need to list organization invitations with optional filtering by status, role, or organization.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/InvitationsGetInvitationConnector
actions.label: Invitations: Get Invitation
actions.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific organization invitation by its identifier. Use when you need to check invitation status or get invitation metadata.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/InvitationsUpdateInvitationConnector
actions.label: Invitations: Update Invitation
actions.description: Tool to update an organization invitation's role. Use when you need to change the role assigned to an invitation before it is accepted.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/JobDescriptionSearchCreateJobDescriptionSearchConnector
actions.label: Job: Description Search Create Job Description Search
actions.description: Search through parsed job descriptions using custom criteria or resume matching. Use this action when you need to find job postings that match specific requirements such as skills, experience, location, education, or to find jobs matching a candidate's resume. Returns ranked results with detailed match scores.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/JobDescriptionSearchCreateJobDescriptionSearchEmbedUrlConnector
actions.label: Job: Description Search Create Job Description Search Embed Url
actions.description: Tool to create and return a signed URL for the embeddable job description search tool. Use this when you need to generate a URL that can be embedded on a web page to provide job description search functionality. Optionally pass config_override to customize display settings, field weights, and theme.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/JobDescriptionSearchGetJobDescriptionSearchConfigConnector
actions.label: Job: Description Search Get Job Description Search Config
actions.description: Tool to get the configuration for the logged in user's embeddable job description search tool. Returns display settings, field weights, and maximum results limits. #### Output | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | Yes | Data from the action execution | | `error` | string | No | Error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | Yes | Whether or not the action execution was successful or not |

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/JobDescriptionSearchUpdateJobDescriptionSearchConfigConnector
actions.label: Job: Description Search Update Job Description Search Config
actions.description: Tool to update the configuration for the logged in user's embeddable job description search tool. Use to configure display fields, field weights, maximum results, and UI customization options.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/MappingsCreateMappingConnector
actions.label: Mappings: Create Mapping
actions.description: Tool to create a custom mapping for a data source. Use when you need to configure specific lookup settings for a MappingDataSource. Note: This endpoint is deprecated.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/MappingsDeleteMappingConnector
actions.label: Mappings: Delete Mapping
actions.description: Tool to delete a specific mapping by its identifier. Use when you need to remove an unused or incorrect mapping from the database. Note: This endpoint is deprecated.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/MappingsGetMappingConnector
actions.label: Mappings: Get Mapping
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a specific mapping by its identifier. Use when you need to fetch mapping configuration details for a lookup against a MappingDataSource.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/MappingsListMappingsConnector
actions.label: Mappings: List Mappings
actions.description: Tool to retrieve the list of all custom data mappings. Use when you need to list mappings for a specific data source.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/MappingsUpdateMappingConnector
actions.label: Mappings: Update Mapping
actions.description: Tool to update a specific mapping's settings. Use when you need to adjust score cutoff or ordering for a lookup against a MappingDataSource.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/OccupationGroupsListOccupationGroupsConnector
actions.label: Occupation: Groups List Occupation Groups
actions.description: Tool to retrieve the list of searchable occupation groups. Use when you need to get available occupation categories for job matching or classification. #### Output | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | Yes | Data from the action execution | | `error` | string | No | Error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | Yes | Whether or not the action execution was successful or not |

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/OrganizationMembershipsGetAllOrganizationMembershipsConnector
actions.label: Organization: Memberships Get All Organization Memberships
actions.description: Retrieve all organization memberships across the account. Returns paginated results showing which users belong to which organizations. Use to audit organization access or find specific user memberships.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/OrganizationMembershipsGetOrganizationMembershipConnector
actions.label: Organization: Memberships Get Organization Membership
actions.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific organization membership by its ID. Use when you need to confirm a user's role and details within an organization.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/OrganizationMembershipsUpdateOrganizationMembershipConnector
actions.label: Organization: Memberships Update Organization Membership
actions.description: Tool to update an organization membership's role. Use when you need to change a user's role within an organization.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/OrganizationsCreateOrganizationConnector
actions.label: Organizations: Create Organization
actions.description: Tool to create a new organization. Use when you have a unique organization name and want to group resources under it.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/OrganizationsDeleteOrganizationConnector
actions.label: Organizations: Delete Organization
actions.description: Permanently deletes an organization from Affinda. This action is destructive and cannot be undone. All workspaces, collections, and documents associated with the organization will also be deleted. Use the get_organizations action first to confirm the organization identifier before deletion.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/OrganizationsGetOrganizationConnector
actions.label: Organizations: Get Organization
actions.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific organization by its ID. Use when you need to fetch an organization's metadata after confirming its identifier.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/OrganizationsGetOrganizationsConnector
actions.label: Organizations: Get Organizations
actions.description: Retrieves all organizations accessible to the authenticated user. Returns a list of organizations with details including identifier, name, user role, trial status, and configuration settings. Use the 'identifier' field from the response when calling other organization-related endpoints. #### Output | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | Yes | Data from the action execution | | `error` | string | No | Error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | Yes | Whether or not the action execution was successful or not |

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/OrganizationsUpdateOrganizationConnector
actions.label: Organizations: Update Organization
actions.description: Tool to update specific fields of an organization. Use when you need to modify an organization's name, avatar, or webhook and validation settings after creation.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/ResthooksCreateResthookSubscriptionConnector
actions.label: Resthooks: Create Resthook Subscription
actions.description: Tool to create a new RESTHook subscription. Use after confirming your webhook endpoint is ready to receive document event notifications.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/ResthooksDeleteResthookSubscriptionConnector
actions.label: Resthooks: Delete Resthook Subscription
actions.description: Tool to delete a specific resthook subscription by ID. Use after confirming the subscription identifier when the webhook is no longer needed.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/ResthooksGetResthookSubscriptionConnector
actions.label: Resthooks: Get Resthook Subscription
actions.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific resthook subscription by its ID. Use after confirming its creation to verify its settings.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/ResthooksGetResthookSubscriptionsConnector
actions.label: Resthooks: Get Resthook Subscriptions
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all RESTHook subscriptions. Use after authenticating to list all webhook subscriptions associated with your account.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/ResthooksUpdateResthookSubscriptionConnector
actions.label: Resthooks: Update Resthook Subscription
actions.description: Tool to update an existing RESTHook subscription. Use after confirming the subscription identifier to modify its URL, event, or activation status.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/ResumeSearchCreateResumeSearchConnector
actions.label: Resume: Search Create Resume Search
actions.description: Tool to search through parsed resumes using three methods: match to a job description, match to a resume, or custom criteria. Use when you need to find candidates matching specific requirements.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/ResumeSearchCreateResumeSearchEmbedUrlConnector
actions.label: Resume: Search Create Resume Search Embed Url
actions.description: Tool to create and return a signed URL for the embeddable resume search tool. Use this when you need to generate a URL that can be embedded on a web page to provide resume search functionality. Optionally pass config_override to customize display settings, field weights, and theme.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/ResumeSearchListResumeSearchConfigConnector
actions.label: Resume: Search List Resume Search Config
actions.description: Tool to get the configuration for the logged in user's embeddable resume search tool. Use this to retrieve display field settings, search weights, maximum results, and theme customization options for the resume search interface. #### Output | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | Yes | Data from the action execution | | `error` | string | No | Error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | Yes | Whether or not the action execution was successful or not |

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/ResumeSearchListResumeSearchJobTitleSuggestionsConnector
actions.label: Resume: Search List Resume Search Job Title Suggestions
actions.description: Tool to get job title suggestions based on provided job title(s). Use when you need to find related job titles for resume search.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/ResumeSearchListResumeSearchSkillSuggestionsConnector
actions.label: Resume: Search List Resume Search Skill Suggestions
actions.description: Tool to get skill suggestions based on provided skills. Use when you need to find related skills to expand or refine resume search queries.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/ResumeSearchUpdateResumeSearchConfigConnector
actions.label: Resume: Search Update Resume Search Config
actions.description: Tool to update the configuration for the logged in user's embeddable resume search tool. Use this to modify which fields are displayed, their search weights, maximum results limit, distance units, custom actions, and theme settings.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/TagsCreateTagConnector
actions.label: Tags: Create Tag
actions.description: Creates a new tag in the specified workspace. Tags can be used to categorize and label documents for organization and filtering. Each tag name must be unique within its workspace. Returns the created tag with its ID and metadata.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/TagsDeleteTagConnector
actions.label: Tags: Delete Tag
actions.description: Permanently delete a tag from Affinda by its ID. This is a destructive operation that cannot be undone. Use Get Tags first to verify the tag ID before deletion.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/TagsGetAllTagsConnector
actions.label: Tags: Get All Tags
actions.description: Tool to list all tags. Use after confirming authentication to fetch tags across workspaces.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/TagsGetTagConnector
actions.label: Tags: Get Tag
actions.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific tag by its ID. Use when you need to fetch information about a particular tag.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/TagsUpdateTagConnector
actions.label: Tags: Update Tag
actions.description: Tool to update data of a tag. Use when you need to modify a tag's name or reassign it to a different workspace. Only provide the fields you want to change; other fields will remain unchanged.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/ValidationSplitDocumentPagesConnector
actions.label: Validation: Split Document Pages
actions.description: Split a document into multiple documents by dividing its pages. Use when you need to separate a multi-page document into distinct documents based on page groupings. Prerequisites: - Obtain the document identifier from create_document or get_document actions - Use get_document to retrieve page IDs for the pages you want to split Important notes: - Each page can only be assigned to one split - All pages should be accounted for across all splits - One split can optionally use the original document identifier to maintain the root document

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/ValidationResultsCreateValidationResultConnector
actions.label: Validation: Results Create Validation Result
actions.description: Create a validation result for document annotations in Affinda. Use this tool to record validation outcomes after parsing a document. Validation results track whether specific annotations (extracted data fields) pass or fail business rules. Prerequisites: 1. Get a document identifier from Get Documents or Create Document 2. Get annotation IDs from Get Annotations for that document 3. Define a kebab-case rule slug that identifies your validation rule Example use cases: - Recording that an invoice total matches the sum of line items - Marking that a required field is present and valid - Logging validation failures for review workflows

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/ValidationResultsCreateValidationResultsBatchConnector
actions.label: Validation: Results Create Validation Results Batch
actions.description: Batch create multiple validation results for document annotations in a single API call. Use this action to efficiently record validation outcomes for multiple documents or rules at once, rather than making individual create requests for each validation result. This is particularly useful for bulk validation workflows or when validating multiple rules across many documents. Prerequisites: - Obtain document identifiers from Get Documents or Create Document actions - Get annotation IDs from Get Annotations for those documents - Define kebab-case rule slugs that identify your validation rules Common use cases: - Bulk recording of validation results across multiple documents - Validating multiple business rules on the same document - Automated validation workflows for large document batches

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/ValidationResultsDeleteValidationResultsConnector
actions.label: Validation: Results Delete Validation Results
actions.description: Delete multiple validation results in a single API call. Use this action to efficiently remove multiple validation results at once rather than making individual delete requests for each validation result. Prerequisites: - Obtain validation result IDs using the 'Get All Validation Results' action Common use cases: - Removing obsolete validation results in bulk - Cleaning up validation results after reprocessing documents - Deleting validation results for specific documents programmatically

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/ValidationResultsGetAllValidationResultsConnector
actions.label: Validation: Results Get All Validation Results
actions.description: Tool to list validation results for documents. Use after processing documents to inspect validation outcomes.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/WorkspaceMembershipsCreateWorkspaceMembershipConnector
actions.label: Workspace: Memberships Create Workspace Membership
actions.description: Tool to add a user to a workspace by creating a membership. Use when you need to grant a user access to a specific workspace.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/WorkspaceMembershipsDeleteWorkspaceMembershipConnector
actions.label: Workspace: Memberships Delete Workspace Membership
actions.description: Tool to remove a user from a workspace by membership ID. Use after confirming the workspace membership ID to revoke access.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/WorkspaceMembershipsGetAllWorkspaceMembershipsConnector
actions.label: Workspace: Memberships Get All Workspace Memberships
actions.description: Retrieve all workspace memberships across the account. Returns paginated results showing which users belong to which workspaces. Use to audit workspace access or find specific user memberships.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/WorkspaceMembershipsGetWorkspaceMembershipConnector
actions.label: Workspace: Memberships Get Workspace Membership
actions.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific workspace membership by its ID. Use when you need to confirm a user's role and details within a workspace after obtaining the membership identifier.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/WorkspacesCreateWorkspaceConnector
actions.label: Workspaces: Create Workspace
actions.description: Tool to create a new workspace. Use when you need to programmatically create a workspace container within an organization.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/WorkspacesDeleteWorkspaceConnector
actions.label: Workspaces: Delete Workspace
actions.description: Tool to delete a specific workspace by its ID. Use when you need to remove an unused workspace after confirming the workspace ID.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/WorkspacesGetUsageByWorkspaceConnector
actions.label: Workspaces: Get Usage By Workspace
actions.description: Retrieves monthly document processing usage statistics for a specific workspace. Returns a list of usage records showing how many documents were processed each month. Use this to track workspace activity, monitor consumption trends, or generate usage reports.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/WorkspacesGetWorkspaceConnector
actions.label: Workspaces: Get Workspace
actions.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific workspace by its ID. Use when you need full workspace metadata after confirming its identifier.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/WorkspacesGetWorkspacesConnector
actions.label: Workspaces: Get Workspaces
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all workspaces. Use when you need to list workspaces filtered by organization and optional name.

actions.name: Corsair/Affinda/WorkspacesUpdateWorkspaceConnector
actions.label: Workspaces: Update Workspace
actions.description: Tool to update specific fields of a workspace. Use when you need to modify a workspace's name, visibility, document rejection policy, or other settings. Only provide the fields you want to change; other fields will remain unchanged.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/AuthLogTheUserInConnector
actions.label: Auth: Log The User In
actions.description: Authenticates an existing AgencyZoom user using their email (as username) and password to obtain a JWT for API access; this action does not support new user creation.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/AuthLogTheUserOutConnector
actions.label: Auth: Log The User Out
actions.description: Use this action to log the current user out of AgencyZoom by invalidating their active session token. #### Output | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | Yes | Data from the action execution | | `error` | string | No | Error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | Yes | Whether or not the action execution was successful or not |

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/AuthV4SsoLogTheUserInConnector
actions.label: Auth: V4 Sso Log The User In
actions.description: Logs a user into the AgencyZoom platform via Single Sign-On (SSO). Returns JWT on success or error details on authentication failure.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/ContactBatchCreateContactConnector
actions.label: Contact: Batch Create Contact
actions.description: Creates 1 to 5 new contacts in AgencyZoom in a single batch API call.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/CustomersCreateACustomerNoteConnector
actions.label: Customers: Create ACustomer Note
actions.description: Adds a new note to an existing customer's profile using their ID; cannot be used to edit or retrieve existing notes.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/CustomersDeleteACustomerConnector
actions.label: Customers: Delete ACustomer
actions.description: Irreversibly deletes a customer and all associated data in AgencyZoom using their `customerId`; useful for offboarding or data privacy compliance.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/CustomersDeleteACustomerFileConnector
actions.label: Customers: Delete ACustomer File
actions.description: Permanently deletes a specific file, identified by `fileId`, associated with a customer, identified by `customerId`.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/CustomersDeleteACustomerPolicyConnector
actions.label: Customers: Delete ACustomer Policy
actions.description: Permanently deletes a specific policy associated with a customer, for instance, if it's cancelled or inactive; this action is irreversible and requires caution.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/CustomersGetAmsPoliciesForACustomerConnector
actions.label: Customers: Get Ams Policies For ACustomer
actions.description: Retrieves a customer's synchronized Agency Management System (AMS) policy data (typically a single policy); requires an active AMS integration, may return empty/default values if data is missing.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/CustomersGetPoliciesForACustomerConnector
actions.label: Customers: Get Policies For ACustomer
actions.description: Retrieves from AgencyZoom all insurance policies for an existing customer (identified by `customerId`), including policy details like type, carrier, premium, effective dates, and assigned agents. Excludes premium payment history or claims information.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/CustomersGetTheCustomerDetailsConnector
actions.label: Customers: Get The Customer Details
actions.description: Fetches comprehensive details for a specific customer, including personal information, policies, notes, tasks, files, and custom fields, using their unique customer ID.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/CustomersGetTheCustomerTasksConnector
actions.label: Customers: Get The Customer Tasks
actions.description: Fetches all tasks (read-only task data) for a customer by `customerId` to review their activities, follow-ups, and action items; the `customerId` must be valid.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/CustomersSearchCustomersConnector
actions.label: Customers: Search Customers
actions.description: Searches for customers in AgencyZoom using criteria like contact information, policy details, or custom fields, with options for filtering, sorting, and pagination. #### Output | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | Yes | Data from the action execution | | `error` | string | No | Error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | Yes | Whether or not the action execution was successful or not |

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/CustomersUpdateCustomerConnector
actions.label: Customers: Update Customer
actions.description: Updates an existing customer's information in AgencyZoom using their unique customerId.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/EmailThreadsDeleteMessageConnector
actions.label: Email: Threads Delete Message
actions.description: Deletes a specific message from an email thread within AgencyZoom. Requires the message ID to identify which message to remove. Returns the updated thread information with the remaining messages after deletion.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/EmailThreadsDeleteThreadConnector
actions.label: Email: Threads Delete Thread
actions.description: Permanently deletes a specific email thread from the AgencyZoom system, identified by its `threadId` (expected by the endpoint), provided the thread exists.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/EmailThreadsGetThreadDetailsConnector
actions.label: Email: Threads Get Thread Details
actions.description: Searches and retrieves detailed information for email threads in AgencyZoom; no explicit search criteria are passed in this request. #### Output | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | Yes | Data from the action execution | | `error` | string | No | Error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | Yes | Whether or not the action execution was successful or not |

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/EmailThreadsMarkThreadAsUnreadApiEndpointConnector
actions.label: Email: Threads Mark Thread As Unread Api Endpoint
actions.description: Marks an email thread in AgencyZoom as read or unread using its `threadId`; this action does not modify message content and the specified `threadId` must refer to an existing thread.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/EmailThreadsSearchEmailThreadsConnector
actions.label: Email: Threads Search Email Threads
actions.description: Retrieves a list of email thread metadata from AgencyZoom, suitable for an overview when no specific filtering, sorting, or pagination is needed, as results are subject to default server-side limits and ordering. #### Output | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | Yes | Data from the action execution | | `error` | string | No | Error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | Yes | Whether or not the action execution was successful or not |

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/LeadsBatchCreateLeadConnector
actions.label: Leads: Batch Create Lead
actions.description: Creates up to 5 new leads in AgencyZoom; all referenced entity IDs (e.g., pipeline, user, custom field names) must exist, and organization `name` is required if `isBusiness` is true.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/LeadsChangeStatusForLeadConnector
actions.label: Leads: Change Status For Lead
actions.description: Updates a lead's lifecycle status (e.g., Active, Won, Lost, X-Dated) and can optionally manage its workflow, pipeline, stage, source, or associated tags.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/LeadsCreateALeadNoteConnector
actions.label: Leads: Create ALead Note
actions.description: Adds a new note to an existing lead in AgencyZoom, identified by `leadId`.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/LeadsCreateALeadOpportunityConnector
actions.label: Leads: Create ALead Opportunity
actions.description: Adds a new sales opportunity to an existing lead in AgencyZoom, requiring a valid `leadId`, `carrierId`, `productLineId`, and that custom field names match existing definitions in AgencyZoom.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/LeadsCreateALeadQuoteConnector
actions.label: Leads: Create ALead Quote
actions.description: Creates a new insurance quote for an existing lead in AgencyZoom, using valid carrier and product line IDs, to track a proposal; this action does not bind policies or process payments.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/LeadsCreateBizLeadConnector
actions.label: Leads: Create Biz Lead
actions.description: Creates or updates a business lead in AgencyZoom using detailed personal and company information, for B2B sales and marketing lead management.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/LeadsCreateLeadConnector
actions.label: Leads: Create Lead
actions.description: Creates a new lead or updates an existing one in AgencyZoom; ensure `pipelineId`, `stageId`, `leadSourceId`, and `assignTo` reference valid, existing entities.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/LeadsDeleteALeadFileConnector
actions.label: Leads: Delete ALead File
actions.description: Deletes a specific file (identified by `fileId`) associated with an existing lead (identified by `leadId`); this operation is irreversible.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/LeadsDeleteALeadOpportunityConnector
actions.label: Leads: Delete ALead Opportunity
actions.description: Permanently deletes an existing opportunity (by `opportunityId`) associated with an existing lead (by `leadId`) when it's irrelevant, closed, or erroneous; the lead itself remains.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/LeadsDeleteALeadQuoteConnector
actions.label: Leads: Delete ALead Quote
actions.description: Deletes a specific quote from a lead, requiring that the lead and quote exist and are associated.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/LeadsGetLeadFilesConnector
actions.label: Leads: Get Lead Files
actions.description: Retrieves metadata (id, title, MIME type, size, dates, creator info) for files attached to leads in AgencyZoom. Optionally filter by `leadId` to get files for a specific lead, or omit to retrieve files across all leads. Returns file metadata only, not the actual file content.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/LeadsGetLeadNotesConnector
actions.label: Leads: Get Lead Notes
actions.description: Fetches the complete history of notes for a specific lead by `leadId` (which must exist), useful for reviewing context for communications or follow-ups; this is a read-only operation.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/LeadsGetLeadQuotesConnector
actions.label: Leads: Get Lead Quotes
actions.description: Retrieves all insurance quotes (active and inactive) for a specific lead ID, useful for reviewing or tracking quote history.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/LeadsGetLeadTasksConnector
actions.label: Leads: Get Lead Tasks
actions.description: Retrieves all tasks for a specific lead, identified by its `leadId`, to review its activity history or manage follow-ups.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/LeadsGetTheLeadDetailsConnector
actions.label: Leads: Get The Lead Details
actions.description: Retrieves comprehensive details for a specific lead in AgencyZoom by its unique `leadId` (which must correspond to an existing lead), including contact information, status, associated opportunities, quotes/policies, custom fields, and interaction history.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/LeadsGetTheOpportunitiesForALeadConnector
actions.label: Leads: Get The Opportunities For ALead
actions.description: Retrieves all sales opportunities and their details for a specified, existing `leadId` in AgencyZoom.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/LeadsMoveLeadToSoldConnector
actions.label: Leads: Move Lead To Sold
actions.description: Marks an existing lead as sold by its `leadId` and records product details; `productLineId`, `premium`, `effectiveDate`, and `soldDate` are operationally required for each sold product, despite schema flexibility.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/LeadsSearchLeadsConnector
actions.label: Leads: Search Leads
actions.description: Retrieves AgencyZoom leads, using filters, pagination, and sorting options sent in the POST body, as the request schema itself is empty. #### Output | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | Yes | Data from the action execution | | `error` | string | No | Error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | Yes | Whether or not the action execution was successful or not |

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/LeadsSearchLeadsCountConnector
actions.label: Leads: Search Leads Count
actions.description: Retrieves a summary of lead counts categorized by workflow stage from AgencyZoom; this action does not support filtering and returns aggregate counts rather than individual lead details. #### Output | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | Yes | Data from the action execution | | `error` | string | No | Error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | Yes | Whether or not the action execution was successful or not |

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/LeadsUpdateALeadFileNameConnector
actions.label: Leads: Update ALead File Name
actions.description: Updates a lead's file name to `newFileName`; requires `fileId` of the target file, which must be associated with both the `leadId` (path parameter) and the provided `customerReferralId`.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/LeadsUpdateALeadOpportunityConnector
actions.label: Leads: Update ALead Opportunity
actions.description: Updates an existing opportunity's details (carrier, product line, premium, items, custom fields) for a specific lead; `leadId`, opportunity `id`, `carrierId`, and `productLineId` must refer to existing entities.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/LeadsUpdateALeadQuoteConnector
actions.label: Leads: Update ALead Quote
actions.description: Updates an existing quote for a specified lead in AgencyZoom when its details require revision, ensuring the provided `leadId` (path parameter), quote `id` (body parameter), `carrierId`, and `productLineId` are valid and correspond to existing entities.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/LeadsUpdateBusinessLeadConnector
actions.label: Leads: Update Business Lead
actions.description: Updates an existing business lead in AgencyZoom. Requires leadId (path parameter) plus core business information fields: firstname, email, name (business name), pipelineId, stageId, leadSourceId, assignTo (producer ID), and country. All other fields are optional and will only update if provided.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/LeadsUpdateLeadConnector
actions.label: Leads: Update Lead
actions.description: Updates an existing lead's information in AgencyZoom using the `leadId`; ensure the `leadId` corresponds to an existing lead in AgencyZoom.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/LeadsUpdateLeadStatusByIdConnector
actions.label: Leads: Update Lead Status By Id
actions.description: Updates a lead's status (0=ACTIVE, 2=WON, 3=LOST, 5=XDATED) by `leadId`, optionally setting workflow, stage, date, loss reason, X-date type, source, recycle stage/pipeline, or tags; requires `date` and `xDateType` for status 5 (XDATED), and `lossReasonId` for status 3 (LOST).

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/LifeSearchLifeAndHealthLeadsConnector
actions.label: Life: Search Life And Health Leads
actions.description: Searches for life and health insurance leads by providing filter criteria (matching AlrLead fields) in the request body; an empty request may retrieve all leads or a default set. #### Output | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | Yes | Data from the action execution | | `error` | string | No | Error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | Yes | Whether or not the action execution was successful or not |

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/OpportunitiesCreateADriverForAnOpportunityConnector
actions.label: Opportunities: Create ADriver For An Opportunity
actions.description: Creates a new driver record associated with an existing AgencyZoom opportunity using its ID; requires firstName and lastName, with optional fields for additional driver details.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/OpportunitiesCreateAnOpportunityConnector
actions.label: Opportunities: Create An Opportunity
actions.description: Creates a new lead opportunity in AgencyZoom; this action cannot update existing opportunities.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/OpportunitiesCreateAVehicleForAnOpportunityConnector
actions.label: Opportunities: Create AVehicle For An Opportunity
actions.description: Adds a new vehicle record to a specified opportunity; `opportunityId` must refer to a valid, existing opportunity.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/OpportunitiesDeleteADriverConnector
actions.label: Opportunities: Delete ADriver
actions.description: Permanently deletes an existing driver record (a person associated with an insurance opportunity) from AgencyZoom using its unique `driverId`; this action is irreversible.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/OpportunitiesDeleteAnOpportunityConnector
actions.label: Opportunities: Delete An Opportunity
actions.description: Permanently deletes a specific opportunity by its unique ID; this action is irreversible and requires a valid, existing `opportunityId`.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/OpportunitiesDeleteAVehicleConnector
actions.label: Opportunities: Delete AVehicle
actions.description: Permanently deletes a vehicle record by its `vehicleId`, which must correspond to an existing vehicle in the AgencyZoom system.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/OpportunitiesGetAListOfDriversForAnOpportunityConnector
actions.label: Opportunities: Get AList Of Drivers For An Opportunity
actions.description: Retrieves a list of drivers (individuals), including their personal details, licensing information, and relationship status, associated with a specific, existing `opportunityId` in AgencyZoom.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/OpportunitiesGetAListOfVehiclesForAnOpportunityConnector
actions.label: Opportunities: Get AList Of Vehicles For An Opportunity
actions.description: Retrieves all vehicles associated with an existing opportunity, using its unique opportunityId.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/OpportunitiesGetTheDriverDetailsConnector
actions.label: Opportunities: Get The Driver Details
actions.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific, existing driver (by `driverId`) associated with an AgencyZoom opportunity.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/OpportunitiesGetTheOpportunityDetailsConnector
actions.label: Opportunities: Get The Opportunity Details
actions.description: Fetches comprehensive details for an existing opportunity using its unique `opportunityId`.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/OpportunitiesGetTheVehicleDetailsConnector
actions.label: Opportunities: Get The Vehicle Details
actions.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific vehicle, often associated with an AgencyZoom opportunity, using its unique vehicleId.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/OpportunitiesLinkADriverToOpportunityConnector
actions.label: Opportunities: Link ADriver To Opportunity
actions.description: Assigns or reassigns an existing driver to an existing opportunity.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/OpportunitiesLinkAVehicleToOpportunityConnector
actions.label: Opportunities: Link AVehicle To Opportunity
actions.description: Links an existing vehicle to an existing sales opportunity in AgencyZoom using their respective IDs, typically for managing auto insurance policies or related services.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/OpportunitiesUnlinkADriverFromOpportunityConnector
actions.label: Opportunities: Unlink ADriver From Opportunity
actions.description: Unlinks a currently associated driver from an AgencyZoom opportunity, used when the driver is no longer relevant, for policy or data updates, potentially impacting the opportunity's status or associated policy details.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/OpportunitiesUnlinkAVehicleFromOpportunityConnector
actions.label: Opportunities: Unlink AVehicle From Opportunity
actions.description: Unlinks a specific, existing vehicle from a specific, existing opportunity using their respective IDs, removing only the association and not the records themselves.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/OpportunitiesUpdateADriverSDetailsConnector
actions.label: Opportunities: Update ADriver SDetails
actions.description: Updates an existing driver's details in AgencyZoom, requiring `driverId` in the path and `firstName` and `lastName` in the request.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/OpportunitiesUpdateAnOpportunityConnector
actions.label: Opportunities: Update An Opportunity
actions.description: Updates an existing opportunity with the provided details; ensure any custom field names are predefined in AgencyZoom configuration.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/OpportunitiesUpdateAVehicleSDetailsConnector
actions.label: Opportunities: Update AVehicle SDetails
actions.description: Updates details for an existing vehicle within an opportunity; this action cannot be used to create new vehicle records.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/PoliciesUpdateAPolicyConnector
actions.label: Policies: Update APolicy
actions.description: Updates an existing insurance policy for the given `policyId`; monetary values must be in cents and dates in YYYY-MM-DD format.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/PoliciesUpdateTagsForAPolicyConnector
actions.label: Policies: Update Tags For APolicy
actions.description: Adds new comma-separated `tagNames` to a policy, requiring `tagNames` and identification by either `policyId` or `amsPolicyId`; if `amsPolicyId` is provided, `policyId` is ignored, and existing tags are not affected.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/ProfileUpdateMyProfileConnector
actions.label: Profile: Update My Profile
actions.description: Updates the profile information (first name, last name, email, and optional phone) for the currently authenticated user in AgencyZoom; the provided email address must be unique within the system.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/ReferenceDataGetAListOfAssignGroupsConnector
actions.label: Reference: Data Get AList Of Assign Groups
actions.description: Retrieves all assign groups configured in AgencyZoom, used for categorizing or assigning items to specific teams or units. #### Output | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | Yes | Data from the action execution | | `error` | string | No | Error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | Yes | Whether or not the action execution was successful or not |

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/ReferenceDataGetAListOfCarriersConnector
actions.label: Reference: Data Get AList Of Carriers

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/ReferenceDataGetAListOfCsrsConnector
actions.label: Reference: Data Get AList Of Csrs
