actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/ReferenceDataGetAListOfCustomFieldsConnector
actions.label: Reference: Data Get AList Of Custom Fields
actions.description: Retrieves metadata for all configured custom field definitions, not the specific values entered for individual records. #### Output | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | Yes | Data from the action execution | | `error` | string | No | Error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | Yes | Whether or not the action execution was successful or not |

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/ReferenceDataGetAListOfEmployeesConnector
actions.label: Reference: Data Get AList Of Employees
actions.description: Retrieves a complete list of all employees for the authenticated agency; returns an empty list if no employees are configured. #### Output | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | Yes | Data from the action execution | | `error` | string | No | Error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | Yes | Whether or not the action execution was successful or not |

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/ReferenceDataGetAListOfLeadSourceCategoriesConnector
actions.label: Reference: Data Get AList Of Lead Source Categories
actions.description: Retrieves a comprehensive list of all predefined lead source categories from AgencyZoom, used to classify lead origins. #### Output | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | Yes | Data from the action execution | | `error` | string | No | Error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | Yes | Whether or not the action execution was successful or not |

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/ReferenceDataGetAListOfLeadSourcesConnector
actions.label: Reference: Data Get AList Of Lead Sources
actions.description: Fetches a list of all lead sources configured in AgencyZoom, including their ID, name, sales exclusion status, and category ID. #### Output | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | Yes | Data from the action execution | | `error` | string | No | Error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | Yes | Whether or not the action execution was successful or not |

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/ReferenceDataGetAListOfLifeProfessionalsConnector
actions.label: Reference: Data Get AList Of Life Professionals
actions.description: Retrieves a list of life insurance professionals, including only their contact and status information (excluding sales or customer data), from the AgencyZoom platform. #### Output | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | Yes | Data from the action execution | | `error` | string | No | Error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | Yes | Whether or not the action execution was successful or not |

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/ReferenceDataGetAListOfLocationsConnector
actions.label: Reference: Data Get AList Of Locations
actions.description: Retrieves all agency locations or branches from AgencyZoom; filtering options are not available. #### Output | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | Yes | Data from the action execution | | `error` | string | No | Error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | Yes | Whether or not the action execution was successful or not |

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/ReferenceDataGetAListOfLossReasonsConnector
actions.label: Reference: Data Get AList Of Loss Reasons
actions.description: Retrieves all predefined loss reasons (e.g., 'Lost to competitor', 'Premium too high') available in AgencyZoom. These reasons can be used when marking leads as lost or for reporting purposes. No parameters required - returns complete list. #### Output | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | Yes | Data from the action execution | | `error` | string | No | Error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | Yes | Whether or not the action execution was successful or not |

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/ReferenceDataGetAListOfPipelinesConnector
actions.label: Reference: Data Get AList Of Pipelines
actions.description: Retrieves all pipelines and their stages from AgencyZoom to understand workflow structures; this is a read-only operation and does not return individual items (like leads or tasks) within these pipelines. #### Output | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | Yes | Data from the action execution | | `error` | string | No | Error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | Yes | Whether or not the action execution was successful or not |

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/ReferenceDataGetAListOfProductLinesPolicyTypesConnector
actions.label: Reference: Data Get AList Of Product Lines Policy Types
actions.description: Fetches all product lines and policy types from AgencyZoom, each detailed with its ID, name, and product category ID. #### Output | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | Yes | Data from the action execution | | `error` | string | No | Error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | Yes | Whether or not the action execution was successful or not |

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/ReferenceDataGetAListOfRecycleEventsConnector
actions.label: Reference: Data Get AList Of Recycle Events
actions.description: Retrieves the available recycle event types and any existing X-Date information for a specified lead in AgencyZoom. Returns a list of recycle event categories that can be used to trigger follow-ups (e.g., 'X-Date', 'Accident Falls Off', 'Prior Insurance Fulfilled').

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/ReferenceDataGetDepartmentsGroupsConnector
actions.label: Reference: Data Get Departments Groups
actions.description: Fetches department and group information for an agency, optionally filtered by a specific `agencyNumber`, to analyze its organizational structure.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/ReferenceDataGetListOfEndStagesConnector
actions.label: Reference: Data Get List Of End Stages
actions.description: Fetches a list of all defined end stages, representing final steps in processes like lead conversion or policy closure. #### Output | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | Yes | Data from the action execution | | `error` | string | No | Error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | Yes | Whether or not the action execution was successful or not |

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/ReferenceDataListProductCategoriesConnector
actions.label: Reference: Data List Product Categories
actions.description: Retrieves a complete, unfiltered list of all product categories (ID and name) from AgencyZoom, useful for understanding product organization or populating UI elements. #### Output | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | Yes | Data from the action execution | | `error` | string | No | Error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | Yes | Whether or not the action execution was successful or not |

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/ReferenceDataSearchBusinessClassificationsConnector
actions.label: Reference: Data Search Business Classifications
actions.description: Retrieves a comprehensive list of all available business classifications from AgencyZoom, each including an ID, code, and description. #### Output | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | Yes | Data from the action execution | | `error` | string | No | Error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | Yes | Whether or not the action execution was successful or not |

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/ServiceTicketsServiceTicketListConnector
actions.label: Service: Tickets Service Ticket List
actions.description: Retrieves a paginated list of service tickets from AgencyZoom. Supports filtering by: - Status (0=removed, 1=active, 2=completed) - Priority ID and Category ID Returns service ticket details including subject, description, dates, assignment information, and workflow stage. Results are paginated with default page size of 20 tickets per page.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/TasksBatchDeleteTaskConnector
actions.label: Tasks: Batch Delete Task
actions.description: Deletes multiple AgencyZoom tasks in a batch; task deletion is permanent and the response indicates overall batch success, not individual task status.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/TasksCompleteTaskConnector
actions.label: Tasks: Complete Task
actions.description: Marks an existing and accessible task in AgencyZoom as 'completed'; this action does not return the full updated task object.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/TasksCreateTaskConnector
actions.label: Tasks: Create Task
actions.description: Creates a new task in AgencyZoom; ensure `assigneeId`, `customerId`, or `leadId` are valid existing entities if provided, and use `contactEmail`, `customerId`, or `leadId` to link the task to a contact.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/TasksDeleteATaskConnector
actions.label: Tasks: Delete ATask
actions.description: Permanently and irreversibly deletes an existing task, identified by its `taskId`.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/TasksGetTheTaskDetailsConnector
actions.label: Tasks: Get The Task Details
actions.description: Retrieves comprehensive details for a specific task using its unique `taskId`, which must correspond to an existing task in AgencyZoom.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/TasksReopenATaskConnector
actions.label: Tasks: Reopen ATask
actions.description: Reopens an existing AgencyZoom task that is currently 'completed' or 'closed', allowing it to be reactivated with optional comments.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/TasksSearchTasksConnector
actions.label: Tasks: Search Tasks
actions.description: Searches and lists tasks, supporting pagination and accepting filter criteria in the POST request body despite an empty request schema.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/TasksUpdateTaskConnector
actions.label: Tasks: Update Task
actions.description: Modifies an existing AgencyZoom task (which must be valid and identified by `taskId` in the path) with new attributes from the request body, which must also contain `taskId`.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/TextThreadsGetAListOfProducerConnector
actions.label: Text: Threads Get AList Of Producer
actions.description: Retrieves a list of all producers from AgencyZoom, typically related to text thread functionalities. #### Output | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | Yes | Data from the action execution | | `error` | string | No | Error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | Yes | Whether or not the action execution was successful or not |

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/TextThreadsRemoveTextThreadEndpointConnector
actions.label: Text: Threads Remove Text Thread Endpoint
actions.description: Call this action to permanently delete an SMS/text message thread in AgencyZoom; the target thread is identified by its `threadId`. Note: This operation is idempotent - deleting a non-existent thread will return success.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/TextThreadsSearchSmsThreadsConnector
actions.label: Text: Threads Search Sms Threads
actions.description: Searches and retrieves SMS threads from AgencyZoom, with search parameters, filters, sorting, and pagination typically provided in the request body of this POST operation. #### Output | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | Yes | Data from the action execution | | `error` | string | No | Error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | Yes | Whether or not the action execution was successful or not |

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/TextThreadsTextDetailThreadConnector
actions.label: Text: Threads Text Detail Thread
actions.description: Retrieves detailed messages for a specific SMS/text thread by its thread ID. Returns all messages in the thread with their content, attachments, sender/recipient information, and metadata. The thread ID can be obtained from the search_sms_threads action.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/TextThreadsUnreadThreadConnector
actions.label: Text: Threads Unread Thread
actions.description: Updates the read or unread status of a specific SMS/text thread within AgencyZoom.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/V4ssoAuthenticateForJwtviaV4SsoConnector
actions.label: V4sso: Authenticate For Jwtvia V4 Sso
actions.description: Completes AgencyZoom V4 Single Sign-On (SSO) authentication by exchanging an OAuth2 authorization code for a JWT token. Prerequisites: First call get_auth_url_for_v4sso to obtain the authentication URL, then redirect the user to that URL for login. After successful authentication through Vertafore's OAuth provider, the callback will include a 'code' parameter. Use that code with this action to obtain the JWT token for API access. Note: This is typically used during initial authentication setup. The code is single-use, time-limited, and must match the PKCE challenge from the original auth request.

actions.name: Corsair/Agencyzoom/V4ssoGetAuthUrlForV4SsoConnector
actions.label: V4sso: Get Auth Url For V4 Sso
actions.description: Retrieves a fresh authentication URL for AgencyZoom's V4 Single Sign-On (SSO) process; call before each SSO attempt as the URL may change and should not be cached. #### Output | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | Yes | Data from the action execution | | `error` | string | No | Error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | Yes | Whether or not the action execution was successful or not |

actions.name: Corsair/Agentmail/MessagesGetConnector
actions.label: Messages: Get
actions.description: Retrieve the complete details of an AgentMail message

actions.name: Corsair/Agentmail/MessagesListConnector
actions.label: Messages: List
actions.description: List messages from an AgentMail inbox

actions.name: Corsair/Agentmail/MessagesSendConnector
actions.label: Messages: Send
actions.description: Send an email using AgentMail

actions.name: Corsair/Agentql/BrowserSessionsCreateRemoteBrowserSessionConnector
actions.label: Browser: Sessions Create Remote Browser Session
actions.description: Tool to create a remote browser session. Use when you need to run browser automation on remote infrastructure.

actions.name: Corsair/Agentql/DataQueryConnector
actions.label: Data: Query
actions.description: Tool to query structured data as JSON from a web page using an AgentQL query or natural language prompt. Use after defining your query or prompt and a URL or HTML.

actions.name: Corsair/Agentql/DataQueryDocumentConnector
actions.label: Data: Query Document
actions.description: Tool to extract structured data from PDF or image documents using an AgentQL query or natural language prompt. Accepts a file upload plus query or prompt.

actions.name: Corsair/Agentql/UsageGetConnector
actions.label: Usage: Get
actions.description: Retrieves API usage statistics and subscription limits for the AgentQL account. Returns current billing cycle dates, lifetime usage limits, API key usage counts, and total account usage. Useful for monitoring quota consumption and planning usage. No parameters required - uses the authenticated API key from connection settings.

actions.name: Corsair/Agenty/AgentsAgentsControllerCreateAgentConnector
actions.label: Agents: Agents Controller Create Agent
actions.description: Creates a new Agenty agent for web scraping, change detection, crawling, map monitoring, or brand monitoring. Use this tool to set up automated data extraction agents. Requires: - name: A descriptive name for the agent - type: One of 'scraping', 'changedetection', 'crawling', 'mapmonitoring', 'brandmonitoring' - config: Configuration object with url, browser, and collections defining what data to extract The config.collections array contains field definitions with CSS selectors or other extraction methods. Each field specifies what data to extract and how (TEXT content, ATTR for attributes, etc.). Optional: Set start=true to immediately run the agent after creation, or configure a scheduler for recurring runs. Returns the created agent with its unique agent_id for future reference.

actions.name: Corsair/Agenty/AgentsAgentsControllerGetTemplatesConnector
actions.label: Agents: Agents Controller Get Templates
actions.description: Tool to fetch all public agent templates and sample agents. Use when listing available templates for users to select.

actions.name: Corsair/Agenty/AgentsAgentsDeleteByIdConnector
actions.label: Agents: Agents Delete By Id
actions.description: Tool to delete a single agent by its ID. Use when you need to permanently remove an agent after confirming it exists.

actions.name: Corsair/Agenty/AgentsAgentsGetAllConnector
actions.label: Agents: Agents Get All
actions.description: Tool to fetch all active agents under an account. Use after authenticating when you need to list agents with pagination and sorting.

actions.name: Corsair/Agenty/AgentsAgentsGetByIdConnector
actions.label: Agents: Agents Get By Id
actions.description: Retrieves complete details of a specific agent including its configuration, input settings, scheduler, and metadata. Use this tool when you need to: - View full agent configuration and settings - Check agent type and current version - Access scheduler and script configurations - Verify agent status before executing jobs - Retrieve agent metadata for updates or cloning

actions.name: Corsair/Agenty/AgentsAgentsUpdateByIdConnector
actions.label: Agents: Agents Update By Id
actions.description: Updates an existing agent's configuration, settings, and metadata. Use this tool to modify an agent's properties such as name, type, config, tags, scheduler, scripts, or visibility settings. The API only returns the fields that were updated in the response, not the complete agent object. To get the full updated agent details, use the 'Get Agent by ID' action after updating. Example uses: - "Update agent abc123 to change its name to 'Production Scraper'" - "Enable scheduling for agent xyz789 with a cron expression '0 */6 * * *'" - "Update agent def456 config to scrape a different URL"

actions.name: Corsair/Agenty/AgentsCopyAgentConnector
actions.label: Agents: Copy Agent
actions.description: Tool to copy an existing agent by its ID, creating a duplicate with optionally a new name. Use when you need to duplicate an agent's configuration to create a similar agent without starting from scratch.

actions.name: Corsair/Agenty/AgentsTransferAgentOwnershipConnector
actions.label: Agents: Transfer Agent Ownership
actions.description: Tool to transfer agent ownership to another Agenty account. Use when you need to move an agent to a different user's account by specifying their email address.

actions.name: Corsair/Agenty/ApiKeysApiKeysControllerCreateApiKeysConnector
actions.label: Api: Keys Api Keys Controller Create Api Keys
actions.description: Creates a new API key for programmatic access to the Agenty API. The generated API key can be used to authenticate API requests with different permission levels (Owner, Admin, or Manager). The key is returned in the response and should be securely stored as it provides access to your Agenty account.

actions.name: Corsair/Agenty/ApiKeysApiKeysDeleteByIdConnector
actions.label: Api: Keys Api Keys Delete By Id
actions.description: Delete an API key by its unique identifier. Use this tool to permanently revoke access for a specific API key. The key_id can be obtained from the "Get all API keys" or "Create API key" actions. This action cannot be undone.

actions.name: Corsair/Agenty/ApiKeysApiKeysDownloadConnector
actions.label: Api: Keys Api Keys Download
actions.description: Tool to download all API keys under an account in CSV format. Use when you need a complete list of API keys for export or backup.

actions.name: Corsair/Agenty/ApiKeysApiKeysGetAllConnector
actions.label: Api: Keys Api Keys Get All
actions.description: Tool to retrieve all API keys under an account. Use after authentication when you need to list API keys with pagination and sorting.

actions.name: Corsair/Agenty/ApiKeysApiKeysGetByIdConnector
actions.label: Api: Keys Api Keys Get By Id
actions.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific API key by its ID. Use this action when you need to: - Get the full details of an API key including its value, role, and status - Verify the existence and properties of a specific API key - Check if an API key is enabled or disabled The key_id can be obtained from the 'Get all API keys' action or when creating a new API key.

actions.name: Corsair/Agenty/ApiKeysApiKeysResetByIdConnector
actions.label: Api: Keys Api Keys Reset By Id
actions.description: Resets (regenerates) the secret value of an existing API key. The old secret becomes invalid immediately. Important: This action only confirms the reset was successful but does NOT return the new secret. After resetting, use the 'Get API Key By ID' action to retrieve the new secret value. Use this when you need to: - Rotate API key secrets for security - Invalidate a compromised API key and generate a new secret - Update credentials as part of security maintenance

actions.name: Corsair/Agenty/ApiKeysApiKeysUpdateByIdConnector
actions.label: Api: Keys Api Keys Update By Id
actions.description: Updates an existing API key's name and role by its unique identifier. This action allows you to modify the display name and permission level of an API key. Only the name and role fields can be updated; other properties are read-only. After updating, the action automatically fetches and returns the complete updated API key details. Use this when you need to: - Rename an API key for better identification - Change the permission level (Owner, Admin, or Manager) of an API key - Update multiple properties of an API key at once

actions.name: Corsair/Agenty/ApiKeysChangeApiKeyStatusByIdConnector
actions.label: Api: Keys Change Api Key Status By Id
actions.description: Toggles the enabled/disabled status of an API key. This endpoint switches the key between enabled and disabled states - if the key is currently enabled, it will be disabled, and vice versa. Returns a confirmation message upon successful status change. Use this after retrieving the key_id from the list or get API key endpoints.

actions.name: Corsair/Agenty/BrowserCaptureScreenshotConnector
actions.label: Browser: Capture Screenshot
actions.description: Tool to capture a full-page or visible screenshot of any webpage URL. Use when you need to capture visual representation of a webpage as an image file. The screenshot is captured using browser automation with default settings.

actions.name: Corsair/Agenty/BrowserCaptureScreenshotWithOptionsConnector
actions.label: Browser: Capture Screenshot With Options
actions.description: Tool to capture webpage screenshots with extensive customization options including full-page capture, image format, quality settings, viewport configuration, and post-processing. Use when you need to take screenshots of web pages with specific requirements for size, format, or rendering behavior.

actions.name: Corsair/Agenty/BrowserConvertUrlToPdfConnector
actions.label: Browser: Convert Url To Pdf
actions.description: Tool to convert a webpage URL to a PDF document. Use when you need to generate a PDF file from a web page for archival, reporting, or offline viewing purposes.

actions.name: Corsair/Agenty/BrowserConvertUrlToPdfWithOptionsConnector
actions.label: Browser: Convert Url To Pdf With Options
actions.description: Tool to convert a URL or raw HTML to PDF with customizable options. Use when you need to generate PDFs with specific formatting requirements like custom page sizes, margins, headers/footers, or orientation. Supports both URL-based and HTML content conversion.

actions.name: Corsair/Agenty/BrowserExtractBrowserStructuredDataConnector
actions.label: Browser: Extract Browser Structured Data
actions.description: Tool to auto-extract structured data from a webpage including schema.org, RDFa, Microdata, and JSON-LD formats. Use when you need to automatically extract semantic markup from web pages without writing custom scraping rules. The API returns organized structured data in four categories: metatags, microdata, rdfa, and jsonld.

actions.name: Corsair/Agenty/BrowserExtractStructuredDataConnector
actions.label: Browser: Extract Structured Data
actions.description: Tool to auto-extract structured data from a webpage URL. Use when you need to extract schema.org, RDFa, Microdata, or JSON-LD structured data from web pages.

actions.name: Corsair/Agenty/BrowserGetBrowserRedirectsConnector
actions.label: Browser: Get Browser Redirects
actions.description: Tool to get the complete redirect chain for a URL. Use when you need to trace how a URL redirects, including both server-side (HTTP 3xx redirects) and client-side redirects (JavaScript, meta tags). Returns an ordered list of all redirect steps from the original URL to the final destination.

actions.name: Corsair/Agenty/BrowserGetPageContentConnector
actions.label: Browser: Get Page Content
actions.description: Tool to fetch the complete HTML content of any webpage URL. Use this when you need to retrieve the full HTML source code of a page, including content rendered after JavaScript execution. The API navigates to the URL using proxies and captures the page's source content.

actions.name: Corsair/Agenty/BrowserGetPageContentWithOptionsConnector
actions.label: Browser: Get Page Content With Options
actions.description: Tool to fetch HTML content of a webpage with custom options including ad blocking. Use this when you need to retrieve the full HTML source of a webpage, particularly for web scraping or content analysis tasks. The tool supports ad blocking to speed up page loads and reduce unnecessary content.

actions.name: Corsair/Agenty/BrowserGetRedirectsWithOptionsConnector
actions.label: Browser: Get Redirects With Options
actions.description: Tool to get the complete redirect chain of a URL with custom navigation options. Use when you need to trace URL redirects including both server-side (3xx) and client-side redirects (JavaScript, meta tags). Supports custom timeout and navigation wait conditions to ensure all redirects are captured.

actions.name: Corsair/Agenty/BrowserScrapeWebpageDataConnector
actions.label: Browser: Scrape Webpage Data
actions.description: Tool to scrape data from any webpage using jQuery/CSS selectors. Use when you need to extract specific data from web pages by defining jQuery selector expressions. Each query field maps a name to a jQuery expression (e.g., "$('h1').text()" extracts the h1 text). The browser will load the page, execute JavaScript, and run your jQuery queries to extract the data.

actions.name: Corsair/Agenty/ConnectionsConnectionsGetAllConnector
actions.label: Connections: Connections Get All
actions.description: Retrieves all connections from your Agenty account. Supports pagination via limit/offset and sorting by field name. Returns an empty list if no connections exist.

actions.name: Corsair/Agenty/DashboardDashboardGetReportsUsageConnector
actions.label: Dashboard: Dashboard Get Reports Usage
actions.description: Tool to fetch account reports like pages used by agent, date, and product. Use when analyzing usage over a date range.

actions.name: Corsair/Agenty/InputsInputsGetByAgentIdConnector
actions.label: Inputs: Inputs Get By Agent Id
actions.description: Retrieves the input configuration for a specific agent by its ID. Returns the input source type (URL, manual list, saved list reference, or another agent's output) and associated configuration details. Use this to inspect an agent's current input setup before modifying it or starting a job, or to verify what data sources an agent will process.

actions.name: Corsair/Agenty/InputsInputsUpdateByAgentIdConnector
actions.label: Inputs: Inputs Update By Agent Id
actions.description: Updates the input configuration for a specific agent in Agenty. This tool modifies where an agent gets its input data from. You can configure the agent to: - Pull from a URL feed (type='url') - Use a manually specified list of URLs (type='manual') - Reference data from an Agenty list (type='list') - Use output from another agent (type='agent') Use this after creating or identifying an agent to set up its data source before running jobs.

actions.name: Corsair/Agenty/JobsDownloadAgentResultConnector
actions.label: Jobs: Download Agent Result
actions.description: Tool to download agent results by agent ID in CSV, TSV or JSON format. Use when you need to export or analyze agent execution results as a file.

actions.name: Corsair/Agenty/JobsGetAgentResultConnector
actions.label: Jobs: Get Agent Result
actions.description: Tool to get the most recent result data for an agent. Use when you need to retrieve and view the scraped/collected data from an agent's latest execution. Returns result data with pagination support.

actions.name: Corsair/Agenty/JobsGetJobResultConnector
actions.label: Jobs: Get Job Result
actions.description: Tool to get the result data from a completed job. Use when you need to retrieve and view the scraped/collected data from a finished job. Returns result data with pagination support.

actions.name: Corsair/Agenty/JobsJobsDownloadConnector
actions.label: Jobs: Jobs Download
actions.description: Tool to download all jobs in CSV format. Use when you need a complete list of jobs for export or analysis.

actions.name: Corsair/Agenty/JobsJobsDownloadFilesByIdConnector
actions.label: Jobs: Jobs Download Files By Id
actions.description: Tool to download output files by job ID. Use when you need to fetch a specific output file after a job completes.

actions.name: Corsair/Agenty/JobsJobsDownloadResultByIdConnector
actions.label: Jobs: Jobs Download Result By Id
actions.description: Tool to download the agent output result by job ID. Use when you need to fetch the final output of a completed job in CSV, TSV, or JSON format.

actions.name: Corsair/Agenty/JobsJobsGetAllConnector
actions.label: Jobs: Jobs Get All
actions.description: Tool to fetch all jobs under an account. Use when you need to view and filter the list of jobs with pagination and sorting.

actions.name: Corsair/Agenty/JobsJobsGetByIdConnector
actions.label: Jobs: Jobs Get By Id
actions.description: Retrieves comprehensive details about a specific job including its status, progress metrics (pages processed/succeeded/failed), timing information (created/started/completed times), resource consumption (page credits), and any error messages. Use this action to check job status, monitor execution progress, or diagnose job failures. Returns complete job metadata needed before downloading results.

actions.name: Corsair/Agenty/JobsJobsGetLogsByIdConnector
actions.label: Jobs: Jobs Get Logs By Id
actions.description: Tool to fetch logs for a given job by its ID. Use when you need to review or debug job execution logs with pagination support.

actions.name: Corsair/Agenty/JobsJobsListFilesByIdConnector
actions.label: Jobs: Jobs List Files By Id
actions.description: Lists all output files generated by a specific job. Returns file names and sizes for available downloads including CSV/JSON/TSV data exports and compressed logs. Use this after a job completes to discover what output files are available before downloading them.

actions.name: Corsair/Agenty/JobsJobsStartConnector
actions.label: Jobs: Jobs Start
actions.description: Tool to start a new agent job. Use when you need to trigger execution of an existing agent.

actions.name: Corsair/Agenty/JobsJobsStopByIdConnector
actions.label: Jobs: Jobs Stop By Id
actions.description: Tool to stop a running job by job ID. Use when you need to halt an in-progress job before it completes. Confirm the job ID beforehand to avoid unintended stops.

actions.name: Corsair/Agenty/ListsAddListRowsConnector
actions.label: Lists: Add List Rows
actions.description: Tool to add new rows to a list. Use when you need to insert one or more data rows into an existing list. Column names in row objects must match the list's schema.

actions.name: Corsair/Agenty/ListsDeleteListRowConnector
actions.label: Lists: Delete List Row
actions.description: Tool to delete a specific row from a list by its unique identifier. Use when you need to permanently remove a single row from a list.

actions.name: Corsair/Agenty/ListsDeleteListRowsConnector
actions.label: Lists: Delete List Rows
actions.description: Tool to delete specific rows from a list by their IDs. Use when you need to remove one or more rows from a list by providing their unique identifiers.

actions.name: Corsair/Agenty/ListsDownloadListRowsConnector
actions.label: Lists: Download List Rows
actions.description: Tool to download list rows as CSV file. Use when you need to export or backup all rows from a specific list.

actions.name: Corsair/Agenty/ListsGetListByIdConnector
actions.label: Lists: Get List By Id
actions.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific list by its ID. Use this action when you need to: - Get the full details of a list including its name, description, and metadata - Verify the existence of a specific list - Check when a list was created or last updated - Access additional data associated with a list The list_id can be obtained from the 'Get all lists' action or when creating a new list.

actions.name: Corsair/Agenty/ListsGetListRowByIdConnector
actions.label: Lists: Get List Row By Id
actions.description: Tool to fetch a specific row by its ID from a list. Use when you need to retrieve a single data entry from a list using its unique identifier.

actions.name: Corsair/Agenty/ListsListsClearRowsConnector
actions.label: Lists: Lists Clear Rows
actions.description: Tool to clear all rows in a list by its ID. Use when you need to wipe out all data in a list before re-populating (e.g., "Clear all rows in list 123").

actions.name: Corsair/Agenty/ListsListsControllerCreateListConnector
actions.label: Lists: Lists Controller Create List
actions.description: Tool to create a new list. Use after preparing the list name and optional description. Example: "Create a list named 'Contacts' with description 'Potential leads'."

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/AnalyticsGetTopFilterAttributesConnector

actions.description: Tool to retrieve top filter attributes from Algolia Analytics. Use when analyzing which filters are most commonly used by users in searches.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/AnalyticsGetTopFilterForAttributeConnector
actions.label: Analytics: Get Top Filter For Attribute
actions.description: Tool to retrieve top filter values for a specific attribute from Algolia Analytics. Use when analyzing which filter values are most commonly used for a given attribute in search queries.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/AnalyticsGetTopFiltersNoResultsConnector
actions.label: Analytics: Get Top Filters No Results
actions.description: Tool to retrieve top filters for searches that returned no results from Algolia Analytics. Use when analyzing which filters are commonly applied to searches that yield zero results, helping identify potential catalog or filtering issues.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/AnalyticsGetTopHitsConnector
actions.label: Analytics: Get Top Hits
actions.description: Tool to retrieve the object IDs of the most frequent search results from Algolia Analytics. Returns up to 1,000 top hits ranked by frequency, optionally including click analytics (CTR, conversion rates) and revenue metrics. Use when analyzing which results appear most often in searches.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/AnalyticsGetTopSearchesConnector
actions.label: Analytics: Get Top Searches
actions.description: Tool to retrieve the most popular searches from Algolia Analytics. Returns search queries ranked by frequency, optionally including click analytics (CTR, conversion rates) and revenue metrics. Use when analyzing search behavior and identifying trending queries.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/AnalyticsGetUsersCountConnector
actions.label: Analytics: Get Users Count
actions.description: Tool to retrieve the number of unique users within a time range, including daily breakdown. Use when you need to analyze user engagement metrics for a specific index over a date range.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/ApiKeysCreateApiKeyConnector
actions.label: Api: Keys Create Api Key
actions.description: Tool to create a new API key with specific permissions and restrictions. Use when you need to generate API keys with custom ACL permissions, index restrictions, rate limits, or expiration times.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/ApiKeysDeleteApiKeyConnector
actions.label: Api: Keys Delete Api Key
actions.description: Tool to delete an API key. Use when you need to revoke or remove an existing API key from your Algolia application.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/ApiKeysGetApiKeyConnector
actions.label: Api: Keys Get Api Key
actions.description: Tool to retrieve the permissions and details of a specific API key. Use when you need to inspect an API key's ACL, restrictions, or other settings.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/ApiKeysListApiKeysConnector
actions.label: Api: Keys List Api Keys
actions.description: Tool to list all API keys associated with your Algolia application, including their permissions and restrictions. Use when you need to audit API key usage, check permissions, or manage access control. #### Output | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | Yes | Data from the action execution | | `error` | string | No | Error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | Yes | Whether or not the action execution was successful or not |

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/ApiKeysRestoreApiKeyConnector
actions.label: Api: Keys Restore Api Key
actions.description: Tool to restore a deleted API key within 72 hours of deletion. Use when you need to recover an accidentally deleted API key.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/ApiKeysUpdateApiKeyConnector
actions.label: Api: Keys Update Api Key
actions.description: Tool to update the permissions and settings of an existing API key. Use when you need to modify ACL permissions, index restrictions, rate limits, or other settings of an existing API key.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/AuthenticationsCreateAuthenticationConnector
actions.label: Authentications: Create Authentication
actions.description: Tool to create a new authentication resource in Algolia. Use when you need to set up authentication credentials for connecting to sources or destinations in the Algolia ingestion API.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/AuthenticationsDeleteAuthenticationConnector
actions.label: Authentications: Delete Authentication
actions.description: Tool to delete an authentication resource from Algolia. Use when you need to remove an existing authentication resource by its ID.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/AuthenticationsGetAuthenticationConnector
actions.label: Authentications: Get Authentication
actions.description: Tool to retrieve an authentication resource by its ID. Use when you need to fetch details about a specific authentication configuration in Algolia's ingestion API.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/AuthenticationsListAuthenticationsConnector
actions.label: Authentications: List Authentications
actions.description: Tool to list authentication resources from Algolia. Use when you need to retrieve available authentication configurations for sources or destinations.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/AuthenticationsSearchAuthenticationsConnector
actions.label: Authentications: Search Authentications
actions.description: Tool to search for authentication resources by IDs in Algolia. Use when you need to retrieve multiple specific authentication configurations by their IDs.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/AuthenticationsUpdateAuthenticationConnector
actions.label: Authentications: Update Authentication
actions.description: Tool to update an authentication resource in Algolia. Use when you need to modify the name or credentials of an existing authentication configuration.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/DestinationsCreateDestinationConnector
actions.label: Destinations: Create Destination
actions.description: Tool to create a new destination in Algolia Ingestion API. Use when you need to set up a new destination for data ingestion.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/DestinationsDeleteDestinationConnector
actions.label: Destinations: Delete Destination
actions.description: Tool to delete a destination in Algolia Ingestion API. Use when you need to permanently remove a destination by its ID.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/DestinationsGetDestinationConnector
actions.label: Destinations: Get Destination
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a destination by its ID. Use when you need to get details about a specific Algolia destination resource.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/DestinationsListDestinationsConnector
actions.label: Destinations: List Destinations
actions.description: Tool to list destinations in Algolia. Use when you need to retrieve all destinations or filter them by type, authentication ID, or transformation ID.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/DestinationsSearchDestinationsConnector
actions.label: Destinations: Search Destinations
actions.description: Tool to search for specific destinations by their IDs. Use when you need to retrieve multiple destinations at once by providing their unique identifiers.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/DestinationsUpdateDestinationConnector
actions.label: Destinations: Update Destination
actions.description: Tool to update a destination in Algolia Ingestion API. Use when you need to modify an existing destination's configuration, name, type, or associated transformations.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/DictionariesGetDictionaryLanguagesConnector
actions.label: Dictionaries: Get Dictionary Languages
actions.description: Tool to list available languages for dictionary entries. Use when you need to check which languages support custom dictionary entries (plurals, stopwords, compounds). #### Output | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | Yes | Data from the action execution | | `error` | string | No | Error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | Yes | Whether or not the action execution was successful or not |

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/DictionariesGetDictionarySettingsConnector
actions.label: Dictionaries: Get Dictionary Settings
actions.description: Tool to retrieve dictionary settings for all dictionaries. Use when you need to check which standard dictionary entries are disabled across different languages. #### Output | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | Yes | Data from the action execution | | `error` | string | No | Error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | Yes | Whether or not the action execution was successful or not |

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/DictionariesSearchDictionaryEntriesConnector
actions.label: Dictionaries: Search Dictionary Entries
actions.description: Tool to search dictionary entries in Algolia dictionaries. Use when you need to find stopwords, plurals, or compound words in specific dictionaries.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/DictionariesSetDictionarySettingsConnector
actions.label: Dictionaries: Set Dictionary Settings
actions.description: Tool to update dictionary settings for Algolia. Use when you need to enable or disable built-in stop words, plurals, or compounds for specific languages.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/DictionariesUpdateDictionaryEntriesConnector
actions.label: Dictionaries: Update Dictionary Entries
actions.description: Tool to add or delete dictionary entries in Algolia dictionaries. Use when you need to batch modify stopwords, plurals, or compound word entries.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/IndicesAddOrReplaceRecordConnector
actions.label: Indices: Add Or Replace Record
actions.description: Tool to add or replace a specific record in an index by objectID. If a record with the given objectID exists, it is replaced; otherwise, a new record is created. Use when you need to upsert an object with a known ID.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/IndicesAddRecordConnector
actions.label: Indices: Add Record
actions.description: Tool to add a record to an index with auto-generated objectID. Records with matching IDs are replaced. Use when you need to insert a new object into an index.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/IndicesBrowseIndexConnector
actions.label: Indices: Browse Index
actions.description: Tool to retrieve all records from an index. Use when you need to export or iterate through an entire index dataset.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/IndicesClearObjectsConnector
actions.label: Indices: Clear Objects
actions.description: Tool to clear records of an index without affecting settings. Use when you need to completely wipe all objects (e.g., after a bulk reindex) while preserving index configuration.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/IndicesCopyIndexConnector
actions.label: Indices: Copy Index
actions.description: Tool to copy the specified index to a new index. Use when you need to duplicate an existing index including records, settings, synonyms, and rules after confirming source and destination names.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/IndicesDeleteIndexConnector
actions.label: Indices: Delete Index
actions.description: Tool to delete the specified index and all its records. Use when you need to permanently remove an index after confirming it's no longer needed.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/IndicesDeleteObjectsConnector
actions.label: Indices: Delete Objects
actions.description: Tool to delete multiple records from an Algolia index. Use when you need to remove multiple objects by their IDs.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/IndicesDeleteRecordsByFilterConnector
actions.label: Indices: Delete Records By Filter
actions.description: Tool to delete records matching a filter from an Algolia index. Use when you need to remove multiple records based on filter criteria (e.g., category, tags, numeric ranges). This is a resource-intensive operation.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/IndicesExecuteBatchOnMultipleIndicesConnector
actions.label: Indices: Execute Batch On Multiple Indices
actions.description: Tool to perform batch operations (add, update, delete) across multiple Algolia indices in a single request. Use when you need to modify records in different indices efficiently. Each operation specifies its target index and action type.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/IndicesGetRecommendTaskStatusConnector
actions.label: Indices: Get Recommend Task Status
actions.description: Tool to check the status of a Recommend task. Use when you need to verify if an asynchronous Recommend operation (such as deleting a Recommend rule) has completed.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/IndicesGetRecordConnector
actions.label: Indices: Get Record
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a specific record from an index by its objectID. Use when you need to fetch a single object's details.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/IndicesGetSettingsConnector
actions.label: Indices: Get Settings
actions.description: Tool to retrieve the settings of a specified index. Use when you need to inspect index configurations after creation or update.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/IndicesGetTaskStatusConnector
actions.label: Indices: Get Task Status
actions.description: Tool to check the status of an asynchronous task. Use when you need to verify completion of operations like adding or deleting records.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/IndicesIndexExistsConnector
actions.label: Indices: Index Exists
actions.description: Tool to check if an Algolia index exists. Use before performing index operations to prevent accidental index creation. Results are scoped to the Algolia app ID configured in the Composio connection. Example: IndexExists(index_name='products').

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/IndicesListIndicesConnector
actions.label: Indices: List Indices
actions.description: Tool to list all indices and their metadata. Use when you need to retrieve index names, sizes, and state before performing operations that depend on index properties. #### Output | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | Yes | Data from the action execution | | `error` | string | No | Error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | Yes | Whether or not the action execution was successful or not |

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/IndicesPartialUpdateObjectsConnector
actions.label: Indices: Partial Update Objects
actions.description: Tool to partially update multiple records in the specified index. Use when you need to change only selected fields of many objects without replacing entire records. Use after confirming objectIDs and desired updates.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/IndicesSetSettingsConnector
actions.label: Indices: Set Settings
actions.description: Tool to update an Algolia index's settings. Use when you need to configure index behavior before indexing records. Example: set searchableAttributes and customRanking for products index.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/IndicesUpdateRecordPartiallyConnector
actions.label: Indices: Update Record Partially
actions.description: Tool to add or update attributes in a single record. Use when you need to modify specific fields without replacing the entire record. Creates a new record if the objectID doesn't exist (when create_if_not_exists is true).

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/InsightsClickedObjectIdsConnector
actions.label: Insights: Clicked Object Ids
actions.description: Tool to send a click event to Algolia to capture clicked items. Use immediately after a user click outside of search contexts to report click events.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/InsightsClickedObjectIdsAfterSearchConnector
actions.label: Insights: Clicked Object Ids After Search
actions.description: Tool to send a click event after a search response. Use when you want to report which items a user clicked in search results.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/InsightsConvertedObjectIdsConnector
actions.label: Insights: Converted Object Ids
actions.description: Tool to send a conversion event for items outside of search context. Use when tracking conversions on category pages or external flows unrelated to Algolia search.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/InsightsDeleteUserTokenConnector
actions.label: Insights: Delete User Token
actions.description: Tool to delete all events related to a user token from events metrics and analytics. Use when removing user data from Algolia Insights.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/InsightsInitInsightsConnector
actions.label: Insights: Init Insights
actions.description: Tool to initialize the Algolia Insights API client. Use before sending any Insights events.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/LogsGetLogsConnector
actions.label: Logs: Get Logs
actions.description: Tool to retrieve log entries for API requests made to your Algolia application. Use when you need to debug issues, monitor API usage, or analyze search patterns.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/PersonalizationComputeRealtimeUserConnector
actions.label: Personalization: Compute Realtime User
actions.description: Tool to compute a user's real-time personalization profile in Algolia. Use when you need to trigger calculation of personalization data for a specific user. Note: This endpoint is deprecated.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/PersonalizationDeleteUserProfileConnector
actions.label: Personalization: Delete User Profile
actions.description: Tool to delete a user profile from personalization. Use when you need to remove a user's personalization data and reset their profile.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/PersonalizationGetConfig2Connector
actions.label: Personalization: Get Config2
actions.description: Tool to retrieve the advanced personalization configuration. Use when you need to check personalization settings, re-ranking impact levels, or profile types for your Algolia application. #### Output | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | Yes | Data from the action execution | | `error` | string | No | Error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | Yes | Whether or not the action execution was successful or not |

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/PersonalizationGetUsersConnector
actions.label: Personalization: Get Users
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a list of user profiles from Algolia advanced personalization. Use when you need to fetch user affinities, filter by date ranges, or paginate through user data.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/PersonalizationSetPersonalizationStrategyConnector
actions.label: Personalization: Set Personalization Strategy
actions.description: Tool to define personalization strategy that controls how user behavior affects search results. Use when you need to configure which events and facets influence personalized search rankings.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/QuerySuggestionsCreateQsConfigConnector
actions.label: Query: Suggestions Create Qs Config
actions.description: Tool to create a new Query Suggestions configuration for an Algolia index. Use when you need to set up query suggestions to help users discover popular searches. Up to 100 configurations per application are supported.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/QuerySuggestionsDeleteConfigConnector
actions.label: Query: Suggestions Delete Config
actions.description: Tool to delete a Query Suggestions configuration for the specified index. Use when you need to remove a Query Suggestions configuration permanently.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/QuerySuggestionsGetConfigConnector
actions.label: Query: Suggestions Get Config
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a Query Suggestions configuration by index name. Use when you need to inspect or verify Query Suggestions settings for a specific index.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/QuerySuggestionsListQsConfigsConnector
actions.label: Query: Suggestions List Qs Configs
actions.description: Tool to retrieve all Query Suggestions configurations for an Algolia application. Use when you need to view or audit existing Query Suggestions setups.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/QuerySuggestionsUpdateConfigConnector
actions.label: Query: Suggestions Update Config
actions.description: Tool to update an existing Query Suggestions configuration. Use when you need to modify settings for query suggestions on an existing index.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/RulesClearRulesConnector
actions.label: Rules: Clear Rules
actions.description: Tool to delete all rules in an index. Use when you need to wipe all rules before re-creating them. Use after confirming no critical rules require retention.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/RulesCreateOrUpdateRecommendRulesConnector
actions.label: Rules: Create Or Update Recommend Rules
actions.description: Tool to create or update a batch of Recommend Rules in an index. Use when you need to add or modify multiple rules at once for a recommendation model. Each rule is created or updated depending on whether a rule with the same objectID already exists.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/RulesDeleteRecommendRuleConnector
actions.label: Rules: Delete Recommend Rule
actions.description: Tool to delete a Recommend rule from a recommendation scenario. Use when you need to remove a specific rule from an index's recommend model.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/RulesDeleteRuleConnector
actions.label: Rules: Delete Rule
actions.description: Tool to delete the specified rule from an index. Use when you need to permanently remove a rule after confirming its objectID.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/RulesExportRulesConnector
actions.label: Rules: Export Rules
actions.description: Tool to export all rules defined on an index. Use when you need to backup or migrate index rules.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/RulesGetRecommendRuleConnector
actions.label: Rules: Get Recommend Rule
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a Recommend rule that was previously created in the Algolia dashboard. Use when you need to inspect a specific rule's configuration, conditions, or consequences by its objectID.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/RulesGetRuleConnector
actions.label: Rules: Get Rule
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a specific rule by its objectID from an index. Use when you need to inspect a rule's configuration, conditions, and consequences.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/RulesReplaceAllRulesConnector
actions.label: Rules: Replace All Rules
actions.description: Tool to push a new set of rules, erasing previous ones. Use when you need zero-downtime atomic replacement of all rules in an index.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/RulesSaveRuleConnector
actions.label: Rules: Save Rule
actions.description: Tool to create or replace a rule in an index. Use when you need to add merchandising rules, query modifications, or conditional search behavior.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/RulesSearchRecommendRulesConnector
actions.label: Rules: Search Recommend Rules
actions.description: Tool to search for Recommend rules in the specified index and model. Use when you need to retrieve rules matching a query, or use an empty query to list all rules for this recommendation scenario.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/RunsListRunsConnector
actions.label: Runs: List Runs
actions.description: Tool to list task runs. Use when you need to retrieve and monitor task execution status, filter by time range, or paginate through run history.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/SearchFindObjectConnector
actions.label: Search: Find Object
actions.description: Tool to find the first object matching a query or filter in an index. Use when debugging relevance or filter logic after confirming index exists.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/SearchGetObjectPositionConnector
actions.label: Search: Get Object Position
actions.description: Tool to retrieve an object’s position in a result set. Use when debugging relevance after performing a search query.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/SearchGetObjectsConnector
actions.label: Search: Get Objects
actions.description: Tool to retrieve multiple records from an index. Use when you need to batch-fetch several objectIDs in one call.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/SearchSearchFacetValuesConnector
actions.label: Search: Search Facet Values
actions.description: Tool to search for values of a specified facet attribute. Use when you need to find specific facet values that match a query string. Facet values are sorted by decreasing count by default.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/SearchSearchIndexConnector
actions.label: Search: Search Index
actions.description: Tool to perform a search on a specified Algolia index. Use after confirming the index name. Example: SearchIndex(index_name='contacts', query='apple', search_params={'hitsPerPage':10})

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/SearchSearchMultipleIndicesConnector
actions.label: Search: Search Multiple Indices
actions.description: Tool to perform searches across multiple indices in a single call. Use when you need to batch multiple index queries into one API request.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/SourcesCreateSourceConnector
actions.label: Sources: Create Source
actions.description: Tool to create a new data source in Algolia Ingestion API. Use when you need to set up a new source for data ingestion from external platforms or custom data feeds.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/SourcesDeleteSourceConnector
actions.label: Sources: Delete Source
actions.description: Tool to delete a source from the Algolia Ingestion API. Use when you need to permanently remove a source after confirming it's no longer needed.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/SourcesGetSourceConnector
actions.label: Sources: Get Source
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a source from the Algolia Ingestion API. Use when you need to get details about a specific data source by its ID.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/SourcesListSourcesConnector
actions.label: Sources: List Sources
actions.description: Tool to list sources from the Algolia Ingestion API. Use when you need to retrieve available data sources for ingestion pipelines. Supports filtering by type and authentication ID, with pagination and sorting options.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/SourcesSearchSourcesConnector
actions.label: Sources: Search Sources
actions.description: Tool to search for sources by IDs in Algolia Ingestion API. Use when you need to retrieve multiple specific data sources by their IDs.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/SourcesUpdateSourceConnector
actions.label: Sources: Update Source
actions.description: Tool to update a source in the Algolia Ingestion API. Use when you need to modify the name, authentication, or input configuration of an existing data source.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/SourcesValidateSourceConnector
actions.label: Sources: Validate Source
actions.description: Tool to validate a source payload before creating it in Algolia. Use when you need to verify that a source configuration is valid before actually creating the source.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/SourcesValidateSourceBeforeUpdateConnector
actions.label: Sources: Validate Source Before Update
actions.description: Tool to validate a source update payload in the Algolia Ingestion API. Use when you need to verify that an update to a source configuration is valid before actually updating it.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/SynonymsClearSynonymsConnector
actions.label: Synonyms: Clear Synonyms
actions.description: Tool to delete all synonyms from an index. Use when you need to remove all synonym definitions in one operation.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/SynonymsDeleteSynonymConnector
actions.label: Synonyms: Delete Synonym
actions.description: Tool to delete a synonym from a specified index. Use when you need to remove an existing synonym by its objectID.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/SynonymsGetSynonymConnector
actions.label: Synonyms: Get Synonym
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a specific synonym by its objectID. Use when you need to fetch details of an existing synonym from an index.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/SynonymsSaveSynonymConnector
actions.label: Synonyms: Save Synonym
actions.description: Tool to add or update a synonym in the specified index. Use when you need programmatic upsert of search synonyms after index creation.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/SynonymsSaveSynonymsConnector
actions.label: Synonyms: Save Synonyms
actions.description: Tool to batch create or replace synonyms in an Algolia index. If a synonym with the objectID doesn't exist, Algolia adds a new one. Use when you need to add or update multiple synonyms at once.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/SynonymsSearchSynonymsConnector
actions.label: Synonyms: Search Synonyms
actions.description: Tool to search for synonyms in the specified index. Use when you need to retrieve synonyms matching a query or filter by type.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/TasksCreateIngestionTaskConnector
actions.label: Tasks: Create Ingestion Task
actions.description: Tool to create a new ingestion task connecting a source to a destination in Algolia. Use when you need to set up data synchronization between a source and an Algolia index.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/TasksDisableTaskV1Connector
actions.label: Tasks: Disable Task V1
actions.description: Tool to disable a task V1 in Algolia Ingestion API. Use when you need to disable a specific task. Note: This API is deprecated but still functional.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/TasksEnableTaskV1Connector
actions.label: Tasks: Enable Task V1
actions.description: Tool to enable a task V1 in Algolia Ingestion API. Use when you need to activate a previously disabled task. Note: This API is deprecated but still functional.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/TasksGetAppTaskConnector
actions.label: Tasks: Get App Task
actions.description: Tool to check the status of an application task. Use when you need to verify if a task has completed.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/TasksGetTaskV1Connector
actions.label: Tasks: Get Task V1
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a task V1 from Algolia Ingestion API. Use when you need to fetch details about a specific task. Note: This API is deprecated but still functional.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/TasksListIngestionTasksConnector
actions.label: Tasks: List Ingestion Tasks
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a list of ingestion tasks from Algolia. Use when you need to fetch configured tasks for ingestion pipelines. Supports filtering by various criteria such as source, destination, trigger type, action, and enabled status, with pagination and sorting.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/TasksPushTaskConnector
actions.label: Tasks: Push Task
actions.description: Tool to push records to an Algolia task by task ID. Use when you need to send data to a configured ingestion task. Note: tasks with source type 'json' cannot use this endpoint.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/TasksReplaceTaskConnector
actions.label: Tasks: Replace Task
actions.description: Tool to fully replace a task in Algolia Ingestion API. Use when you need to completely update a task with new configuration, replacing all existing settings.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/TasksRunTaskV1Connector
actions.label: Tasks: Run Task V1
actions.description: Tool to run a task V1 from Algolia Ingestion API. Use when you need to manually trigger a task execution. Note: This API is deprecated but still functional.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/TasksSearchTasksV1Connector
actions.label: Tasks: Search Tasks V1
actions.description: Tool to search for tasks V1 from Algolia Ingestion API. Use when you need to retrieve details about multiple specific tasks by their IDs. Note: This API is deprecated.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/TasksUpdateTaskConnector
actions.label: Tasks: Update Task
actions.description: Tool to partially update a task in Algolia Ingestion API. Use when you need to modify task configuration such as schedule, failure threshold, destination, or notification settings.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/TransformationsCreateTransformationConnector
actions.label: Transformations: Create Transformation
actions.description: Tool to create a new transformation in Algolia Ingestion API. Use when you need to set up data transformations for enriching or modifying records during ingestion.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/TransformationsDeleteTransformationConnector
actions.label: Transformations: Delete Transformation
actions.description: Tool to delete a transformation in Algolia Ingestion API. Use when you need to permanently remove a transformation by its ID.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/TransformationsGetTransformationConnector
actions.label: Transformations: Get Transformation
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a transformation by its ID from Algolia's Ingestion API. Use when you need to fetch details about a specific transformation including its code, configuration, and metadata.

actions.name: Corsair/Algolia/TransformationsListTransformationsConnector
actions.label: Transformations: List Transformations
actions.description: Tool to list all transformations in Algolia Ingestion API. Use when you need to retrieve transformation configurations, filter by type, or paginate through transformation lists.

Supports direct base64-encoded content or S3 key references from other actions.

actions.name: Corsair/Anchorbrowser/BatchSessionsGetBatchSessionStatusConnector
actions.label: Batch: Sessions Get Batch Session Status

actions.name: Corsair/Anchorbrowser/DownloadsListSessionDownloadsConnector

actions.name: Corsair/Anchorbrowser/EventsSignalEventConnector
actions.label: Events: Signal Event

actions.name: Corsair/Anchorbrowser/EventsWaitForEventConnector

actions.description: Blocks execution until a specific named event is signaled or the timeout expires. Used for cross-session coordination, MFA handling, and workflow synchronization. The event must first be signaled using the Signal Event action. Returns the data payload that was sent with the signal. Events are user-scoped.

actions.name: Corsair/Anchorbrowser/ExtensionsDeleteExtensionConnector

actions.name: Corsair/Anchorbrowser/ExtensionsListExtensionsConnector

actions.name: Corsair/Anchorbrowser/ExtensionsUploadExtensionConnector

actions.name: Corsair/Anchorbrowser/OsLevelDoubleClickMouseConnector

actions.name: Corsair/Anchorbrowser/OsLevelDragAndDropConnector

actions.name: Corsair/Anchorbrowser/OsLevelGetClipboardContentConnector

actions.name: Corsair/Anchorbrowser/OsLevelMoveMouseConnector

actions.name: Corsair/Anchorbrowser/OsLevelNavigateToUrlConnector

actions.name: Corsair/Anchorbrowser/OsLevelPasteTextConnector

actions.name: Corsair/Anchorbrowser/OsLevelReleaseMouseButtonConnector

actions.name: Corsair/Anchorbrowser/OsLevelSetClipboardContentConnector

actions.name: Corsair/Anchorbrowser/OsLevelTypeTextConnector
