actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedPutV2ListsListEntriesConnector
actions.label: Generated: Put V2 Lists List Entries
actions.description: Tool to create or update a list entry for a given parent record in Attio. If an entry with the specified parent record is found, that entry will be updated. If no such entry is found, a new entry will be created instead. For multiselect attributes, all values will be either created or deleted as necessary to match the list of values supplied in the request.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedAssertPersonConnector
actions.label: Generated: Assert Person
actions.description: Tool to create or update person records using a unique attribute to search for existing people. Use when you want to ensure a person exists with specific details without creating duplicates.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedPutV2ObjectsObjectRecordsConnector
actions.label: Generated: Put V2 Objects Object Records
actions.description: Tool to create or update people, companies and other records in Attio using a matching attribute. Use when you want to avoid duplicate records - if a record with the same value for the matching attribute is found, it will be updated; otherwise a new record is created. If you want to avoid matching and always create new records, use the Create Record endpoint instead.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedAssertUserRecordConnector
actions.label: Generated: Assert User Record
actions.description: Creates or updates a user record in Attio using a unique attribute to search for existing users. If a user is found with the same value for the matching attribute, that user will be updated. If no user is found, a new one will be created. Use this to ensure user records exist without duplicates.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedAssertWorkspaceConnector
actions.label: Generated: Assert Workspace
actions.description: Creates or updates a workspace record in Attio using a unique attribute to search for existing workspaces. If a workspace is found with the same value for the matching attribute, that workspace will be updated. If no workspace is found, a new one will be created.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedCreateAttributeConnector
actions.label: Generated: Create Attribute
actions.description: Tool to create a new attribute on an object or list in Attio. Use when you need to add custom fields to track additional information. For record-reference types, you can establish bidirectional relationships by supplying a relationship object.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedCreateCommentConnector
actions.label: Generated: Create Comment
actions.description: Tool to create a new comment on a thread, record, or list entry in Attio. Use when you need to add a comment to an existing conversation, a record (like a person, company, or deal), or a list entry.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedCreateCompanyConnector
actions.label: Generated: Create Company
actions.description: Creates a new company record in Attio. This endpoint will throw an error on conflicts of unique attributes like domains. If you prefer to update company records on conflicts, use the Assert company record endpoint instead. Note: The logo_url attribute cannot currently be set via the API.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedCreateDealRecordConnector
actions.label: Generated: Create Deal Record
actions.description: Tool to create a new deal record in Attio. Use when you need to track a new sales opportunity or deal. This endpoint will throw an error on conflicts of unique attributes. Minimal requirement is providing at least one attribute value.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedCreateEntryConnector
actions.label: Generated: Create Entry
actions.description: DEPRECATED: Use ATTIO_ATTIO_POST_V2_LISTS_LIST_ENTRIES instead. Tool to add a record to a list as a new list entry in Attio. Use when you need to organize records into specific lists. Throws errors on unique attribute conflicts. Multiple list entries are allowed for the same parent record.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedCreateListConnector
actions.label: Generated: Create List
actions.description: Tool to create a new list in Attio. Use when you need to organize records into custom lists. Once created, add attributes using the Create Attribute API and add records using the Create Entry API. New lists must have either workspace_access set to 'full-access' or one or more workspace_member_access with 'full-access' level.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedPostV2ListsListEntriesConnector
actions.label: Generated: Post V2 Lists List Entries
actions.description: Tool to add a record to a list as a new list entry in Attio. Use when you need to organize records into specific lists. This endpoint will throw on conflicts of unique attributes. Multiple list entries are allowed for the same parent record.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedCreateNoteConnector
actions.label: Generated: Create Note
actions.description: This tool creates a new note on a given record in Attio. The note can be attached to any record type (like person, company, or deal) and includes a title and content. It requires parameters such as parent_object, parent_record_id, title, and content, with an optional created_at timestamp.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedCreateObjectConnector
actions.label: Generated: Create Object
actions.description: Tool to create a new custom object in your Attio workspace. Use when you need to add a new object type beyond the standard objects (people, companies, deals, users, workspaces). Requires api_slug (snake_case identifier), singular_noun, and plural_noun.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedCreatePersonConnector
actions.label: Generated: Create Person
actions.description: Creates a new person record in Attio. This endpoint will throw an error on conflicts of unique attributes like email_addresses. If you prefer to update person records on conflicts instead, use the Assert person record endpoint. Note: The avatar_url attribute cannot currently be set via the API.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedCreateRecordConnector
actions.label: Generated: Create Record
actions.description: This tool creates a new record in Attio for a specified object type (people, companies, deals, users, workspaces, etc.). It requires the object type and a values dictionary containing the attributes for the new record. IMPORTANT: Different object types have different attributes. For example: - 'people' object uses: name, email_addresses, phone_numbers, primary_location, job_title, etc. - 'users' object uses: primary_email_address, user_id, person, workspace - 'companies' object uses: name, domains, description, etc. Always verify the correct attribute names for your target object type before creating records. Use the List Attributes API or check your workspace to see available attributes for each object type.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedCreateSelectOptionConnector
actions.label: Generated: Create Select Option
actions.description: Tool to add a new select option to a select or multiselect attribute in Attio. Use when you need to add a new choice to an existing select field.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedCreateStatusConnector
actions.label: Generated: Create Status
actions.description: Tool to add a new status to a status attribute on either an object or a list. Use when you need to create a new status option for status attributes. Company and person objects do not support status attributes at this time.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedCreateTaskConnector
actions.label: Generated: Create Task
actions.description: Tool to create a new task in Attio. Use when you need to add a task with content and optional deadline, assignees, or linked records. Note: Tasks can only be created from plaintext without record reference formatting.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedCreateUserRecordConnector
actions.label: Generated: Create User Record
actions.description: Creates a new user record in Attio. User records represent workspace members or users in the system. Requires primary_email_address, user_id, and workspace_id. Optionally link to an existing person record. Note: Required attributes may vary based on workspace configuration - check the List Attributes action if you encounter missing_value errors.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedCreateWebhookConnector
actions.label: Generated: Create Webhook
actions.description: Tool to create a webhook and subscribe to events in Attio. Use when you need to set up a new webhook endpoint to receive real-time event notifications. Returns the webhook configuration including a one-time signing secret for verifying event authenticity.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedCreateWorkspaceRecordConnector
actions.label: Generated: Create Workspace Record
actions.description: Creates a new workspace record in Attio. The workspace_id field is required and must be unique. This endpoint will throw an error on conflicts of unique attributes. Use when you need to create a new workspace entry in your Attio workspace.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedPostV2ObjectsObjectRecordsConnector
actions.label: Generated: Post V2 Objects Object Records
actions.description: Creates a new person, company or other record. This endpoint will throw on conflicts of unique attributes. If you would prefer to update records on conflicts, please use the Assert record endpoint instead.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedDeleteCommentConnector
actions.label: Generated: Delete Comment
actions.description: Tool to delete a comment by its comment_id. Use when you need to remove a comment from Attio. If the comment is at the head of a thread, all messages in the thread are also deleted. The operation is permanent and cannot be undone.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedDeleteCompanyConnector
actions.label: Generated: Delete Company

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedDeleteDealConnector
actions.label: Generated: Delete Deal
actions.description: Tool to delete a deal record from Attio by its record_id. Use when you need to permanently remove a deal record. The deletion is irreversible and cannot be recovered.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedDeleteEntryConnector
actions.label: Generated: Delete Entry
actions.description: Tool to delete a single list entry by its entry_id in Attio. Use when you need to remove an entry from a specific list. The operation is permanent and cannot be undone.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedDeleteNoteConnector
actions.label: Generated: Delete Note
actions.description: This tool allows users to delete a specific note in Attio by its ID. It is implemented via DELETE https://api.attio.com/v2/notes/{note_id} and handles note deletion by validating the provided note_id. It complements ATTIO_CREATE_NOTE functionality, providing complete note management capabilities within the Attio platform.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedDeletePersonConnector
actions.label: Generated: Delete Person
actions.description: Tool to delete a person record from Attio by its record_id. Use when you need to permanently remove a person record. The deletion is irreversible and cannot be recovered.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedDeleteRecordConnector
actions.label: Generated: Delete Record
actions.description: This tool allows you to delete a record from Attio permanently. The deletion is irreversible, and the data will eventually be removed from the system.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedDeleteRecordByIdConnector
actions.label: Generated: Delete Record By Id
actions.description: Tool to delete a single record (e.g. a company or person) by ID. Use when you need to permanently remove a record from Attio.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedDeleteTaskConnector
actions.label: Generated: Delete Task
actions.description: Tool to delete a task by its task_id. Use when you need to remove a task from Attio. The operation is permanent and cannot be undone.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedDeleteUserConnector
actions.label: Generated: Delete User
actions.description: Tool to delete a user record from Attio by its record_id. Use when you need to permanently remove a user record. The deletion is irreversible and cannot be recovered.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedDeleteWebhookConnector
actions.label: Generated: Delete Webhook
actions.description: Tool to delete a webhook by its webhook_id. Use when you need to remove a webhook subscription from Attio. The operation is permanent and cannot be undone.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedDeleteWorkspaceRecordConnector
actions.label: Generated: Delete Workspace Record
actions.description: Tool to delete a workspace record from Attio by its record_id. Use when you need to permanently remove a workspace record. The deletion is irreversible and cannot be recovered.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedFindRecordConnector

actions.description: This tool allows users to find a record in Attio by either its unique ID or by searching using unique attributes. actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedGetDealRecordConnector

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedGetNoteConnector

actions.label: Generated: List Lists
actions.description: This tool retrieves all lists available in the Attio workspace, sorted as they appear in the sidebar. Returns list metadata only (names, IDs, configuration) — not the records/entries within those lists. To fetch actual list entries, use ATTIO_FIND_RECORD with appropriate filters. This tool is a prerequisite for many list-related operations. Requires the list_configuration:read permission scope.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedListMeetingsConnector
actions.label: Generated: List Meetings
actions.description: Tool to list all meetings in the workspace using a deterministic sort order. Use when you need to retrieve meetings, optionally filtering by participants, linked records, or time ranges. This endpoint is in beta.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedListNotesConnector
actions.label: Generated: List Notes
actions.description: Lists notes in Attio. Can list all notes in the workspace, or filter by parent object type and/or specific record. Notes are returned in reverse chronological order (newest first).

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedListObjectsConnector
actions.label: Generated: List Objects
actions.description: This tool retrieves a list of all available objects (both system-defined and user-defined) in the Attio workspace via GET /v2/objects, returning key metadata including slugs and IDs for each object. Call this tool first before ATTIO_LIST_RECORDS, ATTIO_FIND_RECORD, or ATTIO_CREATE_RECORD to discover valid object slugs — hardcoded slugs may not exist across workspaces. Concepts like tasks may be modeled as deals or custom objects rather than dedicated types, so confirm the correct object type before proceeding. Attribute values in responses can be arrays of time-bounded entries rather than simple scalars; downstream code must handle nested structures.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedListPeopleAttributeValuesConnector
actions.label: Generated: List People Attribute Values
actions.description: Tool to get all values for a given attribute on a person record. Use when you need to retrieve current or historic values for a specific person attribute. Historic values can be queried using the show_historic param but cannot be queried on COMINT or enriched attributes (returns 400 error).

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedListPeopleRecordEntriesConnector
actions.label: Generated: List People Record Entries
actions.description: Tool to list all entries across all lists for which a person record is the parent in Attio. Use when you need to see which lists a particular person record belongs to. Returns list information and entry IDs for each list the person appears in.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedPeopleListPersonsConnector
actions.label: Generated: People List Persons
actions.description: Tool to list person records from Attio with optional filtering and sorting. Use when you need to retrieve people based on specific criteria or get a paginated list of all people.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedListRecordAttributeValuesConnector
actions.label: Generated: List Record Attribute Values
actions.description: Tool to retrieve all values for a specified attribute on a record in Attio. Use when you need to see the history of values for a specific attribute. Can return only active values or include historical values. Historic values cannot be queried on COMINT or enriched attributes.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedGetRecordEntriesConnector
actions.label: Generated: Get Record Entries
actions.description: Tool to list all entries, across all lists, for which a record is the parent. Use when you need to find which lists a specific record belongs to. Returns list IDs, slugs, entry IDs, and creation timestamps.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedListRecordEntriesConnector
actions.label: Generated: List Record Entries
actions.description: Tool to list all entries across all lists for which a record is the parent in Attio. Use when you need to see which lists a particular record belongs to. Returns list information and entry IDs for each list the record appears in.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedListRecordsConnector
actions.label: Generated: List Records
actions.description: This tool lists records from a specific object type in Attio. It provides simple pagination support and returns records in creation order (oldest first). For complex filtering, use the FindRecord action instead. Standard object types include: people, companies, deals, users, workspaces. If you get a 404 error, verify the object type exists using the List Objects action first. Response attribute values are returned as arrays of time-bounded objects under a `values` map (e.g., `values['name']`), not simple scalars — handle arrays, nested objects, and empty arrays accordingly. Select attributes are accessed via `option.title`; currency, stage, and select fields may be null or empty arrays. Access records via `data.data` in the response.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedPostV2ObjectsObjectRecordsQueryConnector
actions.label: Generated: Post V2 Objects Object Records Query
actions.description: Tool to list people, company or other records in Attio with the option to filter and sort results. Use when you need to retrieve records based on complex filter criteria or sorting requirements.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedGetV2TasksConnector
actions.label: Generated: Get V2 Tasks
actions.description: Tool to list all tasks in the workspace. Use when you need to retrieve tasks, optionally filtering by assignee, completion status, or linked records. Results are sorted by creation date from oldest to newest by default.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedListThreadsConnector
actions.label: Generated: List Threads
actions.description: Tool to list threads of comments on a record or list entry in Attio. Use when you need to view all comment threads associated with a specific record or list entry. Threads contain one or more comments sorted chronologically.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedListUserRecordEntriesConnector
actions.label: Generated: List User Record Entries
actions.description: Tool to list all entries across all lists for which a user record is the parent in Attio. Use when you need to see which lists a particular user record belongs to. Returns list information and entry IDs for each list the user appears in.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedListUserRecordsConnector
actions.label: Generated: List User Records
actions.description: Tool to list user records in Attio with optional filtering and sorting. Use when you need to retrieve workspace members or user records based on specific criteria.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedListWebhooksConnector
actions.label: Generated: List Webhooks
actions.description: Tool to get all webhooks in your Attio workspace. Use when you need to retrieve a list of configured webhooks, their subscriptions, and statuses. Supports pagination via limit and offset parameters.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedListWorkspaceMembersConnector
actions.label: Generated: List Workspace Members
actions.description: Tool to list workspace members (actors) so agents can reliably assign owners and resolve workspace-member IDs even when the optional Users standard object is disabled. Use when writing or assigning actor-reference attributes (e.g., record/list entry owners) that require referenced_actor_type=workspace-member and an actor id.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedListWorkspaceRecordAttributeValuesConnector
actions.label: Generated: List Workspace Record Attribute Values
actions.description: Tool to retrieve all values for a specified attribute on a workspace record in Attio. Use when you need to see the history of values for a specific attribute on a workspace record. Can return only active values or include all historical values sorted chronologically.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedListWorkspaceRecordEntriesConnector
actions.label: Generated: List Workspace Record Entries
actions.description: Tool to list all entries across all lists for which a workspace record is the parent in Attio. Use when you need to see which lists a particular workspace record belongs to. Returns list information and entry IDs for each list the workspace appears in.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedListWorkspaceRecordsConnector
actions.label: Generated: List Workspace Records
actions.description: Tool to list workspace records with filtering and sorting options. Use when you need to retrieve workspace-level records from Attio. Records are returned based on the filters and sorts provided. Requires record_permission:read and object_configuration:read scopes.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedPatchRecordConnector
actions.label: Generated: Patch Record
actions.description: Tool to update people, companies, and other records by record_id using PATCH method. For multiselect attributes, values supplied will be prepended to existing values. Use PUT endpoint to overwrite or remove multiselect values.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedPutV2ObjectsObjectRecordsRecordIdConnector
actions.label: Generated: Put V2 Objects Object Records Record Id
actions.description: Tool to update people, companies, and other records by record_id using PUT method. For multiselect attributes, values supplied will overwrite/remove existing values. Use PATCH endpoint to append without removing.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedQueryRecordsConnector
actions.label: Generated: Query Records
actions.description: Tool to query records for a specific Attio object using server-side filtering operators and sorting. Use when you need to retrieve records based on complex filter criteria (e.g., 'get all agreements where product=X and status in Y') rather than simple listing or ID-based lookup. This avoids downloading large pages and filtering locally, which is slow and costly.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedSearchRecordsConnector
actions.label: Generated: Search Records
actions.description: Tool to fuzzy search for records across multiple objects in Attio. Use when you need to find records by name, domain, email, phone number, or social handle. This endpoint is in beta and returns eventually consistent results. Matching strategy follows the in-product search approach.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedPostV2ObjectsRecordsSearchConnector

actions.description: Tool to fuzzy search for records across one or more objects in Attio. Use when you need to find records by name, domain, email, phone number, or social handle. This endpoint is in beta and returns eventually consistent results. For results guaranteed to be up to date, use the record query endpoint instead.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedUpdateAttributeConnector

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedUpdateListConnector

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedPutV2ListsListEntriesEntryIdConnector

Use the PATCH endpoint to add multiselect attribute values without removing those that already exist.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedUpdateObjectConnector

actions.description: Tool to update a single object's configuration in Attio. Use when you need to modify an object's API slug, singular noun, or plural noun. Standard objects (people, companies, deals, users, workspaces) and custom objects can be updated.

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedUpdatePersonConnector

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedUpdateStatusConnector

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedUpdateTaskConnector

actions.name: Corsair/Attio/GeneratedUpdateUserRecordConnector

actions.name: Corsair/Basecamp/CardTablesRepositionCardStepConnector

actions.description: Tool to change the position of a step within a card. Use when you need to reorder steps in a card table card by moving a step to a specific position.

actions.name: Corsair/Basecamp/CardTablesUnwatchCardTableColumnConnector
actions.label: Card: Tables Unwatch Card Table Column
actions.description: Tool to stop watching a card table column. Use when you want to unsubscribe from a specific column and no longer receive notifications about changes to it.

actions.name: Corsair/Basecamp/CardTablesUpdateCardConnector
actions.label: Card: Tables Update Card
actions.description: Tool to update a card's details in a Basecamp card table. Use when you need to modify a card's title, content, due date, or assignees.

actions.name: Corsair/Basecamp/CardTablesUpdateCardTableColumnConnector
actions.label: Card: Tables Update Card Table Column
actions.description: Tool to update a card table column's properties in a Basecamp project. Use when you need to modify a column's title or description.

actions.name: Corsair/Basecamp/CardTablesWatchCardTableColumnConnector
actions.label: Card: Tables Watch Card Table Column
actions.description: Tool to start watching a card table column in a Basecamp project. Use when you need to subscribe to a specific column to receive notifications about changes.

actions.name: Corsair/Basecamp/SchedulesAndReportsGetBucketsSchedulesEntriesConnector
actions.label: Schedules: And Reports Get Buckets Schedules Entries
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of schedule entries from a schedule. Use when you need to fetch entries from a specific schedule in a Basecamp project.

actions.name: Corsair/Basecamp/SchedulesAndReportsGetReportsTimesheetConnector
actions.label: Schedules: And Reports Get Reports Timesheet
actions.description: Tool to retrieve all timesheet entries across the Basecamp account within a given timeframe. Use when you need to generate time reports, track hours logged, or analyze time entries by person or project. Without date parameters, returns only the last month of entries.

actions.name: Corsair/Basecamp/SchedulesAndReportsGetScheduleConnector
actions.label: Schedules: And Reports Get Schedule
actions.description: Tool to retrieve schedule details for a specific project. Use when you need information about a schedule including entries count and configuration.

actions.name: Corsair/Basecamp/SchedulesAndReportsGetScheduleEntryConnector
actions.label: Schedules: And Reports Get Schedule Entry
actions.description: Tool to get a specific schedule entry by ID from a Basecamp project. Use when you need to retrieve details about a scheduled event including its time, participants, and metadata.

actions.name: Corsair/Basecamp/SchedulesAndReportsPostBucketsSchedulesEntriesConnector
actions.label: Schedules: And Reports Post Buckets Schedules Entries
actions.description: Tool to create a schedule entry in a Basecamp schedule within a project. Use when you need to add a new event with start/end times and optional participants.

actions.name: Corsair/Basecamp/SchedulesAndReportsPutBucketsScheduleEntriesConnector
actions.label: Schedules: And Reports Put Buckets Schedule Entries
actions.description: Tool to update an existing schedule entry in a Basecamp schedule. Use when you need to modify an entry's title, times, description, or participants. Omitted parameters remain unchanged.

actions.name: Corsair/Basecamp/SchedulesAndReportsPutBucketsSchedulesConnector
actions.label: Schedules: And Reports Put Buckets Schedules
actions.description: Tool to update a schedule configuration in a Basecamp project. Use when you need to change whether the schedule includes due assignments from to-dos, cards and steps.

actions.name: Corsair/Basecamp/SchedulesAndReportsUpdateScheduleEntryConnector
actions.label: Schedules: And Reports Update Schedule Entry
actions.description: Tool to update an existing schedule entry in a Basecamp project schedule. Use when you need to modify details like title, dates, description, or participants. Omitted parameters remain unchanged.

actions.name: Corsair/Basecamp/AutomaticCheckInsGetBucketsQuestionAnswersConnector
actions.label: Automatic: Check Ins Get Buckets Question Answers
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a specific question answer by ID from a Basecamp project. Use when you need to fetch details about an automatic check-in question answer including its content, creator, and associated comments.

actions.name: Corsair/Basecamp/AutomaticCheckInsGetBucketsQuestionnairesConnector
actions.label: Automatic: Check Ins Get Buckets Questionnaires
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a specific questionnaire (automatic check-ins) from a Basecamp project. Use when you need to fetch details about a questionnaire including its questions count and metadata.

actions.name: Corsair/Basecamp/AutomaticCheckInsGetBucketsQuestionnairesQuestionsConnector
actions.label: Automatic: Check Ins Get Buckets Questionnaires Questions
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of questions from a questionnaire in a Basecamp project. Use when you need to fetch questions from a specific questionnaire.

actions.name: Corsair/Basecamp/AutomaticCheckInsGetBucketsQuestionsConnector
actions.label: Automatic: Check Ins Get Buckets Questions
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a specific check-in question by ID from a Basecamp project. Use when you already know the question ID and need its details without listing all questions from a questionnaire.

actions.name: Corsair/Basecamp/AutomaticCheckInsListQuestionsConnector
actions.label: Automatic: Check Ins List Questions
actions.description: Tool to get all questions in a questionnaire from a Basecamp project. Use when you need to fetch questions from a specific questionnaire.

actions.name: Corsair/Basecamp/InboxesAndForwardsGetBucketsInboxesForwardsConnector
actions.label: Inboxes: And Forwards Get Buckets Inboxes Forwards
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of active email forwards from a project's inbox. Use when you need to fetch forwarded emails in a Basecamp inbox.

actions.name: Corsair/Basecamp/InboxesAndForwardsGetInboxConnector
actions.label: Inboxes: And Forwards Get Inbox
actions.description: Tool to get the inbox (email forwards) for a Basecamp project. Use when you need to retrieve details about a specific inbox including its forwards count and metadata.

actions.name: Corsair/Basecamp/InboxesAndForwardsListForwardsConnector
actions.label: Inboxes: And Forwards List Forwards
actions.description: Tool to get all email forwards in an inbox. Use when you need to retrieve forwarded emails from a Basecamp project inbox.

actions.name: Corsair/Basecamp/RecordingsAndSubscriptionsDeleteBucketsRecordingsPinConnector
actions.label: Recordings: And Subscriptions Delete Buckets Recordings Pin
actions.description: Tool to unpin a recording (message) in a Basecamp project. Use when you need to remove the pinned status from a message on a message board or project.

actions.name: Corsair/Basecamp/RecordingsAndSubscriptionsGetBucketsRecordingsCommentsConnector
actions.label: Recordings: And Subscriptions Get Buckets Recordings Comments
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of active comments on a recording. Use when you need to fetch comments from a specific recording in a Basecamp project.

actions.name: Corsair/Basecamp/RecordingsAndSubscriptionsGetBucketsRecordingsEventsConnector
actions.label: Recordings: And Subscriptions Get Buckets Recordings Events
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of events for a recording. Use when you need to fetch change history from a specific recording in a Basecamp project.

actions.name: Corsair/Basecamp/RecordingsAndSubscriptionsGetCommentConnector
actions.label: Recordings: And Subscriptions Get Comment
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a specific comment by ID from a Basecamp project. Use when you need to fetch details about a particular comment including its content, creator, and parent resource.

actions.name: Corsair/Basecamp/RecordingsAndSubscriptionsGetProjectsRecordingsConnector
actions.label: Recordings: And Subscriptions Get Projects Recordings
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of records for a given type of recording across projects. Use when you need to list recordings of a specific type (Message, Document, Todo, etc.) with optional filtering by project, status, and sorting.

actions.name: Corsair/Basecamp/RecordingsAndSubscriptionsGetSubscriptionConnector
actions.label: Recordings: And Subscriptions Get Subscription
actions.description: Tool to get subscription information for a recording. Use when you need to check subscription status, view subscriber count, or get detailed information about all subscribers for a specific recording.

actions.name: Corsair/Basecamp/RecordingsAndSubscriptionsListCommentsConnector
actions.label: Recordings: And Subscriptions List Comments
actions.description: Tool to get all comments on a recording in a Basecamp project. Use when you need to retrieve the list of active comments with their content, creators, and metadata.

actions.name: Corsair/Basecamp/RecordingsAndSubscriptionsListEventsConnector
actions.label: Recordings: And Subscriptions List Events
actions.description: Tool to get all events (history) for a recording. Use when you need to retrieve the complete modification history of a specific recording in a Basecamp project.

actions.name: Corsair/Basecamp/RecordingsAndSubscriptionsPostBucketsRecordingsCommentsConnector
actions.label: Recordings: And Subscriptions Post Buckets Recordings Comments
actions.description: Tool to publish a comment on a recording within a Basecamp project. Use when you need to add a comment with rich text to any recording such as a todolist, message, or document.

actions.name: Corsair/Basecamp/RecordingsAndSubscriptionsPostBucketsRecordingsPinConnector
actions.label: Recordings: And Subscriptions Post Buckets Recordings Pin
actions.description: Tool to pin a recording (message) in a Basecamp project. Use when you need to feature a message prominently at the top of a message board or project.

actions.name: Corsair/Basecamp/RecordingsAndSubscriptionsPostBucketsRecordingsSubscriptionConnector
actions.label: Recordings: And Subscriptions Post Buckets Recordings Subscription
actions.description: Tool to subscribe the current user to a recording for notifications. Use when you need to start watching/subscribing to a specific recording to receive notifications for new comments.

actions.name: Corsair/Basecamp/RecordingsAndSubscriptionsPutBucketsCommentsConnector
actions.label: Recordings: And Subscriptions Put Buckets Comments
actions.description: Tool to update comment content in a Basecamp project. Use when you need to modify the content of an existing comment.

actions.name: Corsair/Basecamp/RecordingsAndSubscriptionsPutBucketsRecordingsClientVisibilityConnector
actions.label: Recordings: And Subscriptions Put Buckets Recordings Client Visibility
actions.description: Tool to update client visibility for a recording in Basecamp. Use when you need to show or hide a recording from clients. Returns 403 if the recording inherits visibility from parent resource.

actions.name: Corsair/Basecamp/RecordingsAndSubscriptionsPutBucketsRecordingsStatusActiveConnector
actions.label: Recordings: And Subscriptions Put Buckets Recordings Status Active
actions.description: Tool to unarchive a recording in a Basecamp project by marking it as active. Use when you need to restore an archived recording to make it visible again in the project.

actions.name: Corsair/Basecamp/RecordingsAndSubscriptionsPutBucketsRecordingsStatusArchivedConnector
actions.label: Recordings: And Subscriptions Put Buckets Recordings Status Archived
actions.description: Tool to mark a recording as archived in a Basecamp project. Use when you need to archive a recording to remove it from active view while preserving it for reference.

actions.name: Corsair/Basecamp/RecordingsAndSubscriptionsPutBucketsRecordingsStatusTrashedConnector
actions.label: Recordings: And Subscriptions Put Buckets Recordings Status Trashed
actions.description: Tool to mark a recording as trashed in a Basecamp project. Use when you need to move a recording to trash without permanently deleting it.

actions.name: Corsair/Basecamp/RecordingsAndSubscriptionsPutBucketsRecordingsSubscriptionConnector
actions.label: Recordings: And Subscriptions Put Buckets Recordings Subscription
actions.description: Tool to update recording subscriptions by adding or removing subscribers. Use when you need to manage who receives notifications for a specific recording. At least one of subscriptions or unsubscriptions must be provided.

actions.name: Corsair/Basecamp/RecordingsAndSubscriptionsSubscribeCurrentUserConnector
actions.label: Recordings: And Subscriptions Subscribe Current User
actions.description: Tool to subscribe the current authenticated user to a recording for notifications. Use when you need to add the current user to the subscriber list to receive updates about the recording.

actions.name: Corsair/Basecamp/RecordingsAndSubscriptionsToggleClientVisibilityConnector
actions.label: Recordings: And Subscriptions Toggle Client Visibility
actions.description: Tool to change client visibility for a recording in Basecamp. Use when you need to show or hide a recording from clients. Returns 403 error if the recording doesn't control its own visibility.

actions.name: Corsair/Basecamp/RecordingsAndSubscriptionsUnsubscribeCurrentUserConnector
actions.label: Recordings: And Subscriptions Unsubscribe Current User
actions.description: Tool to unsubscribe the current user from a recording. Use when you need to stop receiving notifications for a specific recording. This is an idempotent operation that returns success even if the user wasn't previously subscribed.

actions.name: Corsair/Basecamp/WebhooksDeleteWebhooksConnector
actions.label: Webhooks: Delete Webhooks
actions.description: Tool to delete a webhook from a Basecamp project. Use when you need to remove a webhook subscription from a project. Permanently deletes the specified webhook.

actions.name: Corsair/Basecamp/WebhooksGetBucketsWebhooksConnector
actions.label: Webhooks: Get Buckets Webhooks
actions.description: Tool to retrieve all webhooks configured for a Basecamp project. Use when you need to list all webhook configurations including their payload URLs, event types, and active status.

actions.name: Corsair/Basecamp/WebhooksGetWebhookConnector
actions.label: Webhooks: Get Webhook
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a specific webhook by ID from a Basecamp project. Use when you need details about a webhook including its delivery history.

actions.name: Corsair/Basecamp/WebhooksPostBucketsWebhooksConnector
actions.label: Webhooks: Post Buckets Webhooks
actions.description: Tool to create a new webhook subscription for a Basecamp project. Use when you need to receive event notifications at a specified HTTPS endpoint for project activities.

actions.name: Corsair/Basecamp/WebhooksPutBucketsWebhooksConnector
actions.label: Webhooks: Put Buckets Webhooks
actions.description: Tool to update an existing webhook in a Basecamp project. Use when you need to modify the webhook's URL, event types, or active status.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/InventoryAddInventoryConnector
actions.label: Inventory: Add Inventory
actions.description: Tool to add or update a BaseLinker catalog (inventory). Use when you need to create a new catalog or update an existing one with the same identifier.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/InventoryAddInventoryCategoryConnector
actions.label: Inventory: Add Inventory Category
actions.description: Tool to add or update a category in the BaseLinker catalog. Use when you need to create a new category or update an existing one. Adding a category with the same identifier again updates the previously saved category.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/InventoryAddInventoryManufacturerConnector
actions.label: Inventory: Add Inventory Manufacturer
actions.description: Tool to add or update a manufacturer in the BaseLinker catalog. Use when you need to create a new manufacturer or update an existing one. Adding a manufacturer with the same identifier again updates the previously saved manufacturer.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/InventoryAddInventoryPayerConnector
actions.label: Inventory: Add Inventory Payer
actions.description: Tool to add a new payer or update an existing one in BaseLinker storage. Use when you need to create a new payer with contact details or update an existing payer's information.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/InventoryAddInventoryPriceGroupConnector
actions.label: Inventory: Add Inventory Price Group
actions.description: Tool to create or update a price group in BaseLinker storage. Use when you need to define pricing tiers (e.g., wholesale, retail, VIP) that can be later assigned to inventory items via addInventory method.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/InventoryAddInventoryProductConnector
actions.label: Inventory: Add Inventory Product
actions.description: Add a new product to BaseLinker catalog or update an existing product. Use when creating inventory items or modifying product details like SKU, price, stock, dimensions, and text fields. Provide product_id to update existing products, omit it to create new ones.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/InventoryAddInventorySupplierConnector
actions.label: Inventory: Add Inventory Supplier
actions.description: Tool to add a new supplier or update an existing one in BaseLinker storage. Use when you need to manage supplier information for inventory management. If supplier_id is provided, the existing supplier will be updated; otherwise, a new supplier will be created.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/InventoryAddInventoryWarehouseConnector
actions.label: Inventory: Add Inventory Warehouse
actions.description: Tool to add a new warehouse or update an existing warehouse in BaseLinker inventories. Use when you need to create new warehouse locations for inventory management or update warehouse details. Adding a warehouse with the same identifier again will update the previously saved warehouse. The method does not allow editing warehouses created automatically for external stocks.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/InventoryDeleteInventoryConnector
actions.label: Inventory: Delete Inventory
actions.description: Tool to delete a catalog from BaseLinker storage. Use when you need to permanently remove an inventory/catalog.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/InventoryDeleteInventoryCategoryConnector
actions.label: Inventory: Delete Inventory Category
actions.description: Tool to remove categories from BaseLinker warehouse. Along with the category, the products contained therein are removed (however, this does not apply to products in subcategories). The subcategories will be changed to the highest level categories.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/InventoryDeleteInventoryManufacturerConnector
actions.label: Inventory: Delete Inventory Manufacturer
actions.description: Tool to remove a manufacturer from the BaseLinker catalog. Use when you need to delete a manufacturer that is no longer needed or was added by mistake.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/InventoryDeleteInventoryPayerConnector
actions.label: Inventory: Delete Inventory Payer
actions.description: Tool to remove a payer from BaseLinker storage. Use when you need to delete an existing payer entry by its ID.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/InventoryDeleteInventoryPriceGroupConnector
actions.label: Inventory: Delete Inventory Price Group
actions.description: Tool to remove a price group from BaseLinker storage. Use when you need to delete an existing price group by its identifier.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/InventoryDeleteInventoryProductConnector
actions.label: Inventory: Delete Inventory Product
actions.description: Tool to remove a product from the BaseLinker catalog. Use when you need to permanently delete an inventory product by its ID.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/InventoryDeleteInventoryWarehouseConnector
actions.label: Inventory: Delete Inventory Warehouse
actions.description: Tool to remove a warehouse from BaseLinker inventories. Use when you need to delete a warehouse that is no longer needed. Note: This method does not allow removal of warehouses created automatically for external stock management (shops, wholesalers, etc.).

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/InventoryGetInventoriesConnector
actions.label: Inventory: Get Inventories
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a list of catalogs (inventories) available in the BaseLinker storage. Use when you need to discover available catalogs and their configurations before performing inventory-specific operations.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/InventoryGetInventoryAvailableTextFieldKeysConnector
actions.label: Inventory: Get Inventory Available Text Field Keys
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a list of product text fields that can be overwritten for a specific integration. Use when you need to discover which text fields are available for modification within a given inventory catalog.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/InventoryGetInventoryCategoriesConnector
actions.label: Inventory: Get Inventory Categories
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a list of categories for a BaseLinker catalog. Use when you need to fetch category hierarchies for inventory management or product organization.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/InventoryGetInventoryExtraFieldsConnector
actions.label: Inventory: Get Inventory Extra Fields
actions.description: Tool to retrieve extra fields defined for BaseLinker catalog inventory items. Use before fetching or updating inventory products to list available custom fields.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/InventoryGetInventoryIntegrationsConnector
actions.label: Inventory: Get Inventory Integrations
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a list of integrations where text values in the catalog can be overwritten. Use when you need to discover which sales channels support text customization and what languages are available for each integration.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/InventoryGetInventoryManufacturersConnector
actions.label: Inventory: Get Inventory Manufacturers
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a list of manufacturers from the BaseLinker catalog. Use when you need to view all manufacturers available in the system before adding or modifying manufacturer information.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/InventoryGetInventoryPayersConnector
actions.label: Inventory: Get Inventory Payers
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a list of payers available in BaseLinker storage. Use when you need to list payers, optionally filtered by ID or name.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/InventoryGetInventoryPriceGroupsConnector
actions.label: Inventory: Get Inventory Price Groups
actions.description: Tool to retrieve price groups existing in BaseLinker storage. Use when you need to discover available pricing tiers before assigning them to inventory items or performing price-related operations.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/InventoryGetInventoryPrintoutTemplatesConnector
actions.label: Inventory: Get Inventory Printout Templates
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all configured printout templates available for inventory (products). Use when you need to discover available printout templates before generating product documents.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/InventoryGetInventoryProductLogsConnector
actions.label: Inventory: Get Inventory Product Logs
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a list of events related to product changes in the BaseLinker catalog. Use when tracking product modification history, auditing changes, or monitoring inventory updates.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/InventoryGetInventoryProductsDataConnector
actions.label: Inventory: Get Inventory Products Data
actions.description: Tool to retrieve detailed data for selected products from the BaseLinker inventory. Use when you need comprehensive product information including SKU, prices, stock, dimensions, descriptions, images, variants, and bundle details.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/InventoryGetInventoryProductsListConnector
actions.label: Inventory: Get Inventory Products List
actions.description: Tool to retrieve basic data of chosen products from BaseLinker catalogs. Use when you need to list products with optional filtering by ID, category, EAN, SKU, name, price range, or stock levels. Supports pagination for large catalogs (1000 products per page).

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/InventoryGetInventoryProductsPricesConnector
actions.label: Inventory: Get Inventory Products Prices
actions.description: Retrieve gross prices of products from BaseLinker inventories. Use when you need to get pricing information for products and their variants across different price groups. Supports pagination for large product catalogs.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/InventoryGetInventoryProductsStockConnector
actions.label: Inventory: Get Inventory Products Stock
actions.description: Tool to retrieve stock data of products from BaseLinker catalogs. Use when you need to check current inventory levels, reservations, or variant stock across warehouses. Results are paginated at 1000 products per page.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/InventoryGetInventorySuppliersConnector
actions.label: Inventory: Get Inventory Suppliers
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a list of suppliers available in BaseLinker storage. Use when you need to list suppliers, optionally filtered by ID or name.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/InventoryGetInventoryTagsConnector
actions.label: Inventory: Get Inventory Tags
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a list of tags for a BaseLinker catalog. Use when you need to view all tags available in the system before categorizing or filtering inventory items.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/InventoryGetInventoryWarehousesConnector
actions.label: Inventory: Get Inventory Warehouses
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a list of warehouses available in BaseLinker inventories. Use when you need to discover available warehouse locations before performing inventory or stock operations. Returns warehouses created manually as well as those created automatically for external stocks (shops, wholesalers).

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/InventoryRunProductMacroTriggerConnector
actions.label: Inventory: Run Product Macro Trigger
actions.description: Tool to execute a personal trigger for products automatic actions. Use when you need to manually run a custom event trigger for a specific product in BaseLinker inventory.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/InventoryUpdateInventoryProductsStockConnector
actions.label: Inventory: Update Inventory Products Stock
actions.description: Tool to update stocks of products and their variants in BaseLinker catalog. Use when you need to modify inventory levels for products across warehouses. Maximum 1000 products per request.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/InventoryDocumentsAddInventoryDocumentConnector
actions.label: Inventory: Documents Add Inventory Document
actions.description: Tool to create a new inventory document in BaseLinker storage. Use when you need to create goods receipts, issues, or transfers. Documents are created as drafts and require confirmation via user action or setInventoryDocumentStatusConfirmed API method.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/InventoryDocumentsGetInventoryDocumentItemsConnector
actions.label: Inventory: Documents Get Inventory Document Items
actions.description: Tool to retrieve items from inventory documents in BaseLinker. Use when you need to fetch product details from a specific document with support for pagination (100 items per page).

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/InventoryDocumentsGetInventoryDocumentSeriesConnector
actions.label: Inventory: Documents Get Inventory Document Series
actions.description: Tool to retrieve available inventory document series. Use when you need to assign a numbering series to a new inventory document.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/InventoryDocumentsGetInventoryDocumentsConnector
actions.label: Inventory: Documents Get Inventory Documents
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a list of inventory documents. Use when you need to fetch inventory records with optional filters for ID, type, status, date range, warehouse, or pagination.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/PurchaseOrdersAddInventoryPurchaseOrderConnector
actions.label: Purchase: Orders Add Inventory Purchase Order
actions.description: Tool to create a new purchase order in BaseLinker storage. Orders are created as drafts by default. Use when you need to create a new purchase order for inventory management.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/PurchaseOrdersAddInventoryPurchaseOrderItemsConnector
actions.label: Purchase: Orders Add Inventory Purchase Order Items
actions.description: Tool to add items to an existing purchase order in BaseLinker. Use when you need to add products to a purchase order that has already been created.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/PurchaseOrdersGetInventoryPurchaseOrderItemsConnector
actions.label: Purchase: Orders Get Inventory Purchase Order Items
actions.description: Tool to retrieve items from a specific purchase order in BaseLinker. Use when you need to fetch product details from a purchase order with support for pagination (100 items per page).

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/PurchaseOrdersGetInventoryPurchaseOrderSeriesConnector
actions.label: Purchase: Orders Get Inventory Purchase Order Series
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a list of purchase order document series. Use when you need to select a numbering series for a new purchase order.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/PurchaseOrdersGetInventoryPurchaseOrdersConnector
actions.label: Purchase: Orders Get Inventory Purchase Orders
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a list of purchase orders from BaseLinker storage. Use when you need to fetch purchase orders with optional filters like date range, supplier or pagination.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/PurchaseOrdersSetInventoryPurchaseOrderStatusConnector
actions.label: Purchase: Orders Set Inventory Purchase Order Status
actions.description: Tool to change the status of a purchase order in BaseLinker inventory. Use when you need to update a purchase order's status (e.g., mark as sent, received, completed, or canceled).

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/DocumentsAddInvoiceConnector
actions.label: Documents: Add Invoice
actions.description: Tool to issue an order invoice in BaseLinker. Use when you need to generate an invoice for an existing order using a specific numbering series.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/DocumentsAddInvoiceCorrectionConnector
actions.label: Documents: Add Invoice Correction
actions.description: Tool to issue an order invoice correction. Use when correcting pricing errors, handling returns, or updating invoice data. Either original_invoice_id or return_order_id must be provided.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/DocumentsGetInvoiceFileConnector
actions.label: Documents: Get Invoice File
actions.description: Tool to retrieve an invoice file from BaseLinker in base64-encoded format. Use when you need to download an invoice document generated by BaseLinker or from an external accounting system.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/DocumentsGetInvoicesConnector
actions.label: Documents: Get Invoices
actions.description: Download invoices from BaseLinker order manager with optional filtering. Use this tool to: - Fetch all invoices from a specific date onwards - Retrieve a single invoice by ID or order ID - Filter invoices by numbering series - Paginate through invoices using id_from parameter Returns up to 100 invoices per request. Use getSeries to get available series IDs for filtering.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/DocumentsGetNewReceiptsConnector
actions.label: Documents: Get New Receipts
actions.description: Tool to retrieve receipts waiting to be issued. Use after confirming fiscal printer availability; fetch pending receipts and mark them with setOrderReceipt.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/DocumentsGetReceiptsConnector
actions.label: Documents: Get Receipts
actions.description: Tool to retrieve issued receipts from BaseLinker. Use when you need to fetch historical receipt data. Max 100 receipts returned per request.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/DocumentsGetSeriesConnector
actions.label: Documents: Get Series
actions.description: Tool to download invoice/receipt numbering series. Use when you need to retrieve all series configurations before issuing documents.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/DocumentsSetOrderReceiptConnector
actions.label: Documents: Set Order Receipt
actions.description: Tool to mark orders with a receipt already issued. Use after printing receipts retrieved from getNewReceipts to confirm receipt issuance.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/OrdersAddOrderConnector
actions.label: Orders: Add Order
actions.description: Tool to add a new order to the BaseLinker order manager. Use when you need to create a new order with customer details, products, and delivery information.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/OrdersAddOrderBySplitConnector
actions.label: Orders: Add Order By Split
actions.description: Tool to create a new order by splitting selected products from an existing order. Use when you need to split an order into multiple shipments or separate deliveries. The new order inherits all customer details, addresses, and settings from the original order, with only the specified products and optional delivery costs moved to it.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/OrdersAddOrderDuplicateConnector
actions.label: Orders: Add Order Duplicate
actions.description: Tool to add a new order by duplicating an existing order in BaseLinker. The new order will have the same data as the original order but with a different ID.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/OrdersDeleteOrderProductConnector
actions.label: Orders: Delete Order Product
actions.description: Tool to remove a specific product from an order in BaseLinker. Use when you need to delete an order item without canceling the entire order.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/OrdersDeleteOrdersConnector
actions.label: Orders: Delete Orders
actions.description: Tool to delete multiple orders from BaseLinker order manager. Use when you need to permanently remove orders from the system.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/OrdersGetJournalListConnector
actions.label: Orders: Get Journal List
actions.description: Tool to download order event logs from the last 3 days. Use when you need to track order activities, changes, or events. IMPORTANT: This method must be activated by BaseLinker support on your account. If not activated, it returns an empty response. Events include order creation, status changes, payments, invoices, receipts, product modifications, and package operations. Use last_log_id to paginate through results incrementally.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/OrdersGetOrderExtraFieldsConnector
actions.label: Orders: Get Order Extra Fields
actions.description: Tool to retrieve extra fields defined for orders. Use before fetching orders with include_custom_extra_fields to list available custom order fields.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/OrdersGetOrderPaymentsHistoryConnector
actions.label: Orders: Get Order Payments History
actions.description: Tool to retrieve payment history for a selected order, including external payment identifiers from payment gateways. Use when you need to track payment events for an order. One order can have multiple payment history entries due to surcharges, order value changes, or manual payment editing.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/OrdersGetOrderPickPackHistoryConnector
actions.label: Orders: Get Order Pick Pack History
actions.description: Tool to retrieve pick and pack history for a selected order. Use when you need to track the fulfillment timeline and events for an order (reservations, picking, packing, photography). Returns chronological list of pick/pack events with timestamps and responsible profiles.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/OrdersGetOrderPrintoutTemplatesConnector
actions.label: Orders: Get Order Printout Templates
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all configured printout templates available for orders. Use when you need to discover available printout templates before generating order documents.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/OrdersGetOrderSourcesConnector
actions.label: Orders: Get Order Sources
actions.description: Tool to retrieve types of order sources along with their IDs from BaseLinker. Use when you need to understand available order sources for filtering orders or mapping order_source field values from getOrders method.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/OrdersGetOrderStatusListConnector
actions.label: Orders: Get Order Status List
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a list of order statuses created in the BaseLinker order manager. Use when you need to map status IDs to human-readable names.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/OrdersGetOrderTransactionDataConnector
actions.label: Orders: Get Order Transaction Data
actions.description: Tool to retrieve transaction details for a selected order. Use when you need marketplace transaction IDs, fulfillment data, or detailed tax breakdowns for an order.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/OrdersGetOrdersConnector
actions.label: Orders: Get Orders
actions.description: Download orders from BaseLinker order manager with optional filtering. Use this tool to: - Fetch all orders from a specific date onwards - Retrieve a single order by ID - Filter orders by status, email, or marketplace source - Paginate through orders using id_from parameter Returns up to 100 orders per request. For confirmed orders only, omit get_unconfirmed_orders. Tip: Use getOrderStatusList to get status IDs for filtering.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/OrdersGetOrdersByPhoneConnector
actions.label: Orders: Get Orders By Phone
actions.description: Search for orders associated with a specific phone number in BaseLinker. Use when identifying callers in phone recognition systems or finding order history by phone. Returns basic order information including status, recipient names, and timestamps.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/OrdersGetPickPackCartsConnector
actions.label: Orders: Get Pick Pack Carts
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all PickPack carts belonging to the authenticated user. Use when you need to discover available carts and their details (ID, name, color) before performing cart-specific operations.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/OrdersRunOrderMacroTriggerConnector
actions.label: Orders: Run Order Macro Trigger
actions.description: Tool to run personal trigger for orders automatic actions. Use when you need to execute a specific automation trigger on an order.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/OrdersSetOrderFieldsConnector
actions.label: Orders: Set Order Fields
actions.description: Tool to edit selected fields of a specific order in BaseLinker. Use when you need to update order details such as address data, notes, payment method, delivery information, or invoice details. Only provide the fields you want to change; other fields can be omitted.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/OrdersSetOrderPaymentConnector
actions.label: Orders: Set Order Payment
actions.description: Tool to add a payment to an order in BaseLinker. Use when recording a payment for an order. The payment amount replaces (not adds to) the current payment value; if it matches the order total, the order is marked as paid.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/OrdersSetOrderProductFieldsConnector
actions.label: Orders: Set Order Product Fields
actions.description: Tool to edit data of selected items in a specific BaseLinker order. Use when you need to update product fields like prices, quantities, SKU, or other item details. Only provide the fields you want to edit; other fields can be omitted.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/OrdersSetOrderStatusConnector
actions.label: Orders: Set Order Status
actions.description: Tool to change the status of an existing order in BaseLinker. Use when you need to update an order's status to a different value.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/OrdersSetOrderStatusesConnector
actions.label: Orders: Set Order Statuses
actions.description: Tool to batch update order statuses in BaseLinker. Use when you need to set the same status for multiple orders at once.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/OrdersSetOrdersMergeConnector
actions.label: Orders: Set Orders Merge
actions.description: Tool to merge multiple orders into one, based on the selected merge mode. Use when you need to combine orders together with either technical merge or into main order mode.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/ReturnsAddOrderReturnConnector
actions.label: Returns: Add Order Return
actions.description: Tool to add a new order return to BaseLinker. Use when creating a return for an order. Requires status_id (get from getOrderReturnStatusList), date_add (Unix timestamp), currency (3-letter code), and refunded status.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/ReturnsAddOrderReturnProductConnector
actions.label: Returns: Add Order Return Product
actions.description: Tool to add a new product to an existing order return in BaseLinker. Use when a customer is returning items and you need to register the returned products.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/ReturnsDeleteOrderReturnProductConnector
actions.label: Returns: Delete Order Return Product
actions.description: Tool to remove a specific product from an order return in BaseLinker. Use when you need to delete a product item from an existing return request.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/ReturnsGetOrderReturnExtraFieldsConnector
actions.label: Returns: Get Order Return Extra Fields
actions.description: Tool to retrieve extra fields defined for order returns. Use before calling getOrderReturns with include_custom_extra_fields to list available custom fields. Field values can be set via setOrderReturnFields.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/ReturnsGetOrderReturnJournalListConnector
actions.label: Returns: Get Order Return Journal List
actions.description: Tool to download return event logs from the last 3 days in BaseLinker. Use when tracking return order history, monitoring return status changes, or auditing return-related activities. Returns events like return creation, status changes, product modifications, and refund creation.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/ReturnsGetOrderReturnPaymentsHistoryConnector
actions.label: Returns: Get Order Return Payments History
actions.description: Tool to retrieve payment history for a selected order return, including external payment identifiers from the payment gateway. Use when you need to track payment events, surcharges, order value changes, or manual payment edits for a return.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/ReturnsGetOrderReturnProductStatusesConnector
actions.label: Returns: Get Order Return Product Statuses
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a list of order return product statuses from BaseLinker. Use when you need to identify valid status IDs for return items, or to map status IDs to human-readable names.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/ReturnsGetOrderReturnReasonsListConnector
actions.label: Returns: Get Order Return Reasons List
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a list of order return reasons. Use when you need to discover available return reasons before setting return fields with setOrderReturnFields.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/ReturnsGetOrderReturnStatusListConnector
actions.label: Returns: Get Order Return Status List
actions.description: Tool to retrieve order return statuses created in the BaseLinker order manager. Use when you need to map return status IDs to human-readable names.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/ReturnsGetOrderReturnsConnector
actions.label: Returns: Get Order Returns
actions.description: Download order returns from BaseLinker return manager with optional filtering. Use this tool to: - Fetch returns from a specific date onwards using date_from parameter - Retrieve a single return by return_id - Filter returns by source order, status, or marketplace source - Paginate through returns using id_from parameter Returns up to 100 order returns per request. For complete return data including custom fields, set include_custom_extra_fields=true. Use include_connect_data=true for Base Connect integration info.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/ReturnsSetOrderReturnFieldsConnector
actions.label: Returns: Set Order Return Fields
actions.description: Tool to edit selected fields of a specific order return. Use when updating return information such as buyer contact details, delivery address, or custom fields. Only the fields that need to be changed should be provided; other fields can be omitted.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/ReturnsSetOrderReturnProductFieldsConnector
actions.label: Returns: Set Order Return Product Fields
actions.description: Tool to edit data of selected items (e.g., prices, quantities, attributes) of a specific order return product. Use when you need to update fields of a returned product in an order return.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/ReturnsSetOrderReturnRefundConnector
actions.label: Returns: Set Order Return Refund
actions.description: Tool to mark an order return as refunded in BaseLinker. Use when recording that a refund has been issued for a return. Note: This method doesn't issue an actual money refund - it only updates the refund status in BaseLinker.

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/ReturnsSetOrderReturnStatusConnector

actions.name: Corsair/Baselinker/ReturnsSetOrderReturnStatusesConnector
