actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/PullRequestsApprovePullRequestConnector
actions.label: Pull: Requests Approve Pull Request
actions.description: Tool to approve a pull request as the authenticated user. Use when you need to formally approve changes in a pull request review process.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/PullRequestsCreatePullRequestConnector
actions.label: Pull: Requests Create Pull Request
actions.description: Creates a new pull request in a specified Bitbucket repository, ensuring the source branch exists and is distinct from the (optional) destination branch.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/PullRequestsCreatePullRequestCommentConnector
actions.label: Pull: Requests Create Pull Request Comment
actions.description: Creates a new comment on a Bitbucket pull request. Supports top-level comments, threaded replies, and inline code comments. Use when providing feedback on a PR, replying to existing comments, or commenting on specific code lines.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/PullRequestsGetPullRequestConnector
actions.label: Pull: Requests Get Pull Request
actions.description: Get a single pull request by ID with complete details.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/PullRequestsGetPullRequestCommitsConnector
actions.label: Pull: Requests Get Pull Request Commits
actions.description: Tool to retrieve commits for a specified pull request. Use when reviewing the commit history of a PR or analyzing changes included in a pull request.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/PullRequestsGetPullRequestDiffConnector
actions.label: Pull: Requests Get Pull Request Diff
actions.description: Tool to fetch the unified diff for a Bitbucket pull request (follows 302 redirect to repository diff). Use when reviewing code changes in a PR. Supports optional truncation for large diffs via max_chars parameter.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/PullRequestsGetPullRequestDiffstatConnector
actions.label: Pull: Requests Get Pull Request Diffstat
actions.description: Tool to get the diffstat for a Bitbucket pull request, showing all changed files with their change statistics (lines added/removed, status). Use when you need to enumerate files modified in a PR.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/PullRequestsGetPullRequestCommentConnector
actions.label: Pull: Requests Get Pull Request Comment
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a specific comment from a pull request by its ID. Use when you need to fetch details of a particular pull request comment including content, author, timestamps, and inline location.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/PullRequestsGetRepositoriesPullrequestsCommentsConnector
actions.label: Pull: Requests Get Repositories Pullrequests Comments
actions.description: Retrieves a paginated list of comments on a specific pull request in a Bitbucket repository. Returns global, inline, and threaded comments. Use when you need to view feedback, discussions, or reviews left on a pull request.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/PullRequestsGetRepositoriesPullrequestsStatusesConnector
actions.label: Pull: Requests Get Repositories Pullrequests Statuses
actions.description: Returns all build statuses (e.g., CI/CD pipeline results) for a specific pull request. Use when you need to check build status, verify test results, or monitor deployment pipelines for a pull request.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/PullRequestsGetRepositoriesPullrequestsActivityConnector
actions.label: Pull: Requests Get Repositories Pullrequests Activity
actions.description: Get paginated activity log for all pull requests in a repository. Returns comments, updates, approvals, and request changes. Use when you need to track pull request activity history.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/PullRequestsListPullRequestTasksConnector
actions.label: Pull: Requests List Pull Request Tasks
actions.description: Lists all tasks associated with a pull request in a Bitbucket repository. Use when you need to view or track tasks on a PR.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/PullRequestsListPullRequestsConnector
actions.label: Pull: Requests List Pull Requests
actions.description: Lists pull requests in a specified, accessible Bitbucket repository, optionally filtering by state (OPEN, MERGED, DECLINED).

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/PullRequestsRequestPullRequestChangesConnector
actions.label: Pull: Requests Request Pull Request Changes
actions.description: Tool to request changes on a pull request as the authenticated user. Use when you need to formally request changes in a pull request review process, indicating the PR needs modifications before approval.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/SourceAndRefsBrowseRepositoryPathConnector
actions.label: Source: And Refs Browse Repository Path
actions.description: Tool to retrieve content for a file path or browse directory contents at a specified revision in a Bitbucket repository. Use when you need flexible access to repository content - returns raw file data for files or paginated directory listings for directories.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/SourceAndRefsCreateBranchConnector
actions.label: Source: And Refs Create Branch
actions.description: Creates a new branch in a Bitbucket repository from a target commit hash; the branch name must be unique, adhere to Bitbucket's naming conventions, and not include the 'refs/heads/' prefix.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/SourceAndRefsGetRepositoriesBranchingModelConnector
actions.label: Source: And Refs Get Repositories Branching Model
actions.description: Return the branching model as applied to the repository. Use when you need to understand the repository's branch workflow configuration, including development/production branches and branch type prefixes.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/SourceAndRefsGetBranchConnector
actions.label: Source: And Refs Get Branch
actions.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific branch in a Bitbucket repository. Use when you need to get branch metadata, the commit it points to, or verify a branch exists.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/SourceAndRefsGetRepositoriesEffectiveBranchingModelConnector
actions.label: Source: And Refs Get Repositories Effective Branching Model
actions.description: Retrieves the effective branching model for a Bitbucket repository, showing which branching model is currently applied (including any inheritance from project-level settings). Use when you need to understand the repository's branch workflow configuration, including development and production branches and branch type prefixes.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/SourceAndRefsGetRepositoriesFilehistoryConnector
actions.label: Source: And Refs Get Repositories Filehistory
actions.description: Returns a paginated list of commits that modified the specified file. Use when you need to track file changes over time, find who modified a file, or determine when a file was created or last changed.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/SourceAndRefsGetFileFromRepositoryConnector
actions.label: Source: And Refs Get File From Repository
actions.description: Retrieves a specific file's content from a Bitbucket repository at a given commit (hash, branch, or tag), failing if the file path is invalid for that commit.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/SourceAndRefsGetRawFileContentConnector
actions.label: Source: And Refs Get Raw File Content
actions.description: Tool to retrieve the raw content of a file from a Bitbucket repository at a specified commit, branch, or tag. Use when you need to read file contents from a specific revision.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/SourceAndRefsGetRepositoriesSrcConnector
actions.label: Source: And Refs Get Repositories Src
actions.description: Lists the contents of the root directory on the repository's main branch without needing to specify a commit or branch. This endpoint redirects to the main branch automatically.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/SourceAndRefsGetRepositoriesRefsConnector
actions.label: Source: And Refs Get Repositories Refs
actions.description: Returns the branches and tags in the repository. Use when you need to list all refs (both branches and tags) in a single API call with optional filtering by type, name pattern, or commit hash.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/SourceAndRefsGetRepositoriesRefsTagsConnector
actions.label: Source: And Refs Get Repositories Refs Tags
actions.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific tag in a Bitbucket repository. Use when you need to get tag metadata, target commit details, or verify a tag exists.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/SourceAndRefsListBranchesConnector
actions.label: Source: And Refs List Branches
actions.description: Lists branches in a Bitbucket repository with optional server-side filtering by name pattern (BBQL) and sorting. Use when you need to discover available branches, search for specific branch patterns, or navigate repository branch structure.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/SourceAndRefsListRepositoryPathsConnector
actions.label: Source: And Refs List Repository Paths
actions.description: Lists file and directory entries under a repository path at a given revision, with optional breadth-first recursion via max_depth for repository traversal and scanning. Fails if the path points to a file rather than a directory.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/SourceAndRefsListTagsConnector
actions.label: Source: And Refs List Tags
actions.description: Lists tags in a Bitbucket repository with optional server-side filtering by name pattern or commit hash (BBQL) and sorting. Use when you need to discover available tags, search for specific tag patterns, or find tags pointing to specific commits.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/IssuesGetRepositoriesIssuesVoteConnector
actions.label: Issues: Get Repositories Issues Vote
actions.description: Tool to check whether the authenticated user has voted for a specific issue in a Bitbucket repository. Use when you need to verify if the current user has already voted on an issue before attempting to vote or unvote.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/IssuesCreateIssueConnector
actions.label: Issues: Create Issue
actions.description: Creates a new issue in a Bitbucket repository, setting the authenticated user as reporter; ensures assignee (if provided) has repository access, and that any specified milestone, version, or component IDs exist.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/IssuesCreateIssueCommentConnector
actions.label: Issues: Create Issue Comment
actions.description: Adds a new comment with markdown support to an existing Bitbucket issue.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/IssuesDeleteIssueConnector
actions.label: Issues: Delete Issue
actions.description: Permanently deletes a specific issue, identified by its `issue_id`, from the repository specified by `repo_slug` within the given `workspace`.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/IssuesListIssuesConnector
actions.label: Issues: List Issues
actions.description: Lists issues in a Bitbucket repository with optional filtering by state, priority, kind, or assignee. Use when you need to discover issue IDs or get an overview of repository issues.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/IssuesListVersionsConnector
actions.label: Issues: List Versions
actions.description: Lists versions (milestones) in a Bitbucket repository's issue tracker. Use when you need to discover available versions for associating with issues, or to retrieve version IDs for use with create_issue.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/IssuesUpdateIssueConnector
actions.label: Issues: Update Issue
actions.description: Updates an existing issue in a Bitbucket repository by modifying specified attributes; requires `workspace`, `repo_slug`, `issue_id`, and at least one attribute to update.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/CommitsAndInsightsCreateRepositoriesCommitReportsAnnotationsConnector
actions.label: Commits: And Insights Create Repositories Commit Reports Annotations
actions.description: Adds multiple annotations to a commit report in bulk. Use when you need to add code analysis findings (vulnerabilities, code smells, bugs) to a report attached to a specific commit.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/CommitsAndInsightsDeleteCommitCommentConnector
actions.label: Commits: And Insights Delete Commit Comment
actions.description: Permanently deletes a specific comment on a commit. Use when removing outdated, incorrect, or unwanted feedback on a commit.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/CommitsAndInsightsDeleteRepositoriesCommitReportsAnnotationsConnector
actions.label: Commits: And Insights Delete Repositories Commit Reports Annotations
actions.description: Deletes a single annotation matching the provided ID from a commit report. Use when you need to remove a specific annotation from a code analysis report.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/CommitsAndInsightsGetCommitBuildStatusConnector
actions.label: Commits: And Insights Get Commit Build Status
actions.description: Get a specific build status for a commit in Bitbucket. Use when you need to check the status of a particular build/CI run for a commit.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/CommitsAndInsightsGetCommitChangesConnector
actions.label: Commits: And Insights Get Commit Changes
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a page of changes made in a specified commit, showing all changed files with their change statistics (lines added/removed, status). Use when you need to enumerate files modified in a specific commit or commit range.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/CommitsAndInsightsGetCommitDiffConnector
actions.label: Commits: And Insights Get Commit Diff
actions.description: Tool to retrieve the unified diff between two provided revisions or for a single commit in a Bitbucket repository. Use when you need to see the actual code changes in a commit or between two commits. Supports filtering by file path and various diff options.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/CommitsAndInsightsGetRepositoriesCommitReportsConnector
actions.label: Commits: And Insights Get Repositories Commit Reports
actions.description: Tool to get reports linked to a specific commit. Use when you need to retrieve analysis results, test reports, security scans, or code coverage data associated with a commit.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/CommitsAndInsightsGetRepositoriesMergeBaseConnector
actions.label: Commits: And Insights Get Repositories Merge Base
actions.description: Get the merge base (best common ancestor) between two commits in a Bitbucket repository. Use when you need to find the common ancestor commit between two branches or commits for comparison or merge operations.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/CommitsAndInsightsGetRepositoriesCommitConnector
actions.label: Commits: And Insights Get Repositories Commit
actions.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about a specific commit in a Bitbucket repository. Use when you need to get complete commit details including author, message, date, parents, and related links.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/CommitsAndInsightsGetRepositoryPatchConnector
actions.label: Commits: And Insights Get Repository Patch
actions.description: Tool to retrieve the git patch content for a Bitbucket repository at a specified revision or commit range. Use when you need to review code changes, generate diffs, or analyze modifications between commits. Returns raw patch in unified diff format.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/CommitsAndInsightsGetCommitCommentConnector
actions.label: Commits: And Insights Get Commit Comment
actions.description: Retrieves a specific comment from a commit by its ID. Use when you need to fetch details of a particular commit comment including content, author, timestamps, and inline location.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/CommitsAndInsightsGetRepositoriesCommitCommentsConnector
actions.label: Commits: And Insights Get Repositories Commit Comments
actions.description: Retrieves all comments on a specific commit in a Bitbucket repository. Returns both global and inline code comments. Use when you need to view feedback, discussions, or notes left on a specific commit.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/CommitsAndInsightsGetRepositoriesCommitReportConnector
actions.label: Commits: And Insights Get Repositories Commit Report
actions.description: Returns a single report matching the provided ID from a commit. Use when you need to retrieve details of a specific analysis report (e.g., security scan, code coverage, test results, or bug report) for a commit.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/CommitsAndInsightsGetRepositoriesCommitReportsAnnotationsConnector
actions.label: Commits: And Insights Get Repositories Commit Reports Annotations
actions.description: Returns a single annotation matching the provided ID from a commit report. Use when you need to retrieve details of a specific code analysis finding (e.g., vulnerability, code smell, or bug) identified in a commit.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/CommitsAndInsightsGetRepositoriesCommitStatusesConnector
actions.label: Commits: And Insights Get Repositories Commit Statuses
actions.description: Returns all build statuses (e.g., CI/CD pipeline results) for a specific commit. Use when you need to check build status, verify test results, or monitor deployment pipelines for a particular commit.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/CommitsAndInsightsListCommitsConnector
actions.label: Commits: And Insights List Commits
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a page of commits from a Bitbucket repository. Returns commits in reverse chronological order (newest first), similar to git log. Use when you need to browse commit history, filter commits by branch/tag, or restrict to commits affecting a specific path.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/CommitsAndInsightsListCommitsFromRevisionConnector
actions.label: Commits: And Insights List Commits From Revision
actions.description: Tool to list commits starting from a specific revision in a Bitbucket repository. Commits are paginated and returned in reverse chronological order. Use when you need to retrieve commit history from a specific commit, branch, or tag.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/CommitsAndInsightsCreateRepositoriesCommits2Connector
actions.label: Commits: And Insights Create Repositories Commits2
actions.description: Tool to list commits from a revision using POST method. Identical to GET endpoint but allows sending include/exclude parameters in request body to avoid URL length limits. Use when include/exclude parameters are too long for query strings.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/CommitsAndInsightsListCommitsOnMasterConnector
actions.label: Commits: And Insights List Commits On Master
actions.description: Lists commits on the master branch of a Bitbucket repository. Use when you need to retrieve the commit history for the master branch, including commit messages, authors, dates, and parent relationships.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/CommitsAndInsightsUpdateRepositoriesCommitCommentsConnector
actions.label: Commits: And Insights Update Repositories Commit Comments
actions.description: Updates the contents of a comment on a commit. Use when you need to modify an existing comment's text on a commit.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/CommitsAndInsightsUpdateInsightsProjectsReposCommitsReportsConnector
actions.label: Commits: And Insights Update Insights Projects Repos Commits Reports
actions.description: Create or update an insight report for a commit. Creates a new report if it doesn't exist, or replaces the existing one if a report already exists for the given repository, commit, and report key. Note: replacing an existing report will be rejected if the authenticated user was not the creator of the specified report.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/CommitsAndInsightsUpdateRepositoriesCommitReportsAnnotationsConnector
actions.label: Commits: And Insights Update Repositories Commit Reports Annotations
actions.description: Creates or updates an individual annotation for a commit report. Use when you need to add or modify code analysis findings (vulnerabilities, code smells, or bugs) identified in a commit.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/RepositoriesCreateRepositoryConnector
actions.label: Repositories: Create Repository
actions.description: Creates a new Bitbucket 'git' repository in a specified workspace, defaulting to the workspace's oldest project if `project_key` is not provided.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/RepositoriesDeleteRepositoryConnector
actions.label: Repositories: Delete Repository
actions.description: Permanently deletes a specified Bitbucket repository; this action is irreversible and does not affect forks.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/RepositoriesGetRepositoryConnector
actions.label: Repositories: Get Repository
actions.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific repository in a Bitbucket workspace. Use when you need to get repository metadata, settings, or details.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/RepositoriesGetRepositoriesWatchersConnector
actions.label: Repositories: Get Repositories Watchers
actions.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all the watchers on the specified repository. Use when you need to see who is watching a particular repository.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/RepositoriesListRepositoriesConnector
actions.label: Repositories: List Repositories
actions.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all public repositories on Bitbucket. Use when you need to discover or search across public repositories, optionally filtered by role, query string, creation date, or sorted by various fields.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/RepositoriesListRepositoriesInWorkspaceConnector
actions.label: Repositories: List Repositories In Workspace
actions.description: Lists repositories in a specified Bitbucket workspace, accessible to the authenticated user, with options to filter by role or query string, and sort results. Responses are paginated; iterate using the `next` field in each response until it is absent to retrieve all repositories.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/SnippetsCreateSnippetCommentConnector
actions.label: Snippets: Create Snippet Comment
actions.description: Posts a new top-level comment or a threaded reply to an existing comment on a specified Bitbucket snippet.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/SnippetsDeleteSnippetsWatchConnector
actions.label: Snippets: Delete Snippets Watch
actions.description: Stops watching a specific snippet. Use when you want to unsubscribe from notifications for a snippet.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/SnippetsGetSnippetConnector
actions.label: Snippets: Get Snippet
actions.description: Retrieves a specific Bitbucket snippet by its encoded ID from an existing workspace, returning its metadata and file structure.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/SnippetsGetSnippetsWatchConnector
actions.label: Snippets: Get Snippets Watch
actions.description: Checks if the current user is watching a specific snippet. Use when you need to verify watch status for a snippet.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/SnippetsListSnippetsConnector
actions.label: Snippets: List Snippets
actions.description: Returns all snippets accessible to the authenticated user. Use when you need to discover or list snippets, optionally filtered by role (owner, contributor, or member).

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/PipelinesAndDeploymentsCreateTeamsPipelinesConfigVariablesConnector
actions.label: Pipelines: And Deployments Create Teams Pipelines Config Variables
actions.description: Creates a team-level pipeline configuration variable in Bitbucket. Use when you need to add environment variables or configuration values that should be available to all pipelines within a team.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/PipelinesAndDeploymentsCreateUsersPipelinesConfigVariablesConnector
actions.label: Pipelines: And Deployments Create Users Pipelines Config Variables
actions.description: Creates a user-level pipeline variable for Bitbucket pipelines. Use when you need to create account-level configuration variables that can be used across all repositories owned by the user.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/PipelinesAndDeploymentsDeleteUserPipelineVariableConnector
actions.label: Pipelines: And Deployments Delete User Pipeline Variable
actions.description: Permanently deletes a user-level pipeline configuration variable identified by its UUID. Use this to remove pipeline variables that are no longer needed at the account level.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/PipelinesAndDeploymentsGetOpenidConfigurationConnector
actions.label: Pipelines: And Deployments Get Openid Configuration
actions.description: Retrieves the OpenID Connect discovery configuration for Bitbucket Pipelines OIDC. Use when integrating Bitbucket Pipelines with resource servers (AWS, GCP, Vault) using OpenID Connect authentication. Returns issuer URL, JWKS URI, and supported capabilities.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/PipelinesAndDeploymentsGetRepositoriesEnvironments2Connector
actions.label: Pipelines: And Deployments Get Repositories Environments2
actions.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific deployment environment in a Bitbucket repository. Use when you need to get environment configuration, deployment settings, or check environment properties like locks and restrictions.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/PipelinesAndDeploymentsGetDeploymentEnvironmentVariablesConnector
actions.label: Pipelines: And Deployments Get Deployment Environment Variables
actions.description: Retrieves deployment environment level variables for a specific Bitbucket repository environment. Use when you need to view or audit environment-specific configuration variables for deployments.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/PipelinesAndDeploymentsGetRepositoriesPipelinesStepsConnector
actions.label: Pipelines: And Deployments Get Repositories Pipelines Steps
actions.description: Retrieves all steps for a given pipeline. Use when you need to inspect the individual steps of a pipeline execution, including their state, duration, and commands.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/PipelinesAndDeploymentsGetRepositoriesPipelinesConfigSshKnownHostsConnector
actions.label: Pipelines: And Deployments Get Repositories Pipelines Config Ssh Known Hosts
actions.description: Retrieves repository-level SSH known hosts configured for Bitbucket Pipelines. Use when you need to list or verify SSH known hosts that Pipelines can connect to during builds.

actions.name: Corsair/Bitbucket/PipelinesAndDeploymentsGetRepositoriesPipelinesConfigRunnersConnector
actions.label: Pipelines: And Deployments Get Repositories Pipelines Config Runners

actions.name: Corsair/Customgpt/ProjectsListConnector
actions.label: Projects: List
actions.description: Lists all CustomGPT projects (agents) for the authenticated user. Returns projects with full details including ID, name, type, chat status, and timestamps. Supports pagination via the 'page' parameter. Use this to discover available projects or iterate through all projects.

actions.name: Corsair/Customgpt/ProjectsGetConnector
actions.label: Projects: Get
actions.description: Tool to get agent details. Returns the full configuration and current status for a specific agent. Use this to check processing status, view settings, or retrieve metadata about the agent.

actions.name: Corsair/Customgpt/ProjectsCreateConnector
actions.label: Projects: Create
actions.description: Tool to create a new CustomGPT agent from a sitemap URL or file upload. The agent immediately begins processing the content to build its knowledge base. Use when you need to create a new AI agent with custom knowledge from web content or documents. Either sitemap_path or file must be provided.

actions.name: Corsair/Customgpt/ProjectsUpdateConnector
actions.label: Projects: Update
actions.description: Updates an existing CustomGPT agent's name or configuration settings. Use this to rename an agent or modify its basic properties without affecting its knowledge base. Returns the complete updated project details including all metadata.

actions.name: Corsair/Customgpt/ProjectsDeleteConnector
actions.label: Projects: Delete
actions.description: Tool to delete a CustomGPT project by ID. Use when you need to permanently remove an existing agent after confirming the ID. [DESTRUCTIVE · IRREVERSIBLE]

actions.name: Corsair/Customgpt/ProjectsCloneConnector
actions.label: Projects: Clone
actions.description: Tool to clone a CustomGPT agent (project). Creates a complete copy of an existing agent, including its knowledge base, persona, and settings. Use this to create variations of an agent for testing, or to use an existing agent as a template for a new one.

actions.name: Corsair/Customgpt/ProjectsStatsConnector
actions.label: Projects: Stats
actions.description: Tool to get agent statistics. Returns usage metrics and performance statistics for an agent, including total conversations, query counts, document statistics, and processing information. Use when you need to monitor agent performance or generate usage reports.

actions.name: Corsair/Customgpt/ProjectsPluginsConnector
actions.label: Projects: Plugins
actions.description: Tool to retrieve plugin details for a specific CustomGPT agent (project). Use when you need to inspect plugin configuration, status, and metadata for an agent.

actions.name: Corsair/Customgpt/PagesListConnector
actions.label: Pages: List
actions.description: Lists all documents in a CustomGPT agent's knowledge base. Returns indexed content including webpages, PDFs, and uploaded files that the agent can reference. Supports filtering by crawl/index status and pagination. Use this to audit knowledge sources or verify successful document ingestion.

actions.name: Corsair/Customgpt/PagesDeleteConnector
actions.label: Pages: Delete
actions.description: Tool to delete a document from a CustomGPT agent's knowledge base. Permanently removes a document and the agent will no longer reference this content when answering questions. Use this to remove outdated or incorrect information. Warning: This action cannot be undone. [DESTRUCTIVE · IRREVERSIBLE]

actions.name: Corsair/Customgpt/PagesReindexConnector
actions.label: Pages: Reindex
actions.description: Tool to reindex a document in CustomGPT knowledge base. Re-crawls and re-indexes a URL-based document to update its content. Use this when the source content has changed and you want the agent to use the updated version. Only works for URL-based documents.

actions.name: Corsair/Customgpt/PagesGetMetadataConnector
actions.label: Pages: Get Metadata
actions.description: Tool to get document metadata including title, source URL, word count, and custom metadata fields. Use this to display document information or manage your knowledge base.

actions.name: Corsair/Customgpt/PagesUpdateMetadataConnector
actions.label: Pages: Update Metadata
actions.description: Update document metadata for a specific page in a CustomGPT project. Updates custom metadata fields such as title, description, URL, and image that help organize and manage your knowledge base. Use when you need to add tags, categories, or other organizational information to documents.

actions.name: Corsair/Customgpt/SourcesListConnector
actions.label: Sources: List
actions.description: Tool to list all data sources connected to an agent. Returns sources from various origins like sitemaps, Google Drive folders, SharePoint sites, or uploaded files. Use this to manage what content feeds into an agent's knowledge base.

actions.name: Corsair/Customgpt/SourcesAddConnector
actions.label: Sources: Add
actions.description: Add a data source to a CustomGPT agent's knowledge base. Connects content via sitemap URL, file upload, or integration. The system begins indexing immediately after creation. Use when adding documentation, FAQs, or knowledge content to an agent.

actions.name: Corsair/Customgpt/SourcesUpdateConnector
actions.label: Sources: Update
actions.description: Update source settings for a CustomGPT agent data source. Configure how the source is indexed and kept up to date by adjusting auto-sync frequency, crawl depth, file filters, and refresh behavior. Use this to fine-tune sitemap crawling (JavaScript execution, image extraction), control which pages are added or removed during syncs, and set up custom refresh schedules.

actions.name: Corsair/Customgpt/SourcesDeleteConnector
actions.label: Sources: Delete
actions.description: Tool to delete a data source from a CustomGPT agent. Removes the source and all its documents from the agent's knowledge base. Use this to disconnect content that's no longer relevant or to clean up after testing. [DESTRUCTIVE · IRREVERSIBLE]

actions.name: Corsair/Customgpt/LicensesListConnector
actions.label: Licenses: List
actions.description: List all licenses for a CustomGPT project/agent. Returns an array of license objects with details like ID, type, status, and timestamps. Returns an empty array if the project has no licenses or if licenses are not enabled for the project. Use this when you need to check what licenses exist for a specific project/agent.

actions.name: Corsair/Customgpt/LicensesGetConnector
actions.label: Licenses: Get
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a license for a specific project. Use when you need to fetch license details by license ID.

actions.name: Corsair/Customgpt/LicensesUpdateConnector
actions.label: Licenses: Update
actions.description: Updates the name of an existing license for a CustomGPT project/agent. Prerequisites: - The project must have licenses enabled in its plan - Both project ID and license ID must be valid and exist - Use List Projects to get valid project IDs - Use List Project Licenses to get valid license IDs for a project This action only updates the license name. Other license properties cannot be modified through this endpoint.

actions.name: Corsair/Customgpt/LicensesDeleteConnector
actions.label: Licenses: Delete
actions.description: Deletes a license from a CustomGPT project/agent. Requires numeric project ID and license ID. This action is idempotent - it succeeds even if the license doesn't exist (404). The project must have licenses enabled in its plan for this endpoint to work properly. [DESTRUCTIVE · IRREVERSIBLE]

actions.name: Corsair/Customgpt/SettingsGetConnector
actions.label: Settings: Get
actions.description: Retrieve configuration settings for a specific CustomGPT agent/project. Returns settings including: chatbot avatar, background, default prompt, example questions, response source, language, and branding preferences. Use this to inspect agent configuration, audit settings, or retrieve values before making updates. Note: Some newly created projects may not have settings initialized yet and will return a 404.

actions.name: Corsair/Customgpt/SettingsUpdateConnector
actions.label: Settings: Update
actions.description: Update CustomGPT agent configuration settings. Updates persona instructions, response format, citation style, branding, and deployment settings. Only include fields you want to change - omitted fields retain their current values. Use this to configure agent behavior, customize appearance, or adjust user experience settings.

actions.name: Corsair/Customgpt/PersonasListConnector
actions.label: Personas: List
actions.description: Tool to list persona versions for a CustomGPT agent. Use when you need to view the version history of an agent's persona. Every time the persona is updated, a snapshot is automatically saved, allowing you to view changes over time or restore a previous version. Results are paginated. Requires Custom plan.

actions.name: Corsair/Customgpt/PersonasActivateConnector
actions.label: Personas: Activate
actions.description: Restore a previous persona version for a CustomGPT agent. Activates a previous persona version, making it the current active persona. This creates a new version entry in the history (it doesn't overwrite), preserving the full audit trail. Use this to roll back to a known-good configuration. Requires Custom plan.

actions.name: Corsair/Customgpt/ConversationsCreateConnector
actions.label: Conversations: Create
actions.description: Tool to create a new conversation session for a CustomGPT agent. Use this when starting a new chat interaction - it returns a session ID that you'll use to send messages. Optionally provide a name to help identify the conversation later.

actions.name: Corsair/Customgpt/MessagesListConnector
actions.label: Messages: List
actions.description: Retrieves all messages from a CustomGPT conversation, including both user queries and AI responses. Use this to view the complete chat history for a specific conversation session. Returns an empty list if the conversation doesn't exist or has no messages.

actions.name: Corsair/Customgpt/MessagesGetConnector
actions.label: Messages: Get
actions.description: Tool to get message details from a CustomGPT conversation. Returns the complete details for a single message, including the user's prompt, the agent's response, timestamps, citations, and any attached metadata.

actions.name: Corsair/Customgpt/MessagesGetTrustScoreConnector
actions.label: Messages: Get Trust Score
actions.description: Tool to retrieve verification trust score for a message in a CustomGPT conversation. Returns a score calculated by checking how well the agent's claims are supported by source documents. Higher scores indicate better-grounded responses with stronger evidence.

actions.name: Corsair/Customgpt/MessagesVerifyConnector
actions.label: Messages: Verify
actions.description: Tool to verify message accuracy by triggering a fact-checking verification process. Use when you need to verify claims in a conversation message against source documents. The system compares each claim and reports which claims are supported, partially supported, or unsupported.

actions.name: Corsair/Customgpt/MessagesSubmitFeedbackConnector
actions.label: Messages: Submit Feedback
actions.description: Tool to submit feedback (thumbs up/down) for a message in a CustomGPT conversation. Use this to record user satisfaction signals that help identify which AI responses are helpful and which need improvement. Feedback can be changed by submitting a new reaction value.

actions.name: Corsair/Customgpt/ReportsGetAnalysisConnector
actions.label: Reports: Get Analysis
actions.description: Tool to retrieve analytics chart data for a CustomGPT project. Returns time-series data formatted for charts, with daily or weekly breakdowns of key metrics including conversation counts, query counts, and queries-per-conversation ratios. Use this to generate usage reports, track project engagement over time, or visualize chatbot performance trends.

actions.name: Corsair/Customgpt/ReportsGetConversationsConnector
actions.label: Reports: Get Conversations
actions.description: Tool to get conversation analytics for a CustomGPT project. Returns conversation metrics including total conversations, average queries per conversation, and other engagement statistics. Use this to understand how users engage with your agent and analyze conversation patterns over time.

actions.name: Corsair/Customgpt/ReportsGetTrafficConnector
actions.label: Reports: Get Traffic
actions.description: Tool to retrieve traffic analytics for a CustomGPT agent/project. Returns user traffic metrics including unique visitors, session counts, geographic distribution, and device types. Use this to understand who's using your agent and how they're accessing it.

actions.name: Corsair/Customgpt/ReportsGetIntelligenceConnector
actions.label: Reports: Get Intelligence
actions.description: Tool to get customer intelligence for a CustomGPT project. Returns AI-analyzed insights about users including common intents, emotional sentiment, frequently discussed topics, and emerging trends. Use this to understand what users are asking about and identify patterns in user behavior.

actions.name: Corsair/Customgpt/ReportsExportLeadsConnector
actions.label: Reports: Export Leads
actions.description: Export leads from a CustomGPT project. Returns lead information captured from conversations including email addresses, names, phone numbers, and custom fields. Supports pagination and date range filtering. Use this to sync leads with CRM or marketing tools.

actions.name: Corsair/Customgpt/LimitsGetUsageConnector
actions.label: Limits: Get Usage
actions.description: Get account usage limits showing current usage vs. maximum allowed for projects, storage credits, and API queries. This returns how many projects, storage credits (characters indexed), and queries you've used compared to your account's maximum limits. Use this to monitor quota consumption.

actions.name: Corsair/Customgpt/UserGetProfileConnector
actions.label: User: Get Profile
actions.description: Tool to retrieve the current user's profile information. Use when you need to display or verify authenticated user details after login.

actions.name: Corsair/Customgpt/UserUpdateProfileConnector
actions.label: User: Update Profile
actions.description: Updates the authenticated user's profile information in CustomGPT. Use this action to modify profile details such as the user's display name, email address, or profile photo URL. All fields are optional - only the fields you provide will be updated. The action returns the complete updated user profile.

actions.name: Corsair/Customgpt/UserSearchTeamMembersConnector
actions.label: User: Search Team Members
actions.description: Tool to search for team members by email address or user ID. Use this to find users when assigning permissions or managing team access. Requires Owner or Admin role to execute.

actions.name: Corsair/Digitalocean/DatabasesCreateDatabaseClusterConnector
actions.label: Databases: Create Database Cluster
actions.description: Creates a new managed database cluster on DigitalOcean. Provisions a database with specified engine (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Valkey, MongoDB, Kafka, or OpenSearch), version, region, size, and node count. Returns connection credentials and cluster details. The cluster will be in 'creating' status initially and take several minutes to become fully operational.

actions.name: Corsair/Digitalocean/DatabasesDeleteDatabaseClusterConnector
actions.label: Databases: Delete Database Cluster
actions.description: Tool to delete a database cluster by UUID. Use when you have confirmed the cluster is no longer needed. Returns HTTP 204 No Content on success.

actions.name: Corsair/Digitalocean/DatabasesListAllDatabasesConnector
actions.label: Databases: List All Databases
actions.description: Tool to list all managed database clusters on your account. Supports pagination and filtering by tag. A single request returns only one page; iterate using `page` and `per_page` to retrieve all clusters.

actions.name: Corsair/Digitalocean/DatabasesListDatabaseOptionsConnector
actions.label: Databases: List Database Options
actions.description: Lists all available configuration options for DigitalOcean managed database clusters, including supported engines (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Valkey, Kafka, OpenSearch), versions, regions, and cluster sizes/layouts. Use this to discover valid parameter values when creating a new database cluster. #### Output | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | Yes | Data from the action execution | | `error` | string | No | Error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | Yes | Whether or not the action execution was successful or not |

actions.name: Corsair/Digitalocean/DomainRecordsCreateNewDomainRecordConnector
actions.label: Domain: Records Create New Domain Record
actions.description: Tool to create a new DNS record for a domain. Use after confirming domain exists and record specifics.

actions.name: Corsair/Digitalocean/DomainRecordsDeleteDomainRecordConnector
actions.label: Domain: Records Delete Domain Record
actions.description: Tool to delete a DNS record by its record ID for a domain. Use when you need to remove an existing DNS record and have the domain name and record ID. Returns HTTP 204 No Content on success.

actions.name: Corsair/Digitalocean/DomainRecordsListDomainRecordsConnector
actions.label: Domain: Records List Domain Records
actions.description: Tool to list all DNS records for a domain. Use when you need to inspect or filter a domain's DNS configuration.

actions.name: Corsair/Digitalocean/DomainRecordsRetrieveDomainRecordConnector
actions.label: Domain: Records Retrieve Domain Record
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a specific DNS record for a domain by its record ID. Use when you have the domain name and record ID to fetch record details.

actions.name: Corsair/Digitalocean/DomainRecordsUpdateDomainRecordConnector
actions.label: Domain: Records Update Domain Record
actions.description: Tool to update an existing DNS record for a domain. Use when you need to modify any valid attribute of a record after confirming its record ID.

actions.name: Corsair/Digitalocean/DomainsCreateNewDomainConnector
actions.label: Domains: Create New Domain
actions.description: Creates a new domain in DigitalOcean's DNS management system. This adds the domain to your DigitalOcean account and allows you to manage its DNS records. Use this action when you need to: - Add a domain to DigitalOcean DNS for DNS hosting and management - Set up a new domain with an optional initial A record pointing to an IP address - Transfer DNS management of an existing domain to DigitalOcean Note: The domain name must be unique within your DigitalOcean account and use a recognized top-level domain (TLD). After creation, you can add additional DNS records using the create domain record action.

actions.name: Corsair/Digitalocean/DomainsDeleteDomainConnector
actions.label: Domains: Delete Domain
actions.description: Deletes a domain from DigitalOcean DNS. This action is permanent and cannot be undone. Note: If the domain is associated with a Let's Encrypt certificate, delete the certificate first and reconfigure any resources using it (e.g., load balancer SSL termination, Spaces CDN endpoints). Returns 204 No Content on successful deletion.

actions.name: Corsair/Digitalocean/DomainsListAllDomainsConnector
actions.label: Domains: List All Domains
actions.description: Lists all DNS domains configured in your DigitalOcean account. Returns domain names, TTL values, and complete zone files. Supports pagination for large domain lists. Use this action to discover available domains, check domain configurations, or as a prerequisite for domain-specific operations like managing DNS records. No parameters are required - calling without parameters returns the first 20 domains (default page size).

actions.name: Corsair/Digitalocean/DomainsRetrieveDomainConnector
actions.label: Domains: Retrieve Domain
actions.description: Retrieves complete details about a specific domain including its TTL and DNS zone file configuration. Use this when you need to check domain settings, verify DNS configuration, or get the full zone file contents for a domain in your DigitalOcean account.

actions.name: Corsair/Digitalocean/DropletsCreateNewDropletConnector
actions.label: Droplets: Create New Droplet
actions.description: Tool to create a new Droplet. Use when you need to provision a VM with name, region, size, and image. The `image`, `region`, and `size` must be mutually compatible — the chosen `region` must be listed in the image's available regions.

actions.name: Corsair/Digitalocean/DropletsDeleteExistingDropletConnector
actions.label: Droplets: Delete Existing Droplet
actions.description: Tool to delete a Droplet by ID. Deletion is irreversible — all data is permanently lost. Confirm droplet_id with the user and verify a backup or snapshot exists before proceeding.

actions.name: Corsair/Digitalocean/DropletsListAllDropletsConnector
actions.label: Droplets: List All Droplets
actions.description: Lists all Droplets (virtual machines) in your DigitalOcean account with pagination support. Returns detailed information including: ID, name, specs (memory, vCPUs, disk), status, networking (IP addresses), region, image, size, tags, and VPC. Supports filtering by tag and pagination for large result sets. Use this to get an overview of your infrastructure, find specific droplets, or monitor droplet status. Default page size is 20; accounts with more droplets require explicit pagination (increment `page`, up to `per_page=200`) to avoid silently incomplete results.

actions.name: Corsair/Digitalocean/DropletsRetrieveExistingDropletConnector
actions.label: Droplets: Retrieve Existing Droplet
actions.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific DigitalOcean Droplet by its unique numeric ID. Returns comprehensive droplet details including: current status, specifications (memory, CPU, disk), networking configuration (IPv4/IPv6 addresses), image information, region, VPC, backup settings, attached volumes, and tags. Use this when you need to check a droplet's current state, configuration, or IP addresses.

actions.name: Corsair/Digitalocean/FirewallsCreateNewFirewallConnector
actions.label: Firewalls: Create New Firewall
actions.description: Creates a new cloud firewall with custom inbound and outbound rules. Use this action to set up network security rules that control traffic to and from your Droplets. You can specify rules using IP addresses (CIDR notation), Droplet IDs, tags, Load Balancer UUIDs, or Kubernetes cluster IDs. The firewall can be applied to specific Droplets, all Droplets with certain tags, or scoped to a VPC. Requires at least one inbound rule and one outbound rule. Supports tcp, udp, and icmp protocols.

actions.name: Corsair/Digitalocean/FirewallsDeleteFirewallConnector
actions.label: Firewalls: Delete Firewall
actions.description: Tool to delete a firewall by ID. Use when you have confirmed the firewall is no longer needed.

actions.name: Corsair/Digitalocean/FirewallsListAllFirewallsConnector
actions.label: Firewalls: List All Firewalls
actions.description: List all cloud firewalls configured in your DigitalOcean account. Returns comprehensive firewall details including inbound/outbound rules, associated droplets, tags, and status. Supports pagination for accounts with many firewalls. Use this to audit network security, discover existing firewall configurations, or retrieve firewall IDs for subsequent operations.

actions.name: Corsair/Digitalocean/ImagesCreateCustomImageConnector
actions.label: Images: Create Custom Image
actions.description: Creates a custom image in DigitalOcean by importing a Linux VM disk image from a publicly accessible URL. Use this action to upload custom OS images (Ubuntu, Debian, CentOS, Fedora, etc.) that can later be used to create Droplets. The image will be processed asynchronously and its status can be monitored via the returned image ID.

actions.name: Corsair/Digitalocean/ImagesDeleteImageConnector
actions.label: Images: Delete Image
actions.description: Deletes a user-created custom image or snapshot from your DigitalOcean account by its numeric ID. This action permanently removes the image and cannot be undone. Only custom images and snapshots you own can be deleted - attempting to delete distribution images or marketplace applications will fail with a 403 Forbidden error. Use this when cleaning up unused images that are no longer needed and have no dependent resources.

actions.name: Corsair/Digitalocean/ImagesListAllImagesConnector
actions.label: Images: List All Images
actions.description: Tool to list all images available on your account. Use after obtaining a valid API token to retrieve images optionally filtered by type, private visibility, or tag_name.

actions.name: Corsair/Digitalocean/ImagesRetrieveExistingImageConnector
actions.label: Images: Retrieve Existing Image
actions.description: Tool to retrieve information about an image by ID or slug. Use when you need detailed metadata for a known image.

actions.name: Corsair/Digitalocean/KubernetesCreateNewKubernetesClusterConnector
actions.label: Kubernetes: Create New Kubernetes Cluster
actions.description: Creates a new DigitalOcean Kubernetes (DOKS) cluster with managed control plane. Required: cluster name, region slug, Kubernetes version slug, and at least one node pool configuration. Optional: tags, auto-upgrade settings, maintenance policy, node labels/taints, and auto-scaling. The cluster will be created in 'provisioning' state and may take several minutes to become 'running'. Query /v2/kubernetes/options endpoint to get available regions, versions, and node sizes.

actions.name: Corsair/Digitalocean/KubernetesListAllKubernetesClustersConnector
actions.label: Kubernetes: List All Kubernetes Clusters
actions.description: Tool to list all Kubernetes clusters on your account. Use when you need to enumerate every cluster and handle pagination.

actions.name: Corsair/Digitalocean/LoadBalancersCreateNewLoadBalancerConnector
actions.label: Load: Balancers Create New Load Balancer
actions.description: Tool to create a new load balancer. Use after specifying region, forwarding rules, and targets.

actions.name: Corsair/Digitalocean/LoadBalancersDeleteLoadBalancerConnector
actions.label: Load: Balancers Delete Load Balancer
actions.description: Tool to delete a load balancer instance by ID. Use when you need to permanently remove an existing load balancer after confirming its ID. Returns 204 No Content on success.

actions.name: Corsair/Digitalocean/LoadBalancersListAllLoadBalancersConnector
actions.label: Load: Balancers List All Load Balancers
actions.description: List all load balancers in your DigitalOcean account with pagination support. Returns load balancer details including IDs, names, IP addresses, forwarding rules, health checks, sticky sessions, assigned Droplets, and region information. Use this to get an overview of all load balancers or to find specific load balancers by iterating through results.

actions.name: Corsair/Digitalocean/SnapshotsListAllSnapshotsConnector
actions.label: Snapshots: List All Snapshots
actions.description: Tool to list all snapshots available on your DigitalOcean account. Use when you need to fetch and optionally filter snapshots by resource type (droplet or volume) and handle pagination for inventory or backup workflows.

actions.name: Corsair/Digitalocean/SshKeysCreateNewSshKeyConnector
actions.label: Ssh: Keys Create New Ssh Key
actions.description: Registers a new SSH public key with your DigitalOcean account. The registered key can then be automatically added to new Droplets during creation, enabling secure SSH access. The key must be provided in OpenSSH format (ssh-rsa, ssh-ed25519, etc.) and must not already exist on the account.

actions.name: Corsair/Digitalocean/SshKeysDeleteSshKeyConnector
actions.label: Ssh: Keys Delete Ssh Key
actions.description: Tool to delete a public SSH key. Use when you need to remove an SSH key from your account by its ID or fingerprint after confirming its ownership. Returns 204 No Content on success.

actions.name: Corsair/Digitalocean/SshKeysListAllSshKeysConnector
actions.label: Ssh: Keys List All Ssh Keys
actions.description: Lists all SSH keys associated with your DigitalOcean account. Returns SSH key details including ID, name, public key content, and fingerprint. Supports pagination for accounts with many SSH keys. Use this when you need to view available SSH keys or retrieve an SSH key ID for use with other operations like creating droplets.

actions.name: Corsair/Digitalocean/TagsCreateNewTagConnector
actions.label: Tags: Create New Tag
actions.description: Creates a new tag in DigitalOcean for organizing and grouping resources. Tags can be applied to droplets, images, volumes, volume snapshots, and databases. If a tag with the same name already exists, the API returns the existing tag (idempotent operation). Tag names must be 1-255 characters containing only letters, numbers, hyphens, or underscores.

actions.name: Corsair/Digitalocean/TagsDeleteTagConnector
actions.label: Tags: Delete Tag
actions.description: Deletes a tag from your DigitalOcean account. When a tag is deleted, it is automatically removed from all resources that were tagged with it. This operation is idempotent - deleting a non-existent tag will also return success (204 No Content).

actions.name: Corsair/Digitalocean/TagsListAllTagsConnector
actions.label: Tags: List All Tags
actions.description: Tool to list all tags in your account. Use when you need to retrieve available tags and pagination info. A single request returns only one page of results; iterate using `page` and `per_page` to retrieve all tags.

actions.name: Corsair/Digitalocean/TagsRetrieveTagConnector
actions.label: Tags: Retrieve Tag
actions.description: Tool to retrieve an individual tag by name. Use when you need to inspect the resources grouped under a specific tag.

actions.name: Corsair/Digitalocean/TagsTagResourceConnector
actions.label: Tags: Tag Resource
actions.description: Tool to tag resources by name. Use when you need to assign an existing tag to one or more resources. Returns 204 No Content on success.

actions.name: Corsair/Digitalocean/TagsUntagResourceConnector
actions.label: Tags: Untag Resource
actions.description: Tool to untag resources by tag name. Use when you need to remove an existing tag from multiple resources in a single operation.

actions.name: Corsair/Digitalocean/VolumesCreateNewBlockStorageVolumeConnector
actions.label: Volumes: Create New Block Storage Volume
actions.description: Tool to create a new block storage volume. Use when you need to provision persistent block storage after confirming the target region supports volumes. Example: "Create a 100 GiB ext4 backup volume named 'db-backup' in nyc1."

actions.name: Corsair/Digitalocean/VolumesDeleteBlockStorageVolumeConnector
actions.label: Volumes: Delete Block Storage Volume
actions.description: Permanently deletes a block storage volume by its unique ID. Use this tool when you need to remove an existing volume. The volume must not be attached to any Droplet before deletion. This operation cannot be undone. Returns HTTP 204 No Content on success. Note: To delete by volume name instead of ID, you would need a different endpoint that accepts both name and region parameters.

actions.name: Corsair/Digitalocean/VolumesListAllVolumesConnector
actions.label: Volumes: List All Volumes
actions.description: Tool to list all block storage volumes available on your account. Use when you need to retrieve volumes and optionally filter by name and region.

actions.name: Corsair/Digitalocean/VpcsCreateNewVpcConnector
actions.label: Vpcs: Create New Vpc
actions.description: Creates a new Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) in a specified DigitalOcean region. VPCs are private networks for isolating your resources. Traffic within a VPC is free and doesn't count toward bandwidth limits. VPCs support Droplets, managed databases, load balancers, and Kubernetes clusters. The first VPC created in a region automatically becomes the default VPC for that region.

actions.name: Corsair/Digitalocean/VpcsDeleteVpcConnector
actions.label: Vpcs: Delete Vpc
actions.description: Delete a VPC (Virtual Private Cloud) by its unique identifier. Use this tool when you need to permanently remove a VPC from your DigitalOcean account. Deletion is irreversible — always confirm the vpc_id with the user before proceeding. **Important Restrictions:** - Cannot delete a VPC that is the default VPC for its region - Cannot delete a VPC that has member resources (droplets, databases, load balancers, etc.) — all resources must be detached or migrated first - VPC must be empty before deletion Returns an empty response (HTTP 204) on successful deletion.

actions.name: Corsair/Digitalocean/VpcsListAllVpcsConnector
actions.label: Vpcs: List All Vpcs
actions.description: Tool to list all VPCs on your account. Use when you need an inventory of your VPC resources. A single request returns only one page; iterate through all pages using `page` and `per_page` (max 200) to retrieve the complete set.

actions.name: Corsair/Digitalocean/VpcsRetrieveVpcConnector
actions.label: Vpcs: Retrieve Vpc
actions.description: Tool to retrieve details about a specific VPC by its ID. Use when you need to inspect VPC properties for configuration or auditing.

actions.name: Corsair/Digitalocean/VpcsUpdateVpcConnector
actions.label: Vpcs: Update Vpc
actions.description: Tool to update information about a VPC. Use when you need to modify the name, description, or default status of an existing VPC.

actions.name: Corsair/Googlemaps/PlacesAutocompleteConnector
actions.label: Places: Autocomplete
actions.description: Returns place and query predictions for text input. Use when implementing as-you-type autocomplete functionality for place searches. Returns up to five predictions ordered by relevance.

actions.name: Corsair/Googlemaps/PlacesGetPlaceDetailsConnector
actions.label: Places: Get Place Details
actions.description: Retrieves comprehensive details for a place using its resource name (places/{place_id} format). Use when you need detailed information about a specific place.

actions.name: Corsair/Googlemaps/PlacesGetPlacePhotoConnector
actions.label: Places: Get Place Photo
actions.description: Retrieves high quality photographic content from the Google Maps Places database. Use when you need to download a place photo using a photo_reference obtained from Place Details, Nearby Search, or Text Search requests. Images are scaled proportionally to fit within specified dimensions.

actions.name: Corsair/Googlemaps/PlacesNearbySearchConnector
actions.label: Places: Nearby Search
actions.description: Searches for places (e.g., restaurants, parks) within a specified circular area, with options to filter by place types and customize the returned fields and number of results.

actions.name: Corsair/Googlemaps/PlacesTextSearchConnector
actions.label: Places: Text Search
actions.description: Searches for places on Google Maps using a textual query (e.g., "restaurants in London", "Eiffel Tower"). Results may include CLOSED_PERMANENTLY or TEMPORARILY_CLOSED places — filter by businessStatus=OPERATIONAL. Include city/region and business type in textQuery to avoid empty or irrelevant results. Deduplicate using id or formattedAddress, not name alone. Throttle to ~1 req/s; OVER_QUERY_LIMIT (HTTP 429) requires exponential backoff.

actions.name: Corsair/Googlemaps/RoutesComputeRouteMatrixConnector
actions.label: Routes: Compute Route Matrix
actions.description: Calculates travel distance and duration matrix between multiple origins and destinations using the modern Routes API; supports OAuth2 authentication and various travel modes. Matrix is capped at 625 elements (e.g., 25×25); chunk larger sets to avoid RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED errors. Response elements may be returned out of input order — always use originIndex and destinationIndex to map results. Only use elements where condition='ROUTE_EXISTS'; the matrix may be incomplete.

actions.name: Corsair/Googlemaps/RoutesDistanceMatrixConnector
actions.label: Routes: Distance Matrix
actions.description: DEPRECATED: Legacy API that calculates travel distance and time for a matrix of origins and destinations. This API only works with API keys (no OAuth2 support). Use the modern 'Compute Route Matrix' action instead, which supports OAuth2 authentication. Supports different modes of transportation and options like departure/arrival times. Capped at 100 elements per request (elements = origins × destinations count); split large sets into batches.

actions.name: Corsair/Googlemaps/RoutesGetDirectionConnector
actions.label: Routes: Get Direction
actions.description: Fetches detailed directions between an origin and a destination, supporting intermediate waypoints and various travel modes. Automatically uses the modern Routes API with OAuth2 when available, falling back to legacy API with API key if provided.

actions.name: Corsair/Googlemaps/RoutesGetRouteConnector
actions.label: Routes: Get Route
actions.description: Calculates one or more routes between two specified locations. Uses various travel modes and preferences; addresses must be resolvable by Google Maps. Response duration is a string with 's' suffix (e.g., "4557s"); parse before displaying.

actions.name: Corsair/Googlemaps/GeocodingGeocodeAddressConnector
actions.label: Geocoding: Geocode Address
actions.description: DEPRECATED: Legacy API to convert street addresses into geographic coordinates (latitude and longitude). This API works best with API key authentication. For OAuth connections without an API key, use geocoding.geocodeAddressWithQuery or geocoding.geocodingApi instead. Use when you need to geocode an address or location to get its precise latitude/longitude coordinates.

actions.name: Corsair/Googlemaps/GeocodingGeocodeAddressWithQueryConnector
actions.label: Geocoding: Geocode Address With Query
actions.description: Tool to map addresses to geographic coordinates with query parameter. Use when you need to convert a textual address into latitude/longitude coordinates using the modern v4beta API. Results may match multiple places — always verify formattedAddress, region, and addressComponents in the response before using returned coordinates.

actions.name: Corsair/Googlemaps/GeocodingGeocodeDestinationsConnector
actions.label: Geocoding: Geocode Destinations
actions.description: Tool to perform destination lookup and return detailed destination information including primary place, containing places, sub-destinations, landmarks, entrances, and navigation points. Use when you need comprehensive destination data for an address, place ID, or geographic coordinates.

actions.name: Corsair/Googlemaps/GeocodingGeocodePlaceConnector
actions.label: Geocoding: Geocode Place
actions.description: Tool to perform geocode lookup using a place identifier to retrieve address and coordinates. Use when you need to get detailed geographic information for a specific Google Place ID.

actions.name: Corsair/Googlemaps/GeocodingGeocodingApiConnector
actions.label: Geocoding: Geocoding Api
actions.description: Convert addresses into geographic coordinates (latitude and longitude) and vice versa (reverse geocoding), or get an address for a Place ID. Uses the Geocoding API v4 (v4beta) which supports OAuth2 authentication. Exactly one of address, latlng, or place_id must be provided per request; omitting all three or mixing incompatible combinations yields no useful results.

actions.name: Corsair/Googlemaps/GeocodingReverseGeocodeLocationConnector
actions.label: Geocoding: Reverse Geocode Location
actions.description: Tool to convert geographic coordinates (latitude and longitude) to human-readable addresses using reverse geocoding. Use when you need to find the address or place name for a given set of coordinates. A single coordinate pair may return multiple results; verify formattedAddress, region, and addressComponents before committing to a result.

actions.name: Corsair/Googlemaps/TilesCreateTilesSessionConnector
actions.label: Tiles: Create Tiles Session
actions.description: Tool to create a session token required for accessing 2D Tiles and Street View imagery. Use when you need to initialize tile-based map rendering or street view display. The session token is valid for approximately two weeks and must be included in all subsequent tile requests. Each call consumes quota — cache and reuse the returned token across all tile requests within its validity window rather than creating a new session per request.

actions.name: Corsair/Googlemaps/TilesGet2dTileConnector
actions.label: Tiles: Get2d Tile
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a 2D map tile image at specified coordinates for building custom map visualizations. Use when you need to download individual map tile images for roadmap, satellite, or terrain views. Requires a valid session token from the createSession endpoint.

actions.name: Corsair/Googlemaps/TilesGet3dTilesRootConnector
actions.label: Tiles: Get3d Tiles Root
actions.description: Tool to retrieve the 3D Tiles tileset root configuration for photorealistic 3D map rendering. Use when you need to initialize a 3D renderer with Google's photorealistic tiles following the OGC 3D Tiles specification. The Map Tiles API is billable per request; cache the root response client-side and avoid repeated calls.

actions.name: Corsair/Googlemaps/TilesEmbedMapConnector
actions.label: Tiles: Embed Map
actions.description: Tool to generate an embeddable Google Map URL and HTML iframe code. Use when you need to display a map (place, view, directions, street view, search) on a webpage without JavaScript. Note: This API only works with API keys (no OAuth2 support). It generates embed URLs and does not make direct API calls. Generated embed URLs are publicly accessible; avoid passing sensitive or internal location queries.

actions.name: Corsair/Googlemaps/GeolocationGeolocateConnector
actions.label: Geolocation: Geolocate
actions.description: Tool to determine location based on cell towers and WiFi access points. Use when you need to find the geographic location of a device using network infrastructure data.

actions.name: Corsair/Googlemaps/AerialLookupAerialVideoConnector
actions.label: Aerial: Lookup Aerial Video
actions.description: Tool to look up an aerial view video by address or video ID. Returns video metadata including state and URIs for playback. Use when you need to retrieve a previously rendered aerial video or check the status of a video render request. Note that receiving a video is a billable event.

actions.name: Corsair/Googlemaps/AerialRenderAerialVideoConnector
actions.label: Aerial: Render Aerial Video
actions.description: Starts rendering an aerial view video for a US postal address. Returns a video ID that can be used with lookupVideo to retrieve the video once rendering completes. Rendering typically takes up to a few hours.
